jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Amazon is seeking exceptional talent to help develop the next generation of advanced robotics systems that will transform automation at Amazon's scale. We're building revolutionary robotic systems that combine cutting\-edge AI, sophisticated control systems, and advanced mechanical design to create adaptable automation solutions capable of working safely alongside humans in dynamic environments. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of robotics and automation at an unprecedented scale, working with world\-class teams pushing the boundaries of what's possible in robotic dexterous manipulation, locomotion, and human\-robot interaction. This role presents an opportunity to shape the future of robotics through innovative applications of deep learning and large language models. At Amazon we leverage advanced robotics, machine learning, and artificial intelligence to solve complex operational challenges at an unprecedented scale. Our fleet of robots operates across hundreds of facilities worldwide, working in sophisticated coordination to fulfill our mission of customer excellence. The ideal candidate will contribute to research that bridges the gap between theoretical advancement and practical implementation in robotics. You will be part of a team that's revolutionizing how robots learn, adapt, and interact with their environment. Join us in building the next generation of intelligent robotics systems that will transform the future of automation and human\-robot collaboration. jobs.title: Software Dev Mgr, ML Infrastructure, Edge AI Platform
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Amazon Devices (Lab126\) builds products and services that delight millions of customers globally. The Edge AI ML Platform and Infrastructure team is building the platform that enables Amazon teams to train, optimize, evaluate, and deploy generative AI models on devices and in the cloud. Today, optimizing a large model for a new hardware target requires experts to connect model onboarding, distributed training, compression, evaluation, compilation, and deployment systems by hand. We are turning that work into a repeatable, self\-service workflow. Our platform supports large language, vision, audio, multimodal, and mixture\-of\-experts models, and gives scientists and engineers the tools to move new optimization techniques from research code into reliable production workflows. We are looking for a Software Development Manager to build and lead the ML infrastructure team behind this platform. You will own distributed training on multi\-node GPU clusters, compute capacity and utilization, CI/CD, observability, and operational reliability for GPU\-intensive workloads. You will hire and develop a team of software and ML infrastructure engineers, set its technical direction and roadmap, and deliver platform capabilities that scientists and product teams depend on to ship models with hundreds of billions of parameters. This role combines people leadership with deep technical judgment. You will grow engineers and managers\-in\-the\-making, drive architecture decisions with your senior engineers, turn ambiguous science and product needs into a prioritized plan, and hold a high bar for delivery and operational excellence. Key job responsibilities Build, lead, and grow a team of software and ML infrastructure engineers: recruit and hire, set clear goals, coach for growth, and manage performance across the team. Own the roadmap for ML infrastructure—distributed training, GPU capacity, workflow orchestration, CI/CD, and observability—balancing near\-term deliveries with long\-term platform health. Drive the architecture of distributed training capabilities (data, tensor, pipeline, and model parallelism) for large language and multimodal models, partnering with senior engineers and applied scientists. Establish operational excellence for production platform services, including metrics, alarms, runbooks, on\-call processes, and root\-cause correction of recurring issues, while owning GPU fleet efficiency, capacity planning, and cost optimization. Partner with applied science, compiler, runtime, hardware, security, and product teams to align requirements, manage dependencies, and deliver cross\-team programs. You'll scan where things stand, spot the risks that are about to become problems, and decide where your attention will make the biggest difference. No two days look the same, but the through\-line is always the same: you're the person connecting the dots across teams that don't naturally talk to each other. You'll spend a good chunk of your time with engineers, product managers, and scientists, sometimes in a working session untangling a thorny dependency, sometimes in a quick hallway\-style conversation to unblock a decision. jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Differentiated Security Team
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Do you want to turn recurring security gaps into enterprise\-wide solutions that protect millions of customers? As a Senior Technical Program Manager on Amazon's Differentiated Security Team, you will lead a program that identifies systemic security challenges surfaced through acquisitions and partner engagements, proves solutions work in real environments, and transitions them to long\-term owners. This is a high\-visibility role where you will define program strategy, influence senior leaders, and drive cross\-functional delivery across security engineering, business security, and infrastructure teams. If you thrive in ambiguity, build consensus across organizations, and are energized by turning complex problems into simple, scalable solutions \- we want to talk to you. This is not a maintenance role. You will build the program's operational framework from the ground up by defining how security signals enter the pipeline, how initiatives are prioritized, and what "done" looks like. You will work at the intersection of mergers and acquisitions, security engineering, and enterprise infrastructure, giving you a vantage point into security challenges that most teams never see. What makes this role unique: * You see security problems before anyone else. M\&A integrations and partner engagements surface gaps in non\-standard environments that standard security teams do not encounter * Every initiative has a finish line. You prove solutions work, then hand them off. You are a transient owner by design, not a permanent operator. * You shape the program, not just run it. The operational model, lifecycle framework, and prioritization rubric are being built now. You will have direct influence over how this program works for years to come * Your work has enterprise\-wide impact. Solutions born from this program scale across dozens of business units and hundreds of thousands of applications. Key job responsibilities * Own the end\-to\-end lifecycle of a security solutions program from signal identification through proof\-of\-concept, investment pitch, and transition to a funded long\-term owner * Define program strategy, build prioritization mechanisms, and create measurable success criteria that keep a portfolio of concurrent initiatives on track \- Drive cross\-functional delivery across security engineering, business security, and infrastructure teams \- often in environments with non\-standard technology stacks * Write strategic narratives and present trade\-offs, progress, and investment recommendations to Directors and VPs * Build mechanisms such as intake rubrics, initiative registries, and stage\-gate frameworks that make the program repeatable and scalable beyond any single person. A day in the life You might start the morning facilitating a cross\-functional design review to evaluate whether an existing security solution can close a newly identified gap, or whether a new approach is needed. After lunch, you could be writing an investment narrative to transition a validated solution to its long\-term owner. When an active acquisition closes, you may step in as the integration TPM \- coordinating security workstreams across engineering, infrastructure, and the acquired business to drive Day 1 readiness and post\-close milestones. No two days look the same; the program spans concurrent initiatives at different lifecycle stages, and you keep them all moving forward. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores. jobs.title: Supply Chain Manager III, Global Transportation Services (GTS) Planning
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Do you want to build the tools and processes that make supply chain planning faster and smarter? Amazon's Global Transportation Services (GTS) Planning Products team is looking for a Supply Chain Manager III to define problems, design solutions, and drive productivity improvements across our outbound transportation network planning operations. As the team invests in using AI to automate manual planning processes and build more robust systems, this is a compelling time to join and shape how that transformation takes hold. This is a highly collaborative, individual contributor role where you will work side by side with planners to understand their workflows, identify improvement areas, and write clear problem statements. From there, you will partner with technology teams to build tooling solutions and with operational partners to implement process changes. You will work with optimization models, capacity planning tools, and product management tools to turn undefined challenges into concrete products. If you thrive in ambiguity and want visibility with senior leadership, this role is for you. Key job responsibilities * Define problem statements by embedding with planners to understand planning workflows, then partner with technology teams to design and deliver tooling solutions — including optimization models and capacity planning tools — that improve productivity across the outbound transportation network. * Analyze supply chain planning data to identify root causes behind performance gaps and propose scalable process or system improvements, with a focus on automating manual processes through AI\-driven approaches. * Lead weekly product update meetings with leadership, business, and tech stakeholders, and prepare monthly and quarterly business reviews to communicate progress, trade\-offs, and recommendations. * Collaborate with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Product Managers to implement technical improvements to reporting and planning mechanisms. * Develop metrics and monitoring dashboards that enable stakeholders to track planning performance and make informed decisions. A day in the life Your work is almost entirely collaborative and roadmap\-driven. You might start the morning reviewing capacity planning outputs or optimization model results to refine a problem statement, then meet with planners to validate your findings. After lunch, you could be in a working session with a tech team scoping requirements for a new AI\-powered automation tool. Later in the week, you run a product update meeting with leadership, business, and tech stakeholders to share progress and align on priorities. You will also prepare and present monthly and quarterly business reviews, giving you regular visibility with senior leaders. About the team The GTS Planning Products team keeps Amazon's outbound transportation network planning processes current and pushes them forward. We are investing in AI and automation to replace manual workflows with robust, scalable systems. We build solutions for the broader planning organization and partner with carrier teams, tech teams, and operations to integrate these into our planning tools. This role offers growth in the product space — you will build expertise in optimization models, capacity planning, and the latest tooling trends while developing deep knowledge of network planning. jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Software
jobs.description: ABS Group Digital Solutions is seeking a Principal Software Engineer to help build the next\-generation Fleet Management System (FMS). This role will lead hands\-on application engineering for modern web and SaaS workflows, working with product, UX, Nautical Systems subject matter experts, Advantage architects, platform engineering, data, and AI teams. The Principal Software Engineer will own the technical quality of assigned product areas from design and implementation through testing, deployment, and production support. This is an AI\-enabled engineering leadership role, not simply a full\-stack development position. The successful candidate will turn validated workflows and architecture decisions into clear engineering tasks; use approved AI development tools and coding agents where they add value; and remain accountable for the security, correctness, maintainability, and operability of the resulting software. The role calls for a senior engineer who can mentor others, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and build reusable patterns without losing sight of customer outcomes. **What You Will Do:** * Lead technical design and hands\-on development of FMS application features, including role\-based user interfaces, APIs, business services, and integrations. * Work with product managers, UX designers, legacy\-system SMEs, and customers to translate operational workflows and prototype feedback into buildable designs and acceptance criteria. * Guide engineers on application architecture, service boundaries, data access patterns, and reuse of shared platform capabilities; document consequential design decisions. * Break work into well\-scoped tasks and direct AI\-assisted engineering workflows, including code generation, refactoring, test creation, and documentation, while applying human review and verification to every production change. * Establish and model engineering practices for code review, automated unit and integration testing, secure development, CI/CD, and maintainable software delivery. * Integrate application features with approved AI/ML or LLM\-based services where there is a validated user need, including appropriate authorization, monitoring, and human oversight. * Partner with platform engineering and SRE to make applications observable, performant, resilient, deployable, and supportable in production. * Contribute to integration and migration designs so new capabilities can coexist with legacy systems and customer data can transition safely as releases mature. * Mentor engineers and contractors, review designs and pull requests, resolve complex technical issues, and raise the quality of delivery across the team. * Participate in release readiness, production troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, and continuous improvement of the AI\-enabled software development lifecycle. Comply with applicable ABS security, quality, Health, Safety, and Environmental requirements and other internal policies. * **What You Will Need:** Education and Experience * Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. * Approximately 10\+ years of relevant software engineering experience, including substantial hands\-on delivery of production web or SaaS applications. * Experience serving as a technical lead for a product team or major application area, including design decisions, code review, mentoring, and delivery accountability. * Demonstrated experience building modern user\-facing applications, APIs, and integrations across front\-end and back\-end systems. * Experience deploying and supporting applications in a cloud environment; Azure experience is preferred. * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools in real engineering workflows, with the ability to explain how generated work was reviewed, tested, and maintained. Experience with mobile or intermittent\-connectivity workflows is a plus, particularly for operational or field\-based users. * Technical Skills * UI: Strong TypeScript, HTML, and CSS skills. React is preferred; substantial Svelte/SvelteKit, Vue, or Angular experience is also relevant. * Server: Experience with .NET preferred; strong Go, Python, Node.js or Java API experience is also relevant. * Data and integration: Experience with PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB, or comparable relational/NoSQL stores; familiarity with event\-driven services, Kafka, Redis, or object storage is a plus. * Cloud and identity: Azure and Microsoft Entra ID preferred; equivalent production cloud and enterprise single\-sign\-on experience is welcome. * Engineering delivery: Automated testing, Git\-based collaboration, CI/CD, application observability, secure coding, and containerized deployment. AI: Experience integrating LLM, RAG, or other AI\-enabled services into applications is preferred; ability to use coding agents responsibly and evaluate their output is important. * Knowledge Skills and Abilities * Strong command of full\-stack application design, API contracts, system integration, data access, and maintainable service\-based architecture. * Ability to lead engineers through ambiguity, make pragmatic technical tradeoffs, and align implementation with validated product and UX decisions. * Judgment to use AI for engineering leverage without delegating accountability for design quality, security, testing, or correctness. * Understanding application security, identity and access control, protection of customer data, and reliable operation of production SaaS services. * Ability to work effectively with product, UX, platform, SRE, data, and AI specialists while maintaining clear ownership of application engineering decisions. Strong communication and mentoring skills, including the ability to explain technical risks and options to non\-engineering stakeholders. * **Reporting Relationships** Reports to the designated FMS engineering manager within ABS Group Digital Solutions. The role provides technical leadership to engineers and contractors on assigned product areas; direct\-report responsibilities, if any, will be confirmed as the team scales. **Working Conditions** Work is primarily sedentary; exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects.

These projects, by nature of their complexity and difficulty, require the fully competent application of conventional knowledge in a particular engineering or scientific field. Advises assigned staff in matters related to the application of Rules and Regulations. * Prepares written responses to clients in accordance with established procedures. * Maintains liaison with other engineering specialists internally and externally. * Monitors the performance, development potential, and training needs of engineers assigned. For those with Hull backgrounds * B.S. degree in Civil, Structural Engineering, Naval Architecture, Ocean Engineering, or other related disciplines; an M.S. is preferred * Demonstrated computer literacy in engineering software * Exposed to Finite Element Method (course work or supervised research) * Professional or chartered engineer license * At least ten (10\) years of related engineering experience in a shipyard, design/consulting office, shipping/oil company, or a classification society; or two (2\) years as an Engineer II. For those with Machinery backgrounds * B.S. degree in Marine, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering or other related disciplines * At least ten (10\) years of related engineering experience in a shipyard, design/consulting office, shipping/oil company, or a classification society; or two (2\) years as an Engineer II. * Seagoing engineering license or professional/chartered engineer license. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities * Should have advanced practical industry\-related experience. * Knowledge of related technical disciplines. * Knowledge of applicable Rules and Regulations and the impact of Rule applications and interpretations. * Knowledge of company business policies and procedures. * The human relations skills necessary to maintain positive client contacts and provide leadership and motivation to subordinate staff and peers. * Ability to identify, analyze and solve complex or unique engineering problems. * Ability to undertake short\- and long\-term planning to provide for efficient and effective scheduling of work assignments. * Ability to communicate effectively in English verbally and in writing. * Ability to obtain a working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems. It Would Be Nice If You Had Professional or chartered engineer license. **Reporting Relationships:** The incumbent Generally reports to a Principal Engineer but may report to others depending on the specific of assignment. This position does not have any direct reports.

jobs.title: Automation Engineer II
jobs.description: At Amyris, we value that everyone’s career journey is unique and authentic to who they are. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply and grow alongside us! You may be just the right candidate for this or other open roles. Ready to put your hands\-on laboratory automation experience to work while growing your programming skills? Join Amyris as an **Automation Engineer II** and help scientists work faster and more reliably by supporting, troubleshooting, and improving automated laboratory workflows. You’ll work directly with liquid handlers, laboratory instrumentation, scientists, and experienced automation engineers to develop reliable, high\-throughput workflows—from genetic design through screening and analysis. If you enjoy solving practical hardware and workflow challenges and want to build your scripting and programming capabilities, this is an opportunity to make a visible impact on a production\-scale synthetic biology platform. * ***This is a fully onsite role based in Emeryville, CA.*** **Responsibilities** * **Method \& Workflow Development:** Support the development, modification, testing, and deployment of automated laboratory methods on liquid handlers and other laboratory automation platforms. Execute defined method\-development activities independently and work with more experienced automation engineers on complex or integrated workflows. * **Laboratory Workflow Automation:** Work with automation engineers, scientists, and laboratory users to understand manual laboratory protocols and help translate them into reliable automated workflows using established platforms, standards, and development practices. * **Troubleshooting \& Technical Support:** Provide day\-to\-day support for laboratory automation systems. Troubleshoot routine to moderately complex issues involving instrumentation, automation software, labware, consumables, and liquid\-handling methods. Escalate complex, unfamiliar, or cross\-system issues when additional technical expertise is required. * **Maintenance \& Vendor Coordination:** Support routine instrument maintenance, calibration, equipment qualification activities, and troubleshooting. Coordinate with equipment vendors and service providers as needed under established support processes. * **Documentation:** Develop and maintain method documentation, standard operating procedures, user guides, troubleshooting instructions, and other technical documentation using established team standards. * **Continuous Improvement:** Contribute to identifying operational bottlenecks, recurring automation issues, and opportunities to improve system reliability, assay execution, and automation uptime. Your day to day will include: * Design and build production\-grade ELT pipelines for lab and manufacturing data * Architect secure, reliable data movement between on\-prem systems and AWS * Develop well\-structured, performant warehouse data models for analytics and ML * Write, test, and optimize complex SQL used in production dashboards and workflows * Deploy and manage AWS infrastructure using infrastructure\-as\-code * Implement monitoring, data quality checks, and system observability * Partner closely with scientists and engineers to translate real\-world workflows into reliable data systems **Requirements** * Bachelor’s degree in CS, Engineering, Mathematics, or a scientific discipline * 2\-4\+ years of data engineering experience * Strong Python — able to write clean, modular, well\-tested, production\-ready code * Advanced SQL — comfortable designing schemas, reading query plans, and tuning performance at scale * Experience with data modeling and query optimization in a cloud data warehouse * Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform, CDK, CloudFormation) * Strong software engineering fundamentals (version control/Git, testing, CI/CD) * Ability to operate independently and own data systems end\-to\-end **Nice to Have:** * Experience with manufacturing or industrial data * Scientific background or familiarity with lab\-based research * Experience building data software with Golang * AWS and/or ClickHouse\-specific experience * Experience supporting AI/ML data pipelines **Benefits** * Competitive salary and equity compensation commensurate with experience. Expected salary range for posted level is $116k\-145k * 15 Vacation Days, 10\+ Holidays, Sick time off * Full medical, dental, and vision coverage for team members, 60% coverage for dependents * 401k with match * Paid parental leave with flexible return\-to\-work policy * Diverse and inclusive work environment

jobs.title: Security Audit & Controls, Security GRC
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the team** ------------------ Anthropic's Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) team is the connective tissue that holds the company accountable to its security commitments. We translate regulatory, customer, and voluntary obligations into controls that teams act on, and give leadership a bird's\-eye view of how well we're meeting them. We're building toward a fundamentally different kind of GRC: one that directs Claude, with the right humans in the loop, to challenge and evidence the performance of controls continuously rather than through periodic audits. Within Security GRC, Compliance \& Audit Programs runs the integrated audit across our frameworks and maintains the Common Control Framework, the single set of controls that the whole program is built on. This role sits in Audit \& Assurance and owns the framework and the assurance view across every control domain. **About the role** ------------------ As part of the Security Audit \& Controls team, you will own the CCF across every control domain, from access and change management to logging, encryption, and people controls: which controls we have, what each one says, how each maps to the frameworks and commitments we hold, and whether each one is actually working. You'll work with control owners and GRC Partners to draft and validate control descriptions and activities that describe reality rather than policy intent, build the monitoring that shows operating effectiveness continuously instead of once a year, and drive what monitoring finds to closure with control owners. Building with Claude is a normal part of the job: drafting and mapping controls, testing evidence, and monitoring control health, with you deciding where human judgment stays in the loop. This is an individual contributor role for someone who works well independently, writes clearly, and gets satisfaction from a control set that is accurate, tested, and trusted by auditors and engineers alike. **Key responsibilities** ------------------------ * Own the Common Control Framework: the canonical control set, its mappings to SOC 2, ISO 27001/42001, HIPAA, FedRAMP, and customer commitments, and the change process for adding, retiring, or rewording controls * Draft and validate control descriptions and control activities with control owners, so each control states who does what, how often, in which system, and what evidence proves it * Design and run continuous monitoring of control efficacy: define the metrics and automated tests that show operating effectiveness, tune out false positives, surface failures to owners before an auditor does, and build the controls maturity model that shows where each control domain stands and what it takes to move up a level * **Verify remediation and carry it into steady state:** GRC Partners lead remediation in their domains and control owners implement the fixes. This role advises on control design and implementation, confirms fixes against what the auditor actually asked for, and keeps one source of truth for control and finding status. Once a fix holds, it works with the partner to standardize the evidence pull and, where appropriate, automate it or build continuous * Map new frameworks and commitments onto the CCF as we commit to them, and support gap assessments when a new framework, certification, product, or entity comes into scope, using the CCF as the baseline and writing the requirements for each delta * Support the integrated audit and customer audits: readiness checks, walkthrough preparation, evidence request lists, and the readout of external findings back to GRC * Evaluate evidence reliability, including the completeness and accuracy of system\-generated reports and AI\-generated evidence, and set the standard for what audit\-ready evidence looks like here * Build with Claude: automate control mapping, evidence testing, and monitoring, and verify machine\-drafted control language before it becomes the record **Minimum qualifications** -------------------------- * Several years in IT audit, security compliance, or controls assurance, including hands\-on ownership of a control framework or control library across more than one framework (for example SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, HIPAA) * Working command of audit mechanics: scoping, walkthroughs, sampling, design versus operating effectiveness, deficiency evaluation, and evidence reliability * Experience writing control descriptions, control activities, and test procedures that other teams and external auditors relied on * Experience with continuous controls monitoring or automated evidence collection, whether you built it, ran f diverse perspectives on our team. Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be received on a rolling basis. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $270,000 \- $345,000 USD **Logistics** ------------- **Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. **Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. **How we're different** ----------------------- We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. **Come work with us!** ---------------------- Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Finance Data Engineer
jobs.description: Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming great products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. The Product Marketing Customer Analytics team is seeking a data engineer to support customer analytics with advanced, scalable and robust architecture, tools, data products, and critical data pipelines that are optimized for rapid business intelligence, data analysis, and data science. **Description** * Develop and automate large scale, high\-performance, scalable platform (batch and/or streaming) to drive faster analytics * Ability to design large\-scale, complex applications and frameworks with excellent run\-time characteristics such as low\-latency, fault\-tolerance and availability * Experience in building and maintaining custom frameworks to support engineering/analytics needs * Knowledge of continuous integration, testing methodologies, TDD and agile development methodologies. * Partner with analytic consumers and data scientists to build and improve new/existing constructs and solve data engineering problems @ scale. * Experience in building data pipelines in Spark, Trino, lakehouse or similar distributed platforms \& Snowflake. * Deploy inclusive data quality checks to ensure high quality of data. * Evangelize high quality software engineering practices towards building data infrastructure and pipelines at scale. * Structured thinking with ability to easily break down ambiguous problems and propose impactful solutions. * Applying Generative AI and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques to enhance data analytics capabilities * Communication Strong documentation and technical writing skills. * Attention to detail and effective verbal/written communication skills. **Preferred Qualifications** 5\+ years of experience in data engineering and ETL pipeline development 5\+ years of experience in Big Data Technologies (Spark,Lakehouse,Trino) Experience on Kubernetes, Docker preferred. Familiarity with Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques working in conjunction with LLMs Experience with creating and consuming Model Context Protocol (MCP) services Experience with Snowflake **Minimum Qualifications** 5\+ years of relevant Data Engineering experience Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, MIS, Engineering, Mathematics or other quantitative discipline required. **Pay \& Benefits** At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $149,200 and $249,000, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses \- including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

jobs.description: **HMI Systems Engineer** **\| Fargo, ND** **JOB SUMMARY** --------------- We are seeking a motivated and hardworking individual to join our team in Fargo, ND as a HMI Systems Engineer. You will be part of a group of engineers dedicated to high\-quality work, value\-add solutions, skill development, and career growth. We welcome candidates from the Fargo metro area and beyond to apply. Employees working in Fargo, ND have a short commute from West Fargo, Moorhead, Dilworth, and Horace and will enjoy professional growth and community engagement through our regional presence in Minnesota, Wisconsin, North Dakota and South Dakota. As a **HMI Systems Engineer** you may: * Design, develop, test, and maintain the software, display screens, and communication networks that allow operators to interact safely and efficiently with complex machinery * Combine hardware, software, or mechanical components to ensure all subsystems work together smoothly * Monitor system performance, perform upgrades, manage backups, and troubleshoot failures * Create intuitive graphical user screens, touch controls, alarm management using Java * Connect HMI software with hardware components like PLCs (Programmable Logic Controllers), sensors, data acquisition units, and electronic control units (ECUs) * Configure industrial and vehicle networking protocols * Perform test and analysis as required * Troubleshoot issues and update software * Work collaboratively with suppliers and Applied partners * Contribute to projects that impact communities in West Fargo, Moorhead, Dilworth, and Horace and the greater Fargo metro area * Apply your skills in a dynamic environment that values ownership and innovation **QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------ * Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering required * Experience with Creo required * Proficiency in Java programming language and HMI/SCADA software platforms * Strong understanding of embedded systems, signals, industrial networking, and UI/UX usability principles * Comfortable working in a manufacturing environment * Capable of working independently and as a team member * Strong work ethic and unwavering integrity * Excellent interpersonal skills and a learning mindset * Curiosity, problem solving, and analytical thinking * Effective verbal and written communication * Desire to work on a variety of projects **ESTIMATED PAY RANGE** ----------------------- Engineer I: $34\.62–$40\.38/hour Engineer II: $38\.46–$44\.23/hour Engineer III: $43\.27–$49\.04/hour Senior Engineer: $46\.63–$53\.85/hour Final compensation is based on experience, skills, and alignment with role expectations. Paid overtime may be available. **COMPANY OVERVIEW** -------------------- Applied Engineering is a 100% employee\-owned engineering consulting company dedicated to providing exceptional talent and service to manufacturers across the Midwest and beyond. We have won numerous awards, including Best Place to Work and Top Place to Intern. Innovation, problem solving, integrity, and collaboration are a few things you'll experience and represent while working with Applied. If you appreciate a challenge, variety, and a quicker pace, then we would like to get to know you better. Our unique company culture blends talent, technology, and flexibility. We offer a career trajectory few others can match, with opportunities to take on roles and assignments aligned with your skills and interests. In addition, we offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package including: * Competitive salary * 401K retirement plan * Paid time off and paid holidays * Continuing Education Support * Medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and other insurance options * Paid overtime * Flexible work schedule **ADDITIONAL INFORMATION** Please consider joining Applied's team of talented employees in Fargo, ND and the greater Fargo area. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. We regret that we do not offer sponsorship. jobs.title: Process Engineer Director
jobs.description: **Who We Are** Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next\-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology. **What We Offer** Salary: $185,000\.00 \- $254,000\.00 Location: Santa Clara,CA You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. jobs.title: Firmware Engineer – Hands
jobs.description: Apptronik is a human\-centered robotics company developing AI\-powered robots to support humanity in every facet of life. Our flagship humanoid robot, Apollo, is built to collaborate thoughtfully with people, starting with critical industries such as manufacturing and logistics, with future applications in healthcare, the home, and beyond. We operate at the cutting edge of Applied AI, applying our expertise across the full robotics stack to solve some of society's most important problems. You will join a team dedicated to bringing Apollo to market at scale, tackling the complex challenges like safety, commercialization, and mass production to change the world for the better. **JOB SUMMARY** We are seeking a Firmware Engineer to help develop firmware for the dexterous hands of our humanoid robots. You will collaborate with our existing hands firmware team to implement, test, and debug the embedded software that drives our in\-house hand designs, including motor control, sensor integration, and the real\-time communications that connect the hand to the rest of the robot. You will work closely with mechanical, electrical, and systems engineers as the hand evolves from prototype to production, contribute to hardware bring\-up, and help build out HIL and SIL tests for hand firmware. You will help maintain firmware quality and reliability as we scale from prototypes to fleets of hundreds of hands deployed in the field. As you grow on the team, you will participate in code and design reviews and contribute to our hands firmware stack alongside more experienced engineers, with mentorship and support along the way. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES or KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES** * Collaborate with the hands firmware team to develop, deploy, and maintain firmware for in\-house dexterous hand designs, including motor control, sensor I/O, and real\-time communications. * Work closely with mechanical engineers as the hand design evolves; ensure firmware tracks the mechanical design and exposes the right interfaces for tuning and validation. Contribute to motor control firmware for the small motors that drive the hand, including current control and basic position/torque loops. * Develop firmware for distributed embedded networks that connect multiple MCUs. Help shape and execute the Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HIL) and Software\-in\-the\-Loop (SIL) testing strategy to validate hand performance, safety, and reliability at scale. Help drive firmware quality, reliability, and field performance for fleets of hundreds of hands deployed in production humanoid robots, including telemetry, diagnostics, and root\-cause analysis of field failures. * Work with cross\-functional engineering teams to bring up hand hardware from prototype through production. * Participate in code reviews, design reviews, and pair debugging, learning from and contributing alongside senior engineers. * Contribute to discussions on tooling, processes, and patterns, with guidance from more experienced engineers. **SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience; Master's degree with a focus on controls, motor drives, or embedded systems is especially valued. * 0–2 years of relevant experience developing embedded software, including internships, co\-ops, research, or significant academic or personal projects; recent graduates are encouraged to apply. * Solid working proficiency in C/C\+\+; familiarity with Python, Docker, and Git. Exposure to firmware development for resource\-constrained embedded hardware (limited flash, RAM, and CPU; many peripherals across few MCUs). * Familiarity with real\-time embedded firmware concepts and an eagerness to develop hard real\-time skills. * Familiarity with motor control concepts for BLDC motors (e.g., field\-oriented control, current control, or position control). * Familiarity with distributed embedded networks where multiple MCUs cooperate over real\-time buses. * Exposure to deploying firmware to embedded devices through internships, projects, or coursework. * Strong hardware debugging skills using tools such as oscilloscopes and logic analyzers. Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics (Altium Designer preferred) and hardware datasheets. * Experience with embedded communication protocols such as SPI, UART, RS485, and CAN. * Demonstrated ability to work closely with mechanical engineers on tightly integrated electromechanical assemblies. * Eagerness to learn, take feedback, and grow technically within a collaborative team setting. **EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE** * Experience with humanoid robotics, prosthetics, dexterous manipulation, or other compact electromechanical systems. * Experience with EtherCAT for real\-time embedded communications. * Experience developing in C and C\+\+ for TI C2000 microcontrollers. * Familiarity with safety\-critical embedded system design standards, including MISRA C and ISO 26262\. * Exposure to Agile workflows, including sprint planning, design reviews, and code reviews. * Experience integrating tactile, force, or position sensors into embedded systems. Familiarity with model\-based design tools (e.g., MATLAB/Simulink) for control design and code generation. * Contributions to firmware tooling, build systems, or developer infrastructure. **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:** * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer * Must be able to lift 15 pounds at times * Vision to read printed materials and a computer screen * Hearing and speech to communicate * This is a direct hire. Strong hardware debugging skills using tools such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and JTAG / serial debug. * Ability to read and interpret system schematics and hardware datasheets. Strong collaboration and communication skills, with a desire to grow technical leadership within a team setting. **EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE** * Experience with QNX Neutrino, including SDP, BSP development, and resource managers. Experience with OTA update frameworks (RAUC, SWUpdate, Mender) and fleet provisioning. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Robotic Applications
jobs.description: Atomic Machines is ushering in a new era of micromanufacturing with its Matter Compiler™ technology platform. This platform enables new classes of micromachines to be designed and built by providing manufacturing processes and a materials library that are inaccessible to semiconductor manufacturing methods. It unlocks MEMS manufacturing not only for device classes that could never be produced by semiconductor methods, but also for entirely new categories. Furthermore, this digital platform is fully programmable in the way 3D printing is digital—but whereas 3D printing produces parts of a single material using a single process, the Matter Compiler™ technology platform is a multi\-process, multi\-material system: bits and raw materials go in, and complete, functional micromachines come out. The Atomic Machines team has also created an exciting first device—made possible only through the Matter Compiler™ technology platform—that we will be unveiling to the world soon. Our offices are in Emeryville and Santa Clara, California. ### **About The Role:** Our manufacturing system is composed of nodes; each delivers a unit of manufacturing capacity for a process, and there are a dozen or more node types. As a Software Engineer, Robotic Applications, you will bring nodes to life: designing the automation sequences, state machines, and APIs that turn integrated hardware into reliable, repeatable manufacturing capacity. Your deliverable is software, mainly Python, in the application layers of our stack: the APIs that wrap a node to automate manufacturing processes, the orchestration that sequences motion, vision, and process steps for throughput, and the calibration and diagnostic tooling that lets us replicate nodes and keep them healthy. You will work shoulder to shoulder with mechanical, electrical, and process engineers through bring\-up: one week defining machine behavior with a mechanical designer, the next chasing cycle time out of a motion sequence or root\-causing a failure that crosses the software/hardware boundary. You can try code on the machine in the morning and land it as a tested, typed package through CI in the afternoon. ### **What You'll Do:** * Design and implement machine behavior: automation sequencing, state machines, failure detection and recovery, and the APIs that expose it all. * Write code that makes unsafe commands impossible rather than merely discouraged: enforce invariants, validate before touching hardware, and leave the machine in a known state on every exit path. * Ship a simulator or mock with every device, test sequencing, timing, and recovery without the machine, and extend the conformance suite every machine runs in CI. * Optimize cycle time: instrument sequences, find where time goes, and overlap or restructure motion/vision/process steps to get it back. * Bring up new hardware with cross\-functional teams, and build the calibration, verification, and diagnostic tools that make the next copy of a machine faster to stand up. * Debug across the stack: from a misbehaving sensor or homing failure up through orchestration logic, using logs, telemetry, and the machine itself. * Contribute to system reliability through observability that shows a machine degrading before it stops, fault handling, and graceful recovery, so machines run without babysitting. * Take a turn on the on\-call rotation: periodically a one\-week shift that includes the weekend (about once every 10 weeks; less frequently as the company grows and eventually transitioning to dedicated support teams). Current coverage slots are 6am–2pm or 2pm–10pm, and you will not be expected to work beyond the shift for those days. ### **What You'll Need:** * 3\+ years developing software for systems that interact with hardware or the physical world (level set by experience and interview performance; we hire L3–L5 on this posting). * Depth on something you built: at least one system you can take us two layers down into, what you wrote, why that design, what broke, and how you found it. * Strong programming fundamentals and fluent Python: you will write and debug Python every day, and every coding exercise in our interview is in Python. If your strongest language is something else, you are welcome if you can work in Python live; it does not need to be polished. * A first\-principles mindset: you reason about why a design works, not just how you've seen it done. * Practical understanding of state machines, sequencing, and failure modes in systems where software drives physical hardware: what is legal from the current state, what must still hold when a step fails halfway, and why an operation that may be retried must be safe to repeat. * Systematic debugging habits, starting from the symptom and reaching the mechanism, and the collaboration skills to chase problems across the software/electrical/mechanical boundary. * BS in CS, EE, ME, Mechatronics, Robotics, or equivalent experience. ### **Bonus Points For:** * Experience bringing up and integrating electromechanical systems (sensors, actuators, motion axes) in production environments. * Working fluency in a systems language (C\+\+, Rust, Go); our motion stack is C\+\+ and it helps to read it. * Robotics depth where this job uses it: kinematics, motion planning, vision\-based alignment, calibration (hand\-eye, kinematic, galvo scan\-field), and a track record of landing it in shipped systems. * Experience with hardware\-in\-the\-loop test design, observability, or simulation and digital\-twin validation beyond unit\-level mocks. * Realtime or embedded experience (valuable on adjacent teams; not required here).

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer
jobs.description: At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us. ABOUT THIS ROLE As a Software Development Engineer, it’s up to you to define, design and refine the tech that keeps us one step ahead of listeners. Anticipate. Innovate. Bring challenging ideas and we’ll support you with the latest tech, tools and systems that you need to succeed. You’ll be essential in ensuring the team can reach their potential; working closely with them, reviewing their work, mentoring, and supporting them to develop. Together, you’ll build and maintain our platform to bring thousands of stories to millions of listeners and unleash the power of the human voice. ABOUT THE TEAM Audible's Catalog Management Systems (CMS) team owns the source for all Audible product catalog data. We build the systems that ingest content from publishers, augment and validate it, and publish it to the storefronts and partners where customers discover and access it. Our work spans the full catalog lifecycle, from ONIX and other provider feeds through ingestion and metadata services to pricing, availability, and publishing. A few beliefs guide how we work. Content is Audible's lifeblood, so we keep it flowing smoothly and rapidly, letting customers find and access what they want when they want it. We automate internal processes wherever we can, and involve people when their judgment is needed. We treat content providers as our customers, advocating for them and building tools that improve their experience. And we hold our systems to a clear standard: transparent, easy to learn and use, flexible as business needs change, and scalable as Audible grows. Organized into groups covering ingestion, publishing, operator tooling, and post\-publish refinement, we partner closely with product and downstream teams across Audible to support new products and market expansion. ABOUT YOU You are talented, adaptable, and flexible. We’re looking for creative, open\-minded Software Development Engineers to help build technologies that continuously improve the Audible listening experience. While focusing on iOS development you’ll build and scale mobile software, and coordinate cross\-functionally by integrating new features, maintaining high performance, and creating intuitive interfaces. Our team is working on building native iOS products, without compromising compatibility with various iOS devices in an agile environment. Your primary focus is iOS, and we like for engineers to grow into full\-stack work over time. Backend experience isn’t required—just a willingness to learn and contribute across the stack. As a Software Development Engineer, you will... * Develop, test, and maintain software components and applications for the world's largest audiobook creator and provider * Identify and resolve software defects through code review, log analysis, metrics examination, debugging, and other troubleshooting methods * Write maintainable and scalable code for software components as part of an agile engineering team * Collaborate with stakeholders to envision, design, develop, test, and launch customer\-centric software that inspires and impacts users * Apply computer science, engineering, and analysis principles to solve moderate\-scale problems * Continuously enhance testability, operational excellence (OE), and documentation for owned software components * Handle data classification, storage, and management in accordance with company policies * Participate in the interview process and provide mentorship to fellow engineers ABOUT AUDIBLE Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners’ imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home. Basic Qualifications * Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C\+\+, or C\# including object\-oriented design * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a closely related field * 1\+ years of software development experience Preferred Qualifications * Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers * Knowledge of software engineering best practices across the development life cycle, including agile methodologies, coding standards, code reviews, source management, build processes, testing, and operations * Experience handling ambiguous or undefined challenges through strong problem solving abilities * Experience working in a collaborative team environment to deliver high\-quality design solutions * Experience in building scalable software services (e.g., SOA, Micro\-services) * Basic understanding of security concepts * Capable of using technology to solve straightforward problems * Proficient in a broad range of data structures and algorithms, knowing when it is (and isn’t) appropriate to use them * Experience with Computer Science fundamentals including data structures, algorithms, and problem solving Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign\-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life \& AD\&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits. USA, NJ, Newark \- 121,600\.00 \- 180,600\.00 USD annually

jobs.description: **Job Description** What’s it like to engineer the systems that protect the world? jobs.title: AI Automation Engineer
jobs.description: AI Automation Engineer — Contract · Edison, New Jersey **BluPax Pharma** · Edison, New Jersey · Six\-month contract, with potential to extend **Reports to:** Chief Technology Officer About the role: BluPax is a pharmaceutical distributor. A lot of what keeps the business running is still done by hand — people pulling data out of one system every morning, checking it against another, and re\-entering the result somewhere else. We are building a development team to change that, and this is the role that does it. You would build the automation layer: agents that run on a schedule, connect to the systems we already use, do the work, and escalate only the exceptions that need a person. Not a chatbot. Not a pilot. Software that runs unattended and that people come to rely on. The First Project\- Our compliance team handles controlled substances, and two of their daily processes are the first targets. One is a high\-volume inventory report assembled by hand every morning before the day starts. The other is an order review that checks proposed orders against customer and sales history under federal thresholds — a working prototype exists, and the job is turning it into something that runs unattended in a regulated process. Your job on both is the same: take something that works when a person operates it and make it run on its own, with people looking only at what needs judgement. After compliance, the queue is finance — automated invoice\-to\-receipt matching, and payment processing — and then reporting surfaces for the sales and commercial teams. What you would do\- · Build scheduled, autonomous pipelines: fetch the data, do the work, produce the output, deliver it — without a human starting it · Design the exception path. Clean cases should complete silently; the ones that need attention should reach the right person with the context to act · Connect to the systems we run — our ERP, our data platform, third\-party tools, and web interfaces where no API exists · Build the deterministic guardrails and audit trail underneath all of it — input validation, output checks the model cannot influence, and traceability from any result back to the records and logic version that produced it · Capture user corrections as a feedback signal, so the system’s accuracy is measurable and improves · Work directly with the people whose jobs you are changing, and understand a process properly before automating it · Leave behind something maintainable — documented, in source control, and operable by someone who is not you What we need: Real experience building agent systems that run unattended This is the requirement we cannot flex on. We are not looking for someone who has used AI tools, or built a chat interface over a document set. We are looking for someone who has built **harnesses** — a model with tools, memory and a task loop, running on a schedule, doing work without a person in the conversation. Tell us about one you built and shipped. What it did, what it got wrong, how you found out, and what you changed. We are as interested in the failure handling as in the capability. The discipline that makes a model safe to leave running: Some of what you build here touches federally regulated processes. Getting an answer mostly right is not good enough, and neither is escalating everything and calling it safe. What separates an automation we can trust from a demo is the scaffolding around the model, and we have strong views on it: · **Deterministic checks bracket every model step.** Validate the inputs before the model sees them, and validate the output against rules that do not involve a model. The reasoning sits in the middle, and it never certifies its own work — a verdict on correctness comes from a check the model cannot influence. · **Missing is a failure, not a pass.** An empty result, a partial record, a field that did not populate — these fail loudly. The most expensive bugs in this class of system are the ones where nothing appeared to go wrong. · **Every output traces to the exact inputs that produced it.** When a number is questioned six weeks later, you can show which records, which version of the logic, and which run produced it. · **Confidence thresholds are explicit.** What the system handles alone, what it flags for a person, and what it refuses to decide — decided deliberately and written down, not emergent. You do not need to have used those words. You do need to have learned the lesson some other way, and to recognize why it matters more here than in most places. If your instinct on finding compliance logic in an unversioned script is that it needs fixing before it needs extending, you will do well here. Our stack — ideally you know some of this · **Python or Node** for the pipelines. We are not precious about which · **Agent harnesses** — the orchestration layer around the model, not just the model. Claude Code and similar coding agents, especially used across a team; custom harnesses you have built yourself; anything where you have had to decide what the loop does, where it stops, and what happens when a step fails. **This is the part of the stack we care most about** · **Agent frameworks and tool protocols** — MCP, function calling, whatever you have used to give a model real capability · **Browser automation** — some of what we need to reach has no API · **SQL and analytical databases** — our data platform is ClickHouse · **ERP data** — SAP Business One, though you do not need to have worked in it · **Source control and CI as habits**, not as process imposed on you Nice to have: · Pharmaceutical, medical or another regulated distribution environment · Experience automating finance operations — AP matching, payment processing, reconciliation · Document and data extraction from inconsistent third\-party formats · Having built something that a non\-technical team then used every day without you How we work: Every change is a ticket, with an estimate when we take it on and an actual when it is done. September through November is our busiest period. Product is temperature\-controlled and high value, and mistakes reach patients rather than dashboards. We are careful about what we change and when. You will work directly with the CTO and alongside our SAP developer, compliance, and operations. Small team, no layers, decisions made quickly. We expect you to use AI heavily in your own work. Everyone here does. What success looks like: **First month** — the compliance order review runs on a schedule, in a shared environment, under source control, with logging that lets us see what it did and why. **Third month** — the daily inventory report generates itself. Nobody starts it. The time it used to take is measured, not estimated. **Sixth month** — several automations running in production, a pattern the next person can follow, and documentation good enough that maintenance does not depend on you being available. The engagement · **Six months**, with a review at month four and the option to extend · **Full\-time for the six months**, engaged as an independent contractor (1099, or through your own agency) · **$120–160 per hour**, depending on depth of relevant experience · **Onsite in Edison, New Jersey for the first few weeks**, then flexible, with the expectation that you come in when it helps and are reachable when something you built stops running The first weeks want you here because the processes you are automating live in people’s heads and in their morning routines, and you will not get them from a specification. We would rather commit to a defined piece of work than open a role we are not certain of. If it is working and the work keeps coming, we will talk about what comes next. BluPax Pharma is an equal opportunity employer. Pay: $120\.00 \- $160\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Application Question(s): * Yes or No\- Built a harness\- a model with tools, memory and a task loop, running on a schedule, doing work without a person in the conversation? Education: * Bachelor's (Required) Experience: * Automation Engineer: 3 years (Required) Work Location: In person

That means voice and chat agents that sit on client websites, reporting platforms that pull data from a dozen sources every month, document automation that reads thousands of invoices, and computer vision on cellular cameras in the field. We also sell our own SaaS product. The team is small, so the work you ship is the work clients use. **The role** We're hiring a full\-stack engineer who can take a client's messy problem, turn it into a Laravel app with AI at its core, put it into production, and keep it running. You'll own several client systems at once, from the first architecture sketch to the monthly support call. In your first six months you will likely: * Take over a live property\-marketing reporting platform that pulls from CRMs, analytics, call tracking, and listing sites, then emails branded PDF reports to more than 150 properties every month. * Finish a computer vision system that reads fill levels from cellular cameras through FTP and alerts operations staff. * Improve an invoice\-matching pipeline that uses an LLM to read about 1,500 vendor invoices a month and match them to accounts. * Add features to a production quoting tool for a hurricane\-protection manufacturer. * Clean up and extend an ERP and CRM built on our internal Laravel platform. * Contribute to our voice and chat AI product, which runs on a real\-time speech model through a Node.js WebSocket layer. You'll work daily with AI coding agents, and we expect you to be good at directing them and better at checking what they produce. **What you'll do** * Build features in Laravel, Livewire, and Filament, starting from user stories with clear acceptance criteria. * Integrate LLMs into production workflows: extraction, summaries, retrieval over a knowledge base, and real\-time voice. * Connect outside systems through REST APIs, OAuth, webhooks, FTP, and scrapers for sites that have no API. * Deploy and operate apps on Laravel Cloud and Forge, including queues, scheduled jobs, workers, DNS, internal platform capabilities. * Develop scalable services, orchestration capabilities, and abstraction layers for globally distributed voice systems and network services. * Own technical initiatives from problem definition through design, proof of concept, implementation, testing, deployment, and production readiness. * Design services for scalability, resiliency, fault tolerance, and geo\-redundant global deployments. * Build and maintain well\-defined service contracts and APIs, ensuring reliability, backward compatibility, observability, and clear ownership. * Apply modern software engineering practices, including design patterns, code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, source control, and operational readiness. * Collaborate with Architects, Network Development Engineers, and Software Engineers to translate infrastructure and telecommunications requirements into software\-driven platform capabilities. * Contribute to architecture and system design decisions, presenting technical trade\-offs and recommendations using data, testing, and engineering analysis. * Participate in the 24x7 on\-call rotation supporting critical platform and voice services. **What You Need:** * 6\+ years of experience in software engineering, backend engineering, platform engineering, network development, or related infrastructure engineering disciplines, designing and building production services at scale. * 4\+ years of experience developing backend services, APIs, automation, or platform capabilities using languages such as Python, Go, Java, C\#, or similar, with the ability to work effectively across multiple programming and scripting languages. * Demonstrated experience designing, building, and owning public APIs or high\-use internal APIs, including service contracts, versioning, reliability, observability, and lifecycle management. * Strong experience with backend services, databases, distributed systems, and cloud\-native application architectures. * Strong hands\-on experience with Linux\-based development and production environments, including building, deploying, troubleshooting, and operating backend services. * Hands\-on experience with major cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure, including compute, networking, storage, identity, observability, and managed services. * Experience designing and operating large\-scale distributed systems, including multi\-region or geo\-redundant deployments, high availability, fault tolerance, and horizontal scalability. * Strong understanding of system design and software architecture, including distributed systems patterns, API design, service decomposition, asynchronous processing, caching, resiliency patterns, and data consistency considerations. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, source control, infrastructure automation, and production software delivery practices. * Working knowledge of IP networking and telecommunications concepts, with familiarity with protocols such as SIP and RTP/RTCP and voice infrastructure such as Session Border Controllers (SBCs), proxies, or similar real\-time communication systems. * Ability to independently navigate ambiguous technical problems, develop prototypes and proofs of concept, evaluate trade\-offs, and present complete engineering solutions for review and implementation. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to document technical designs and communicate architecture, trade\-offs, and recommendations to engineering and senior technical stakeholders. * Willingness to participate in a 24x7 on\-call rotation supporting critical platform and voice services. **Bonus Points:** * Experience building internal developer platforms, infrastructure APIs, or network control\-plane services used by multiple engineering teams. * Experience designing globally scalable architectures, distributed orchestration systems, or lifecycle management platforms. * Experience with Infrastructure as Code and orchestration technologies such as Terraform, Ansible, Kubernetes, Helm, or similar platforms. * Background in observability, event\-driven architectures, message queues, streaming platforms, or distributed telemetry systems. **The Whole Person Promise:** At Bandwidth, we're pretty proud of our corporate culture, which is rooted in our "Whole Person Promise." We promise all employees that they can have meaningful work AND a full life, and we provide a work environment geared toward enriching your body, mind, and spirit. How do we do that? Well… * 100% company\-paid Medical, Vision, \& Dental coverage for you and your family with low deductibles and low out\-of\-pocket expenses. * All new hires receive four weeks of PTO. * PTO Embargo. When you take time off (of any kind!) you're embargoed from working. Bandmates and managers are not allowed to interrupt your PTO – not even with email. * Additional PTO can be earned throughout the year through volunteer hours and Bandwidth challenges. * "Mahalo moments" program grants additional time off for life's most important moments like graduations, buying a first home, getting married, wedding anniversaries (every five years), and the birth of a grandchild. * 90\-Minute Workout Lunches and unlimited meetings with our very own nutritionist. Are you excited about the position and its responsibilities, but not sure if you're 100% qualified? Do you feel you can work to help us crush the mission? If you answered 'yes' to both of these questions, we encourage you to apply! You won't want to miss the opportunity to be a part of the BAND. Applicant Privacy Notice

jobs.description: Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. Within DART, the Computer Security Incident Response Team (CSIRT) leads complex investigations and coordinates the response to security incidents across the company. You’ll establish what happened, determine the scope and impact, guide containment and recovery, and keep responders and stakeholders aligned. You’ll be a trusted resource for your peers, contributing technical judgment and direction to complex investigations and helping the team make sound decisions.
