jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Qlik Sense Engineer
jobs.description: The mission of the Engineering Chief Operating Officer (COO) Office is to identify, evaluate, and address strategic challenges and operational risks affecting the Engineering department. The Office formulates and executes targeted interventions to mitigate or resolve these issues, typically necessitating cross\-departmental alignment and engagement with key external stakeholders. To fulfill this mission, we: * Direct and oversee department\-wide programs and projects initiated within Engineering. * Partner with Engineering leadership to architect solutions and cultivate adoption. * Establish governance policies and drive organizational compliance. * Fill gaps in the organization, owning processes that don't fit naturally in an Engineering department or require continuous collaboration across department boundaries We invite applications from highly qualified, innovative, and technically proficient Senior Full\-Stack Qlik Sense Cloud Engineers to architect, design, and scale the portfolio of Engineering COO Qlik Applications. The ideal candidate will possess a strong track record of enhancing enterprise Business Intelligence through the integration of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Natural Language Processing (NLP) technologies to support executive decision\-making. Working closely with Product Owners, you will translate strategic business objectives into robust, scalable technical architectures and deliver comprehensive full\-stack solutions. Key responsibilities include overseeing enterprise data architecture and pipelines (Back\-End) and designing executive\-level analytical interfaces (Front\-End). Furthermore, you will play a critical role in advancing an AI\-ready data infrastructure, establishing resilient data pipelines, and implementing bespoke analytics solutions for senior executive leadership and operational management across the enterprise. **What’s In It For You?** ------------------------- * An opportunity to join a small but highly impactful team supporting the largest department at Bloomberg. * Exposure to an expansive network within Engineering and across countless other business units and departments. * Deploy and maintain tools that are used by technical and business leaders across the firm. **We’ll Trust You To** ---------------------- * **Trusted Advisor:** Partner to a broad array of senior stakeholders with a goal of translating business objectives into intuitive applications that highlight opportunities and accelerate data driven decisions. * **Advanced Visualizations \& Set Analysis:** Engineer sophisticated Set Analysis expressions, dynamic dimensions, bookmarkable states, and custom measures to drive highly interactive, fluid analytical experiences across complex datasets. * **Data Modeling \& Pipelines:** Architect scalable, access controlled, normalized, high quality data architectures, and write robust ETL load scripts connecting to heterogeneous enterprise data sources, including SQL databases, data warehouses, and big data lakes. Implement a semantic data layer and medallionized data framework. * **Leverage Qlik Cloud Exclusive Features:** Accelerate actionable insights that lead to decisions using Qlik Answers (NLP), App Automations, Alerting, and Qlik Predict. * **App Automation \& System Integration:** Design and maintain automated workflows using Qlik Application Automation and REST APIs to orchestrate data reloads, enable write\-back capabilities, and integrate seamlessly with other systems. Support an MCP AI enabled future. * **Performance Optimization \& Governance:** Fine\-tune memory footprints, script execution times, and data refresh cycles for large\-scale applications while implementing granular Row\-Level Security (Section Access), robust data governance, and role\-based user entitlement structures to protect sensitive risk and operational data. **Qualifications** ------------------ ### **You’ll Need to Have:** * **5\+ years** of hands\-on experience developing, architecting, and deploying Qlik Sense Enterprise or Qlik Cloud applications, ETL tools and data pipeline development * Working knowledge of secure Data handling, governance, lineage, and access controls * Advanced SQL skills, dimensional data modeling expertise, and experience crafting complex ETL scripts and data pipelines. Proficiency in advanced Set Analysis, UI/UX best practices, extensions/mashups, Write Tables * Strong written, oral, visual communication skills to partner directly with business and technical stakeholders to translate complex objectives and requirements into scalable analytics solutions. * Project management experience in mapping requirements to tasks and a predictable schedule * Working familiarity with AI Tools such as Claude Code, ChatGPT, and Gemini in daily workflows ### **We’d Love to See:** * Consulting experience with demonstrated success solving diverse analytics challenges across multiple organizations, industries, or functions * **Domain Knowledge in Technology Risk \& Operational Resilience:** * Familiarity with risk, controls, and risk mitigation frameworks. * Understanding of regulatory and compliance frameworks such as **DORA** (Digital Operational Resilience Act), NIST, or ISO 27001\. * Experience building analytics for issue tracking, audit finding, and remediation plans * **Advanced Qlik Cloud \& AI Capabilities:** * Exposure to Qlik Cloud advanced features including Insight Advisor, Qlik Predict (AutoML), and Qlik Answers, MCP Connectors, Extensions. * **Additional BI \& Tech Stack:** * Exposure to other BI environments (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Superset) and enterprise database technologies (e.g., Greenplum, Hive, Snowflake). * Familiarity with web development technologies (HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, React, or Python) for custom Salary Range \= 160,000 \- 220,000 USD Annual \+ Benefits \+ Bonus The referenced salary range is based on the Company's good faith belief at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, work experience, market conditions, education/training and skill level. We offer one of the most comprehensive and generous benefits plans available and offer a range of total rewards that may include merit increases, incentive compensation (exempt roles only), paid holidays, paid time off, medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability benefits, 401(k) \+match, life insurance, and various wellness programs, among others. The Company does not provide benefits directly to contingent workers/contractors and interns. Please tell us if you require a reasonable adjustment/accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable adjustment/accommodation include but are not limited to making a change to the application process or work procedures, providing documents in an alternate format or using specialized equipment. To request an adjustment/accommodation to apply for a job, please email AMER\_recruit@bloomberg.net (Americas), EMEA\_recruit@bloomberg.net (Europe, the Middle East and Africa), or APAC\_recruit@bloomberg.net (Asia\-Pacific), based on the region you are submitting an application for. We may share your information with a third party provider of accommodations services who may use this information to reach out to you for the purposes of accommodating your application. **Equal Opportunity** --------------------- Bloomberg is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination in employment. jobs.title: Junior Full Stack Software Engineer (Hybrid)
jobs.description: At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team. Broadridge is seeking an early\-career Full Stack Developer to help build secure, scalable, and intuitive business applications. This role is ideal for a recent graduate with practical experience in JavaScript, React, Stencil.js, Java, and Spring Boot who is eager to grow in an agile engineering environment. The successful candidate will contribute across the software development lifecycle (SDLC), from requirements refinement and implementation through testing, deployment, and production support. The role requires a practical understanding of artificial intelligence (AI), including how to apply AI responsibly to improve engineering outcomes. Over time, the developer will work productively in a human\-and\-agent delivery model alongside AI agents and engineering teammates **Responsibilities** * Design, develop, test, debug, and maintain full\-stack software features using JavaScript, React, Stencil.js, Java, and Spring Boot. * Build accessible, reusable user\-interface components and integrate them with secure, reliable backend services and APIs * Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. * Translate user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical designs into high\-quality, maintainable code. * Write and maintain unit, integration, and end\-to\-end tests; investigate defects and contribute to continuous quality improvements. * Collaborate with product owners, designers, quality engineers, architects, and senior developers to deliver customer\-focused outcomes. * Follow established engineering standards for source control, peer review, documentation, security, performance, observability, and release management * Support application troubleshooting and production issue resolution, escalating risks and blockers promptly. **AI and Agent\-Enabled Engineering** * Demonstrate a working understanding of generative AI concepts, including prompting, context management, model limitations, hallucinations, bias, privacy, and secure use of AI\-enabled tools. * Use approved AI\-assisted development tools to support research, code generation, test creation, documentation, debugging, and refactoring, while jobs.description: ***Come to a City that Builds Careers! As one of the largest cities in Broward County, the City of Hollywood provides an energetic, innovative and collaborative work environment for its employees. Want Top Notch Insurance? We offer low cost health insurance giving you the best value \- Medical, Dental, Vision and Flexible Spending Plans. Need Work Life Balance? The City of Hollywood provides a generous Paid Time Off Program inclusive of 13 Paid Holidays, Vacation Leave, Personal Leave, and Sick Leave. Repaying Student Loans? Employees at the City with 10 years of public service and on\-time payments qualify for the Federal Student Loan Forgiveness Program. Let’s Partner Together and Come Grow with the City of Hollywood. Apply Now!*** ***For more information about this position and our competitive pay, benefits package and pension plan, refer to this job posting or our City website at*** ***https://www.governmentjobs.com/careers/hollywoodfl*** *.* **JOB SUMMARY:** Under Director of the Public Utilities Manager\-WWTP, this employee is responsible for administration of all instrumentation, computer control and electrical systems for the Department of Public Utilities\-WWTP. This employee supervises subordinate personnel engaged in planning, installing and maintaining the instrumentation, computer control and electrical systems within the water and wastewater treatment facilities, raw water wells, elevated tanks, collection and storm water pumping stations, SCADA system, local and wide area networks. The Instrumentation Control \& Electrical Manager exercises extensive initiative and independent judgment in solving problems as they develop in order to maintain the continuous, effective, efficient, and safe operation of the instrumentation, computer control and electrical systems within the Public Utilities Department. Technical and computer expertise is of prime importance as error in technical judgment could result in extensive damage to the environment, facilities or both. Duties include enforcing safety precautions for employee and operational staff, implementing preventive maintenance programs and estimating cost for instrumentation, computer control and electrical systems projects. Work is performed with wide latitude in the use of independent judgment and selection of work methods and procedures. Work is reviewed through conferences, reports and observation of the operational success of the instrumentation, computer control and electrical systems and achievement of objectives. This is an essential position, which requires incumbents to report to work during catastrophic events. In case of such an event, incumbents maybe required to work 12\-hour shifts, seven days a week to help provide essential services to our customers. **ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Plans and supervises the installation and maintenance of instrumentation, computer control and electrical systems within the Public Utility\-WWTP department; oversees testing of equipment and systems; enforces safety precautions for employees and the public; estimates costs for system projects. * Directs preventive maintenance programs; reviews daily work orders; oversees movable and fixed asset inventory; verifies monthly expense reports; assist in preparation of annual divisional program budgets. * Consults with engineers staff regarding new construction projects; recommends additions and replacements of instrumentation, computer control and electrical systems; maintains service and maintenance records of repairs. * Makes recommendation regarding hiring, discipline and promotion of subordinates; authorizes leaves and overtime; evaluates and rates employee performance. * Insures that the Public Utilities–WWTP department instrumentation, computer control and electrical systems are performing and operating efficiently. * Coordinates the daily operations of the Public Utilities\-WWTP department instrumentation, computer control and electrical systems. Click here to retrieve a copy of the Summary Plan Description (SPD), and call the COHERF Pension Office for more information: 954\-921\-3333\. * The City is a qualifying employer for the Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program. Full\-time service at the City contributes to the 120 months of payment for certain federal student loans to be forgiven. * Supervisory employees, who complete their probationary period and receive “satisfactory” or better Employee Performance Evaluations, shall be eligible to participate in the City Educational Reimbursement Program for job\-related undergraduate and graduate course work. General employees should request approval *prior* to taking any courses. The City pays as follows to a maximum total of $3,000\.00 for tuition annually: Graduate and Undergraduate Benefit Grade of B or better 100% reimbursement at State tuition rates Grade of Pass 100% reimbursement at State tuition rates Grade of C 50% reimbursement at State tuition rates Employees will be eligible to receive 100% reimbursement for books with approval of the City Manager/designee. **Employees who receive benefits under this program, who voluntarily leave the City's employment within two (2\) years of receiving such benefit, shall be responsible for reimbursing the City for the cost of this benefit.** * The City's award\-winning wellness program, Hollywood Wellness, offers opportunities to earn incentives such as gift cards (taxable), gym reimbursements, iWatches, BBQ grills, water tumblers, lunch boxes, duffel bags, and other items for participating in wellness initiatives. Hollywood Wellness is powered by specific funding received by the City’s Third\-Party Administrator, Cigna, to improve the health and well\-being of City employees, and may be discontinued or limited at any time based on availability of funds and discretion of HR Director. jobs.title: Application Security Engineer
jobs.description: **AI Security Engineer / Application Security Engineer** **Location:** Onsite in Seattle, Washington and Sunnyvale, California. Local candidates are required. **Position Type\-** Contract Any Visa Will work Only W2 Pay rate Role Overview We are seeking an experienced **AI Security / Application Security Engineer** to strengthen our security engineering capabilities across application security, cloud services, APIs, and AI/LLM integrations. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience in security architecture reviews, threat modeling, vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, and adversarial testing of AI agents. Key Responsibilities * Conduct **security and privacy design reviews** for applications, APIs, cloud services, engineering proposals, and AI integrations. * Review system architecture, data flows, access controls, trust boundaries, authentication, authorization, and security safeguards. * Perform **threat modeling** for critical services and AI agents, identifying attack surfaces, attack scenarios, attack paths, mitigations, and residual risks. * Conduct hands\-on **security and adversarial testing** of AI/LLM agents, including: * Prompt injection * Tool misuse * Excessive agency * Unauthorized data access * Permission and access\-control issues * External integrations * Sensitive\-data exposure * Identify, validate, and document security vulnerabilities and provide practical remediation recommendations. * Work closely with engineering, security, privacy, and third\-party teams to drive remediation and validate security controls. * Develop reusable security assessment methodologies, checklists, threat models, test cases, and reporting templates. * Support security automation and AI\-assisted security workflows where appropriate. Required Qualifications * **8\+ years of professional experience** in security engineering, application security, product security, offensive security, systems architecture, or a related technical security field. * Experience reviewing complex technical designs and identifying security risks in: * Applications * APIs * Cloud services * Microservices * Distributed systems * Strong understanding of: * Threat modeling * Vulnerability assessment * Risk modeling * Authentication and authorization * Least\-privilege principles * Data protection * Security architecture * Hands\-on experience with security testing, vulnerability investigation, penetration testing, adversarial testing, or security\-control validation. * Strong technical communication skills with the ability to explain security findings to engineering and business stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications * Experience assessing **AI/LLM applications and autonomous AI agents**. * Knowledge of **prompt injection, jailbreaks, unsafe tool use, excessive agency, and AI data\-security risks**. * Experience with privacy and security design reviews. * Experience securing cloud environments. * Security automation experience using **Python, Go, Bash, or similar languages**. * Familiarity with application\-security frameworks and industry security practices. Key Skills **Application Security \| AI/LLM Security \| Threat Modeling \| Penetration Testing \| Adversarial Testing \| Cloud Security \| API Security \| Security Architecture \| Vulnerability Assessment \| Privacy \& Data Protection \| Python/Go/Bash \| Security Automation** Pay: $50\.00 \- $55\.00 per hour Experience: * AI Security Engineer: 10 years (Preferred) * Application Security Engineer: 10 years (Preferred) * cloud services: 10 years (Preferred) * APIs: 10 years (Preferred) * AI/LLM integration: 10 years (Preferred) * Python: 10 years (Preferred) * Go: 10 years (Preferred) * threat modeling: 10 years (Preferred) * vulnerability assessment: 10 years (Preferred) * penetration testing: 10 years (Preferred) * adversarial testing of AI agents: 10 years (Preferred) * security architecture reviews: 10 years (Preferred) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Structural Engineer IV
jobs.description: **Company Description** CRB is a leading provider of sustainable engineering, architecture, construction and consulting solutions to the global life sciences and food and beverage industries. This is a great opportunity for engineers ready to take the next step in their career, with exposure to client\-facing responsibilities and project leadership. Structural Engineers at CRB contribute to a wide range of impactful projects, including projects in Life Sciences \& Pharmaceutical Manufacturing. **Key Responsibilities** * Lead and manage discipline\-specific design scope and budget on small to mid\-sized projects. * Develop construction drawing packages and specifications with minimal oversight. * Conduct and lead field surveys, site walks, and construction field reporting. * Identify and document non\-compliant existing conditions during site visits. * Interface with clients, architects, engineers, subcontractors, and vendors. * Support proposal development and contribute to internal training presentations. * Lead squad checks and discipline reviews to ensure design quality. * Mentor Engineer I and Designer I/II team members. * Assist in system design programming and master planning with senior support. **Qualifications** * ABET\-accredited Bachelor’s degree in discipline\-specific field * Minimum of 10 years of experience for Lead position, preferably in a design firm setting * Proficiency in structural\-specific software * Advanced experience with performing engineering calculations, and developing and implementing list of discipline systems designs * Advanced experience with the structural material codes * Intermediate experience with other applicable industry standards * Intermediate experience with applicable building codes * Proficient at advanced internal and external cross\-discipline project team coordination * Proficient at coordinating with construction trade partners, vendors and manufacturers * discipline design and engineering training presentations * Experience with troubleshooting issues with discipline and systems **Additional Information** All your information will be kept confidential jobs.title: Senior Production Engineer, Managed Cloud
jobs.description: Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI. We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services. If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe. **About the Role** At Crusoe, our Production Engineering team ensures the reliability and scalability of Crusoe’s AI\-optimized cloud platform. We’re looking for a Senior Production Engineer with a strong background in distributed systems and cloud services to help us build and deliver a seamless Cloud experience at scale. This role is central to delivering highly available, performant, and cost\-efficient AI infrastructure that powers compute\-intensive, latency\-sensitive workloads for our customers. **What You'll Be Working On** * Design and operate reliable managed AI services with a focus on serving and scaling LLM workloads * Define, measure, and improve SLIs/SLOs across to ensure performance and reliability targets are met * Collaborate with AI, platform, and infrastructure teams to optimize large\-scale training and inference clusters * Automate observability by building telemetry and performance tuning strategies for latency\-sensitive services * Investigate and resolve reliability issues in distributed AI systems using telemetry, logs, and profiling * Contribute to the architecture of next\-generation distributed systems purpose\-built for AI\-first environments **What You'll Bring to the Team** * Strong software engineering background — experience building production\-grade systems beyond scripting or Bash * Demonstrated experience in distributed systems design and implementation * SRE mindset and experience (whether or not under the SRE title) including: + Defining and measuring SLIs/SLOs + Building monitoring and observability systems + Driving performance and reliability improvements + Designing fault\-tolerant systems and automated testing strategies * Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (Python, Go, Java, C\+\+) * Familiarity with Kubernetes or container orchestration platforms * Strong collaboration and communication skills * Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, mission\-driven environment **Benefits** * Industry competitive pay * Restricted Stock Units in a fast growing, well\-funded technology company * Health insurance package options that include HDHP and PPO, vision, and dental for you and your dependents * Employer contributions to HSA accounts * Paid Parental Leave * Paid life insurance, short\-term and long\-term disability * Teladoc * 401(k) with a 100% match up to 4% of salary * Generous paid time off and holiday schedule * Cell phone reimbursement * Tuition reimbursement * Subscription to the Calm app * MetLife Legal * Company paid commuter benefit; $300 per month **Compensation** Compensation will be paid in the range of $170,000 to $205,000\. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.title: Senior Development Engineer I - CAP UI
jobs.description: We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time. **POSITION SUMMARY** The CVS Digital \- Developer Experience team is on a mission to build an enterprise software deployment platform, CVS Application Platform (CAP), that will transform how developers deploy applications at scale for CVS Digital application teams. We are a team of engineers and engineering leader's laser\-focused on delivering exceptional self\-service experiences to our developers who are writing critical guest\-facing digital applications to help people on their path to better health. We are looking for engineers and engineering leaders across all levels and skillsets that are passionate about delivering highly scalable, reliable and secure platforms that make deploying software incredibly easy. *About the Role* Digital Senior Development Engineer I \- CAP UI is a hands\-on software engineering role that will be using their software development experience to build various services for CAP. As a Digital Senior Development Engineer I \- CAP UI you will be working with a team of experienced engineers to design, code, test, and debug software applications that power critical experiences for both internal and external customers using CAP. What We Expect of You * Self\-starter who can see the big picture and prioritize their work to make the largest impact on the business and customers vision and requirements. * Collaborate with other engineers and stakeholders to define, design, and implement software features and functionality. * A commitment and drive for quality, technical excellence, and results. We like pushing code to production! * Perform unit testing and integration testing to ensure code quality and reliability. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams as necessary to deliver high value work for the organization. * Be a daily advocate for and implement security best practices. * Participate in on\-call rotations providing exceptional service to our customers. * Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** * 3\+ years of experience exhibiting deep expertise in one or more programing languages such as TypeScript, JavaScript, React. * 3\+ years of full software development life cycle including ideation, coding, coding standards, testing, code reviews and production deployments. * 3\+ years of experience with modern software development practices like CI/CD and collaborative coding tools like GitHub, GitLab, etc. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Familiarity with containerization technologies like Docker and container orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes. * Have a strong desire to see others succeed by mentoring and coaching other engineers through pair programing. * Ability to learn quickly and adapt to change requirements. * Strong understanding of observability and using telemetry to inform decision making. * Experience working in a Scrum/Agile development methodology. * Ability to work independently and part of a team. **EDUCATION** Bachelor’s degree from accredited University or equivalent work experience * **BUSINESS OVERVIEW** Bring your heart to CVS Health Every one of us at CVS Health shares a single, clear purpose: Bringing our heart to every moment of your health. This purpose guides our commitment to deliver enhanced human\-centric health care for a rapidly changing world. Anchored in our brand — with heart at its center — our purpose sends a personal message that how we deliver our services is just as important as what we deliver. Our Heart At Work Behaviors™ support this purpose. We want everyone who works at CVS Health to feel empowered by the role they play in transforming our culture and accelerating our ability to innovate and deliver solutions to make health care more personal, convenient and affordable. We strive to promote and sustain a culture of diversity, inclusion and belonging every day. CVS Health is an affirmative action employer, and is an equal opportunity employer, as are the physician\-owned businesses for which CVS Health provides management services. We do not discriminate in recruiting, hiring, promotion, or any other personnel action based on race, ethnicity, color, national origin, sex/gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We proudly support and encourage people with military experience (active, veterans, reservists and National Guard) as well as military spouses to apply for CVS Health job opportunities. **Anticipated Weekly Hours** 40**Time Type** Full time**Pay Range** The typical pay range for this role is: $92,700\.00 \- $203,940\.00 This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full\-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short\-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above. Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong. **Great benefits for great people** We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families. This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility. Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments. We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 10/30/2026 Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description: **SUMMARY OF POSITION** Canon Medical Research USA, Inc. (CMRU) is seeking a **Software Engineer** to join our High Performance Computing team, developing image\-processing software for large medical devices, from requirements through production. This role is well suited to a recent graduate with a strong mathematical and systems foundation who is looking to apply coursework in linear algebra, numerical methods, and operating systems to real\-time image reconstruction and signal\-processing algorithms running on production hardware. You will work through the full software lifecycle: analyzing requirements, designing solutions, implementing and unit\-testing code, and documenting your work to a standard suitable for a regulated medical device environment. **RESPONSIBILITIES*** Analyze software requirements documentation and consult with the requirements author as needed. * Formulate a software design using industry best practices and document it appropriately. * Implement the software design in C/C\+\+. * Design and execute unit test plans to verify coded software. * Contribute to image reconstruction and scientific/mathematical algorithm implementation, including performance optimization. * Coordinate communication with vendors related to project materials. * Contribute to the creation of software requirements and specifications. * Contribute to the corporate IP portfolio. **QUALIFICATIONS** ***Education**** B.S. or M.S. degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or Electrical Engineering from an accredited institution. ***Experience**** Entry\-level: 0\-2 years of professional experience. New graduates are encouraged to apply. * Strong academic background in applied mathematics is required; linear algebra and numerical methods coursework or project work is required. ### **TECHNICAL BACKROUND** Candidates should have coursework, internship, or project experience (academic or personal) in most of the following: * **Computer architecture:** memory hierarchy, cache behavior, instruction pipelines, and how they affect software performance. * **Operating systems / systems programming:** processes, threads, scheduling, synchronization primitives; direct experience with a preemptive multitasking RTOS is a plus. * **Multi\-threaded / parallel programming:** experience writing correct, race\-free concurrent code; exposure to multi\-processing or parallel algorithm design. * **C/C\+\+:** solid fundamentals; comfort with memory management and low\-level debugging. * **Numerical methods and linear algebra:** ability to translate mathematical algorithms into efficient, numerically sound code. * **Image processing** and/or **GPU programming** experience is a plus (CUDA, OpenCL, or similar). * Familiarity with version control, defect tracking tools, and peer code review is a plus. ### **Key Competencies** * Strong analytical problem\-solving skills, particularly with mathematically dense algorithms. * Initiative and solution orientation; comfortable working through ambiguity. * Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to document design decisions. * Effective relationship building across a cross\-functional engineering team. * Sound time and task management. ***Time and Location Commitment**** This position is regular, full\-time and requires a commitment of 37\.5 hours per week, Monday\-Friday, during regular business hours. * This position is based in CMRU’s office in Vernon Hills, IL. + A hybrid work schedule will allow the ideal candidate the flexibility to work from home on some days and from the office on other days, but the candidate must be able to come on\-site daily based on the needs of the projects and business requirements. **WHY JOIN CMRU?** www.research.us.medical.canon **Canon****Medical****Research** **USA,****Inc.**(CMRU) is a multi\-modality R\&D organization creating next\-generation medical imaging systems. It is equipped with cutting\-edge instrumentation, prototyping, hardware labs and scientific computing facilities to perform research targeted to pre\-clinical and clinical CT, PET, MRI, Ultrasound, and X\-ray systems. For those who like to develop new technologies and research new ways of using them, Canon is a rewarding place to work. At CMRU, you will have the opportunity to contribute to innovative medical imaging research while being part of a collaborative, mission\-driven culture. Our team operates in a flexible hybrid working environment. CMRU offers comprehensive and competitive medical, dental and vision benefits. Additionally, our employees enjoy: * CMRU funded HRA or HSA * 401(k)/Roth/Employer Match/Profit Sharing * Disability and Life Insurance * Generous Paid Time Off and 14 Holidays **Compensation** This compensation information is a good faith estimate and provided in accordance with state law. The base salary for this role generally ranges between $96,796 \- $118,306 annually. This range is an estimate based on an applicant's skills, experience, training, and other business and organization needs. **Our Way: Values in Action** Unity \| Courage \| Teamwork \| Tenacity \| Excellence A vibrant organization is united behind a common vision, sharing common goals.

The magic we’ve created lies in Carbon Health’s custom EHR and the collaboration among clinical teams, engineers, and designers who work side\-by\-side to deliver innovation like our hands free AI charting tool. That’s why we hire people who genuinely care about patients, solving healthcare challenges, and making a positive impact every day. Join us and help change the future of healthcare for the better. **About The Role** As a Full Time Medical Assistant (MA) in our Medical Assistant department, you will play a key role in supporting providers and ensuring a smooth, efficient patient experience. This hourly, full\-time position combines hands\-on clinical responsibilities with essential administrative duties, requiring strong attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and a commitment to high\-quality, patient\-centered care. You will work closely with physicians, nurses, and other care team members to prepare patients for visits, assist with procedures, and maintain accurate medical records in a fast\-paced clinical environment. **What You'll Do** * Greet and prepare patients for examinations, including verifying information, obtaining vital signs, and documenting chief complaints * Assist providers with examinations, treatments, and minor office procedures while maintaining patient comfort and safety * Accurately document patient history, medications, allergies, and other relevant clinical information in the electronic medical record (EMR) * Perform basic clinical tasks such as phlebotomy, injections, specimen collection, and point\-of\-care testing in accordance with training and protocols * Ensure exam rooms are clean, stocked, and properly set up before and after patient visits * Coordinate patient flow to optimize provider schedules and minimize wait times * Communicate test results and provider instructions to patients as directed, ensuring understanding and appropriate follow\-up * Schedule appointments, manage referrals, and assist with prior authorizations as needed * Handle phone calls, messages, and patient inquiries in a professional and timely manner * Follow infection control, safety, and quality standards, including proper handling and disposal of biohazard materials * Maintain accurate logs, documentation, and inventory of clinical supplies and equipment * Collaborate with the clinical team to support quality improvement initiatives and a positive patient experience **Qualifications** * High school diploma or equivalent required * Completion of an accredited Medical Assistant program strongly preferred * Current Medical Assistant certification/registration (e.g., CMA, RMA, CCMA, NCMA) preferred or willingness to obtain within a specified timeframe * Current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification or ability to obtain prior to start date * Previous experience as a Medical Assistant in an outpatient or clinical setting preferred * Proficiency with electronic medical records (EMR) systems and basic computer skills * Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact professionally with patients, families, and staff * Demonstrated ability to work in a fast\-paced environment, manage multiple tasks, and prioritize effectively * Attention to detail and accuracy in clinical documentation and administrative tasks * Knowledge of basic medical terminology, vital signs, and standard clinical procedures * Commitment to maintaining patient confidentiality and complying with HIPAA and organizational policies * Ability to stand, walk, and perform clinical duties for extended periods, and lift or move patients and equipment as required by the role * Fluency in English, with clear verbal and written communication skills

jobs.title: Sr. AI Product Engineer
jobs.description: **About Cardiff** ----------------- Cardiff lends to small businesses. Since 2004 we've funded more than $12 billion across the country, to businesses in logistics, healthcare, construction, professional services, and plenty in between. We're building our own underwriting technology, and we still answer the phone; our customers need capital fast, and they want a straight answer from a person who can actually help. **Location:** Remote (U.S.)**Employment Type:** Full\-time**Department:** Engineering Role Overview This senior individual contributor will turn AI\-built prototypes into reliable software that Cardiff’s teams use every day. Working directly with the Managing Partner and business owners across sales, operations, underwriting, and marketing, this person will define the initial scope, build and deploy solutions, and support them in production. The initial focus will be the Managing Partner’s existing prototypes, including lender routing, sales calculators, decisioning workflows, and agents that reduce manual work. These projects support Cardiff’s goal of reducing application\-to\-funding turnaround from 24 business hours to minutes. The role has no people\-management responsibilities. Over time, it may transition into a dedicated AI engineering role within one of Cardiff’s business teams. What you will own * **Prototype assessment:** Review each prototype and document whether it should move forward, be revised, or be discontinued. * **Production development:** Build the data models, APIs, integrations, error handling, tests, and deployment processes needed to make each solution reliable. * **Release controls:** Establish automated testing, secret scanning, and code and dependency checks for the Managing Partner’s projects, aligned with engineering’s production approval process. * **System integrations:** Connect Cardiff’s systems with external lenders and vendors and standardize inconsistent data. * **Ongoing reliability:** Monitor, maintain, and improve deployed systems, including resolving incidents and documenting corrective actions. * **Project communication:** Provide clear written updates, flag blockers promptly, and coordinate scope and acceptance with each business owner. What Success Looks Like **First 30 days** * Release controls are operating and blocking releases that fail required checks. * The prototype portfolio has been reviewed, with a documented recommendation and production requirements for each project. **First 90 days** * Two prototypes are live in production, have business\-owner sign\-off, and are actively being used. * Decisions to discontinue any unsuitable prototypes are documented. * Each live system has a clear record of remaining risks and follow\-up work. **First six months** * A consistent delivery rhythm moves suitable prototypes into production within weeks. * Deployed systems operate reliably, supported by monitoring and clear ownership. * Completed projects demonstrate measurable improvements in processing efficiency and time to funding. What We’re Looking For * Seven or more years of software development experience, with recent hands\-on ownership of systems delivered to real users. * Strong production engineering judgment across testing, security, reliability, monitoring, and incident response. * Proficiency in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, SQL, REST APIs, and cloud deployment, preferably AWS. * Experience integrating external systems and translating inconsistent inputs into clean, usable data models. * AI development as a core working practice, including coding tools, LLM APIs, agents, and evaluations, with careful review of generated code. * Ability to assess existing code, determine what to retain or rebuild, and deliver practical solutions quickly. * Comfort working directly with the Managing Partner and nontechnical stakeholders, with clear communication and accountability. jobs.title: Data Scientist II
jobs.description: CareDx is a leading precision medicine diagnostics company advancing care in transplant, specialty oncology, and cell therapy. Through our innovative portfolio of molecular diagnostics, digital health solutions, AI\-powered data and analytics, and patient support services, we partner with healthcare providers, patients, and biopharma organizations to help inform clinical decision\-making and improve patient outcomes. At CareDx, every employee has the opportunity to contribute to innovations that help transform patient care and improve lives. The Data Scientist II will develop clinically grounded, interpretable AI and analytics solutions that support commercial, medical affairs, clinical research, and enterprise decision\-making. The role will translate integrated structured and unstructured data into reliable insights, actionable recommendations, and reusable analytical products. This role combines applied data science, statistical modeling, machine learning, generative AI, and research collaboration. The Data Scientist II will own defined workstreams from problem framing and research design through modeling, validation, documentation, deployment support, and stakeholder communication. Success requires strong quantitative judgment, reproducible development practices, and the ability to communicate methods, limitations, and recommendations clearly to technical, scientific, clinical, and business stakeholders. **Responsibilities** * Own analytics and AI workstreams for next\-best\-action and field education capabilities, translating integrated data into actionable recommendations. * Advance literature intelligence workflows, including search, retrieval, synthesis, evaluation, and validation of AI\-generated outputs. * Develop interpretable machine learning, statistical, and generative AI solutions using structured and unstructured clinical, laboratory, commercial, and enterprise data. * Build reproducible workflows and reusable components that can progress from research prototypes to reliable applications and decision\-support tools. * Lead analytics research proposals and collaborations, including cohort definition, analysis planning, modeling, interpretation, and communication of results. * Partner with clinicians, scientists, medical affairs, research teams, and business stakeholders to translate questions into rigorous analytical plans and defensible results. * Support abstracts, presentations, and research reports while applying appropriate privacy, security, validation, and documentation practices. * Contribute to and provide backup support for forecasting, Promotion Effectiveness, and Digital Product Impact initiatives. * Perform exploratory analysis, feature engineering, model development and evaluation, sensitivity testing, and scenario analysis using Python or R and SQL. * Collaborate with data and application engineers on pipelines, version control, testing, deployment readiness, monitoring, and maintenance; clearly document data lineage, assumptions, limitations, and recommendations. **Qualifications** * Bachelor of Science (BS) or Master of Science (MS) degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Biostatistics, Bioinformatics, or a related quantitative field. * 5\+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, advanced analytics, AI engineering, or a related role, including 3\+ years in healthcare, diagnostics, biotechnology, clinical research, life sciences, or another regulated environment. * Strong hands\-on proficiency in Python or R, SQL, and Git\-based development workflows. * Experience developing and validating predictive, descriptive, statistical, or machine learning models using real\-world clinical, EHR, laboratory, research, or other complex longitudinal data. * Ability to produce audit\-ready documentation covering data lineage, methods, assumptions, testing, validation, and model limitations. * Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate across technical, scientific, clinical, and business teams. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with AI\-enabled search, natural language processing, literature intelligence, retrieval\-augmented generation, or document synthesis. * Experience moving analytical prototypes into user\-facing or production workflows, including testing, monitoring, and ongoing support. * Familiarity with Databricks, cloud data platforms, model lifecycle management, and modern analytics application frameworks. * Experience contributing to clinical research deliverables such as protocols, abstracts, presentations, manuscripts, or analytical reports. **How We Work** * Curiosity: Start with Why + We understand why a project matters, what problem we are solving, whom it helps, and what success looks like. We ask thoughtful questions, align early, and move forward with confidence. * Accountability: Extreme Ownership + We take responsibility for what we build and deliver. We communicate risks early, follow through on commitments, and help resolve problems rather than waiting for detailed direction. * Transparency: Default to Share + We proactively share context, decisions, progress, and lessons learned. We document and demonstrate our work so others can build on it. * Empowerment: Amplify Others + We succeed as a team. We collaborate openly, recognize the contributions of others, and give credit generously. * Resilience: Learn Loudly + We treat mistakes and unexpected outcomes as opportunities to improve. We focus on solutions, identify root causes, and share what we learn. **Additional Details:** Every individual at CareDx has a direct impact on our collective mission to improve the lives of organ transplant patients worldwide. We believe in taking great care of our people, so they take even greater care of our patients. Our competitive Total Rewards package for US Employees includes: * Competitive base salary and incentive compensation * Health and welfare benefits, including a gym reimbursement program * 401(k) savings plan match * Employee Stock Purchase Plan * Pre\-tax commuter benefits * And more! * Please refer to our page to view detailed benefits at https://caredx.com/company/careers In addition, we have a Living Donor Employee Recovery Policy that allows up to 30 days of paid leave annually to a full\-time employee who makes the selfless act of donating an organ or bone marrow. With products that are making a difference in the lives of transplant patients today and a promising pipeline for the future, it's an exciting time to be part of the CareDx team. Join us in partnering with transplant patients to transform our future together. **CareDx, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer\-vets/disabled, and participates in the E\-Verify program.** **By proceeding with our application and submitting your information, you acknowledge that you have read our** **U.S. Personnel Privacy Notice****and consent to receive email communication from CareDx.** **Certain jurisdictions require notice of how we use and protect your personal information. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: At Casey's, every event generates data: a pizza delivery, filling up a gas tank, a truck pulling into the lot, pouring a cup of coffee. Our team partners with departments across Casey's to make sense of data and provide direction to decision makers. To enable our strategy, we utilize cutting edge technology tools for data collection, transformation, and analysis. Are you driven to wrangle, cleanse, and transform data? Do you want to partner with leaders to make data\-driven decisions? Does diving into a wide variety of data to extract insights excite you? We're looking for innovators who can take an idea from the whiteboard to the boardroom. If that's you, let's talk. The Senior Data Engineer role will be responsible for developing data ingestion and transformation frameworks, data modeling for analytics, developing data pipelines, CI/CD, data platform performance/cost optimization, and helping enhance our data platform architecture. This is a collaborative role, where you will work closely with other members of the Data Engineering, Analytics, and Technology teams to solve challenging data problems with cloud technology. The primary technologies utilized in this role include: Databricks (Python, PySpark, SQL) and Anomalo. **Key Responsibilities:** * Leads complex data engineering initiatives, actively participating in requirements gathering and continuously refining technical solutions as business needs evolve. * Mentors other engineers on software/data engineering best practices, data modeling, and pipeline development. * Experience using AI to accelerate data engineering practices and enforce standards. * Performs thorough testing of data pipelines and data models to ensure data is accurate and pipelines are resilient and self\-healing. * Evaluates source data systems and understands how to extract and model data for analytics and operational use cases. * Ingests data from API, streaming, event, and batch source systems. * Evaluates the technology landscape and makes recommendations for continuous improvement of the data platform. * Provides support for the data platform as part of an on\-call rotation. * Builds, maintains, and troubleshoots CI/CD pipelines in GitHub. * Acts as the primary point of escalation for the Data Engineering team to troubleshoot data and platform issues. **Compensation**: Starting pay range:‏‏‎ ‎$102,200\-140,500\.‏‏‎ ‎ Actual pay may vary based on Casey's assessment of the candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities (KSAs), related experience, education, and qualifications. Our full salary range for this role does extend beyond the typical hiring range listed, allowing team members the opportunity to continue to grow within the company. Requirements: * This position **requires** authorization to work in the U.S. without the need for employment\-based immigration sponsorship now or in the future. **Casey's will not provide sponsorship or employer support** for applications or petitions for F\-1 OPT, F\-1 CPT, H\-1B, L\-1, TN, O\-1, E\-3, H\-1B1, J\-1, or any other employment\-based visa. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent years of related work experience. * At least five (5\) years of experience designing and developing enterprise data solutions and integrations, ETL, data warehousing, data modeling (star schema, etc.). * Strong proficiency in Python, PySpark and SQL. * Experience with Databricks, Snowflake, or other modern data platform. * Comfort with a variety of data sources including APIs, streams, events, databases, files, etc. * Hands\-on experience with Azure, including ADLS Gen2, Data Factory, Key Vault, and Function Apps (or other equivalent cloud technology). * Experience implementing CI/CD and automated testing for a data team. * Familiarity with data governance concepts: data cataloging, tagging, handling sensitive data. * Prior experience in Software Engineering is a plus. This role **does not** allow for 100% remote work. Qualified candidates must live within a daily commutable distance of Casey's Store Support Center in Ankeny, IA and be willing to work **onsite** 5 days per week.

jobs.title: Coherent DSP Applications Engineer
jobs.description: Principal Applications Engineer Irvine, CA or San Jose, CA About the Role Celero is seeking a hands\-on, highly motivated Coherent DSP Applications Engineer to help bring next\-generation coherent optical DSP solutions from the lab to customer deployment. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast\-paced startup environment, enjoys solving complex technical challenges, and wants to make a direct impact on both products and customers. As a key member of the team, you will work closely with DSP, ASIC, hardware, firmware, and product engineering teams, while partnering directly with hyperscale customers and strategic partners to integrate, validate, debug, and optimize coherent DSP\-based optical solutions. This position offers a unique opportunity to influence product direction, contribute to customer success, and help shape the future of high\-speed optical connectivity for AI infrastructure and cloud networking. What You'll Do Customer Integration and Technical Leadership * Serve as the technical owner for customer integration and deployment of coherent DSP\-based optical modules and systems. * Work directly with hyperscalers, network equipment manufacturers (NEMs), and strategic partners to support: * System design and architecture discussions * Platform integration and bring\-up * Interoperability and qualification testing * Field trials and early customer deployments * Configure, tune, and optimize coherent DSP parameters to maximize performance and reliability. Debug and System Validation * Troubleshoot complex issues spanning multiple disciplines, including: * DSP algorithms and signal processing * Optical impairments, including chromatic dispersion (CD) and differential group delay (DGD) * Host electrical interfaces, including 200G/400G/800G PAM4 and beyond * Module management and control interfaces, including CMIS and telemetry * Analyze system performance metrics, including BER, Q\-factor, SNR, and debug logs, and drive issues to root cause. * Support interoperability testing in multi\-vendor environments. Cross\-Functional Collaboration * Partner closely with DSP, ASIC, hardware, firmware, and systems engineering teams to resolve issues and improve product performance. * Contribute to technical documentation, application notes, validation reports, and customer\-facing materials. * Provide direct feedback to engineering and product teams on feature prioritization, product requirements, and roadmap decisions. What You Bring * Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, Optical Engineering or Applied Physics Related technical discipline * 8\+ years of experience" and "ability to travel up to 25–40% to customer sites as needed * Strong fundamentals in digital signal processing, telecommunications theory, and optical communications. Hands\-on experience with: * Coherent modulation techniques, including QPSK and 16\-QAM * Forward Error Correction (FEC) and framers * DWDM optical systems and coherent transceivers * Experience debugging complex hardware and software interactions in a laboratory environment. * Ability to independently solve ambiguous, cross\-functional technical problems. * Ability to generate technical documentation, such as Applications notes, Data sheets, Product requirement Documents, etc. * Excellent communication skills and the ability to work directly with customers and internal engineering teams. Preferred Qualifications * Experience supporting coherent optical module products, including: * 400ZR * 800ZR * Coherent Lite * Familiarity with QSFP\-DD and OSFP coherent modules. * Knowledge of high\-speed host electrical interfaces, including CEI\-112G, PAM4, and next\-generation standards. * Experience using Python, MATLAB, or similar tools for analysis, automation, and data processing. * Experience working with hyperscalers, network equipment manufacturers (NEMs), or cloud infrastructure providers. * Exposure to open networking environments and multi\-vendor interoperability testing. How You'll Succeed * You are comfortable working in ambiguous environments and can make progress without perfect specifications. * You take ownership and drive issues to resolution from initial discovery through deployment. * You communicate complex technical concepts clearly to customers, partners, and internal stakeholders. * You enjoy learning quickly and contributing beyond a narrowly defined role. * You are excited to help shape not only a product, but also a company and its culture. Why Join Celero? * Work on cutting\-edge coherent DSP technology powering next\-generation AI infrastructure and optical networking. * Make a direct impact on product direction and customer success. * Collaborate with a small, highly experienced engineering team. * Gain exposure across DSP, optics, ASICs, firmware, systems, and customer applications. * Grow your career quickly in a dynamic startup environment with significant opportunities for leadership and ownership. Annual Base Salary Range: $175,000 \- $225,000 (The final offer will be determined based on job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, and location.)

jobs.title: Design Validation & Test (DVT) Engineer (multiple roles/openings)
jobs.description: Junior / Senior / Principal Design Validation \& Test (DVT) Engineer roles Irvine, CA About The Role Celero is seeking an experienced Principal Design Validation \& Test (DVT) Engineer to lead post\-silicon validation for next\-generation coherent DSP ASICs powering AI and hyperscale optical networking. As a key member of our engineering team, you will play a critical role in enabling first silicon, driving silicon characterization, and ensuring product readiness for customer deployment and high\-volume production. This is a highly visible technical leadership role within a fast\-paced startup where you will work closely with Architecture, RTL Design, Firmware, Systems, Product Engineering, and customers to solve complex silicon challenges. You will have the opportunity to influence validation strategy, define best practices, and help build our validation infrastructure from the ground up. What You'll Do * Lead post\-silicon validation and characterization of complex ASICs and SoCs from first silicon through production release. * Develop comprehensive validation plans covering functionality, performance, interoperability, compliance, stress testing, corner cases, and reliability. * Enable first silicon bring\-up using JTAG, scan, embedded debug features, and board\-level diagnostics. * Validate high\-speed interfaces including PCIe, Ethernet, SerDes, CXL, SPI, I²C, MDIO, and other industry\-standard protocols. * Utilize advanced lab equipment including high\-bandwidth oscilloscopes, BERTs, protocol analyzers, Ethernet traffic generators, network analyzers, logic analyzers, and power measurement equipment. * Debug complex hardware, firmware, RTL, and system\-level issues while working closely with cross\-functional engineering teams to identify root cause and drive timely resolution. * Develop scalable Python\-based automation frameworks for test execution, regression, silicon characterization, data analysis, and reporting. * Validate firmware, bootloaders, device drivers, and hardware/software interfaces across multiple platforms. * Characterize silicon performance, power, thermal behavior, margins, and compliance against architectural specifications. * Lead debug reviews and provide technical direction for validation methodology, infrastructure, and best practices. * Support early customer engagements by reproducing and resolving system\-level issues and collaborating with applications engineering. * Document validation results, silicon characterization data, debug findings, and production readiness reports. What You'll Bring * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline. * 8\+ years of hands\-on post\-silicon validation, DVT, or silicon bring\-up experience with complex ASICs or SoCs. * Proven experience bringing first silicon to production in networking, communications, data center, AI, or high\-performance computing products. * Strong understanding of silicon debug methodologies and structured root\-cause analysis. * Extensive experience using laboratory equipment including oscilloscopes, BERTs, protocol analyzers, network analyzers, logic analyzers, and related validation tools. * Strong knowledge of one or more high\-speed protocols including PCIe, Ethernet, SerDes, CXL, USB, SPI, I²C, or similar interfaces. * Strong Python programming skills for automation, regression development, and data analysis. * Experience validating firmware, embedded software, drivers, and hardware/software interfaces. * Ability to interpret schematics, understand board design, power sequencing, signal integrity, and hardware debug. * Excellent communication skills with the ability to work effectively across Architecture, Design, Firmware, Systems, Product Engineering, Manufacturing, and Customer Engineering teams. * Comfortable working in a fast\-paced startup environment where priorities evolve quickly and every team member has significant technical ownership. * Ability to work onsite at our Irvine, California headquarters. Preferred Qualifications * Experience validating coherent optical DSPs, networking ASICs, Ethernet switch silicon, AI accelerators, GPUs, storage controllers, or high\-speed communications devices. * Strong knowledge of Ethernet, PCIe, OIF, IEEE, or related compliance specifications. * Experience with PIPE, PCS, PMA, MAC, PHY, or other physical and protocol layers of high\-speed interfaces. * Experience building scalable validation automation, regression systems, dashboards, and data pipelines. * Familiarity with customer platform validation and hyperscale qualification processes. * Experience mentoring engineers and leading technical initiatives across multiple engineering disciplines. Why Celero At Celero, you'll help develop the next generation of coherent DSP technology enabling AI infrastructure and hyperscale networking. As a Principal Engineer, you'll have the opportunity to influence product architecture, shape validation strategy, work alongside industry leaders, and make a significant impact within a collaborative, high\-growth startup environment where innovation, ownership, and technical excellence are valued every day Annual Base Salary Range: $150,000 \- $250,000 (The final offer will be determined based on job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, and location.)

jobs.title: Manager, Data Science- Merchandising Category Analytics
jobs.description: Manager, Data Science – Merchandising Category Analytics Global Data \& Analytics \| Alimentation Couche\-Tard Location: Charlotte, NC JOIN OUR TEAM! At Circle K, our mission is simple: to make our customers’ lives a little easier every day. You may have already stopped for coffee, refueling your car, or eating something on the go. Then, you know what Circle K is. Since the opening of a first store in Laval, Québec, our parent company, Alimentation Couche\-Tard has never ceased to grow. We have grown into a successful global company with over 17,300 stores in 29 countries, serving almost 8\.5 million customers every day. In total, more than 146,000 people work in our stores and offices. We make journeys easier by offering fast and friendly service. We care about our people and our communities, and we look for ways to uplift people first. Wherever your journey’s going, we can help you get there. Are you ready to grow your career? Let's grow together! ### **The Role** We are seeking an innovative, dynamic Data Science Manager to lead Data Science, Machine Learning, and AI initiatives for Merchandising Category Analytics. As a key leader within the Global Data \& Analytics team, you will partner with Merchandising, Category Intelligence \& Enablement (CIE), and Technology teams to translate strategic priorities into scalable, data\-driven solutions that improve decisions and business performance. The ideal candidate brings deep technical expertise, commercial acumen, product thinking, and strong people leadership. You will lead a high\-performing team of data scientists, analysts, and machine learning engineers, taking solutions from opportunity identification through deployment, adoption, and measurable value realization. ### **What you’ll do** Strategy and Business Partnership* **Shape the Data Science and AI portfolio**: Develop and execute initiatives aligned with merchandising and enterprise priorities. * **Partner with business leaders**: Work with Merchandising and CIE leaders to identify high\-value opportunities, define business problems, and translate needs into analytics and AI solutions. * **Influence decisions**: Present actionable insights and recommendations to senior leaders to shape business strategy and strengthen value realization. Solution Delivery and Innovation* **Lead solution development:** Guide the design and deployment of scalable solutions across pricing, assortment, promotions, forecasting, experimentation, optimization, customer insights, and category performance. * **Advance AI and ML innovation**: Evaluate and apply emerging capabilities, including generative AI and AI agents, to improve merchandising decisions and productivity. * **Ensure end\-to\-end delivery**: Lead initiatives from data discovery and experimentation through production deployment, adoption, governance, and value realization. * **Scale capabilities**: Establish reusable methodologies, frameworks, and MLOps practices that enable solutions to scale across categories and business areas. Leadership, Governance, and Value* **Measure business value**: Define success metrics and demonstrate the measurable impact of Data Science, ML, and AI investments. * **Lead and develop talent**: Coach and develop data scientists and analysts while fostering technical excellence, innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. * **Collaborate across Data \& Analytics and Technology**: Partner with CIE, Data Engineering, Data Products, and Technology teams to deliver scalable, governed solutions aligned with enterprise standards. * **Champion responsible AI**: Promote strong practices for model governance, explainability, data quality, privacy, and responsible AI adoption. ### **What you’ll need** Education and Experience* Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline; an advanced business degree is an asset. * At least eight years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Advanced Analytics, or a related field, including three or more years in leadership roles delivering large\-scale initiatives. Technical Expertise* Strong knowledge of exploratory and descriptive analytics, hypothesis testing, A/B testing, experiment design, and Agile development practices. * Proficiency in Python, SQL, and R, with hands\-on experience using cloud data platforms such as Azure, Snowflake, or Databricks. * Working knowledge of data engineering workflows, including ETL, batch and real\-time processing, model deployment, MLOps, and version control. Leadership and Business Capabilities* Strong commercial mindset and demonstrated ability to translate data, analytics, and AI/ML insights into clear decisions, strategies, and business outcomes. * Proven experience in talent acquisition, team development, coaching, and mentoring. * Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to audiences at all levels and influence senior leaders across geographies. * Demonstrated success collaborating with cross\-functional partners, including Data Engineering, Architecture, and Data Cloud Platform teams. * Ability to prioritize multiple initiatives, communicate timelines clearly, and drive work proactively to completion. * Adaptability, curiosity, and a commitment to continuous learning across business and technology domains. ### **Success in This Role** Success will be measured by the ability to connect merchandising strategy with Data Science, ML, and AI capabilities; deliver scalable solutions with measurable business impact; and build a high\-performing data science organization. **Circle K is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** **The Company complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act (the ADA) and all state and local disability laws. Meet the Team Cisco Silicon One (\#CiscoSiliconOne) is a business organization with a long track record of building complex and high\-performance Silicon ASICs. Our silicon devices drive the world’s most complex networks and carry over 90% of IP traffic. Your Impact * We are seeking a qualified Signal and Power Integrity Engineer to help us develop our next generation ASIC packaging to help define, design and verify ASIC packaging to be deployed in a range of Cisco platforms. * Develop, document, and implement design rules for ultra\-high\-speed signaling, ensuring power, performance, and area goals are met for products. * Analyze substrate signal integrity (SI) and power integrity (PI), providing feedback and collaborating with the layout team to develop optimal solutions across interposer, substrate, and PCB. * Design, document, and develop ASIC packages for high\-volume, high\-quality release, including post\-layout extraction and reporting. * Collaborate with system partners, vendors, and design leads to achieve combined power and signal integrity and to resolve complex technical issues using advanced technology design rules. Minimum Qualifications * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering and 4\+ years of relevant signal and power integrity experience, or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering and 2\+ years of relevant signal and power integrity experience, or PhD in Electrical Engineering and 0\+ years of related experience, or equivalent related work experience. * High\-Speed Design\& Theory: Experience with high\-speed design principles, including Transmission Line Theory, electromagnetics, scattering parameters, and impedance network analysis, applied to 56G PAM4 SerDes architectures, channel modeling, and BER prediction. * SI/PI Simulation Proficiency: Experience with pre\- and post\-layout signal and power integrity (SI/PI) simulations using industry\-standard EDA tools such as Cadence Sigrity, Ansys HFSS, and Keysight ADS. * Layout Review\& Physical Validation: Experience conducting detailed layout reviews and physical design validation using tools such as Cadence APD and Ansys EM flows to ensure signal performance and crosstalk mitigation. * Circuit Analysis: Experience with SPICE for circuit\-level analysis, signal modeling, and performance validation.
