jobs.title: vCIO - Strategic Technology Advisor
jobs.description: **Job Title: Strategic Technology Advisor (Virtual CIO)** Chicago, IL (Hybrid/Remote) \| Reports to: Director of Operations \| Full\-Time Framework IT is Chicago’s premier IT Managed Service Provider with a mission of reinventing technology by updating how it is serviced. We base our vision on a ‘client\-first’ motto to focus on our clients’ business needs and challenges, then design their support solutions around them. We believe that investing in the health, happiness, welfare and continued career development of our employees and community allows us to spearhead the next big ideas that will shape the way technology enhances the world around us. Framework IT was founded on the fundamental need to enhance our community and culture through technology. We work together to grow together. **The Role:** Our vCIO Consultant is the trusted executive advisor and strategic owner for a portfolio of Framework IT clients. You’ll sit at the intersection of business and technology, partnering with C\-suite leaders to build technology roadmaps, budgets, and security strategies that drive real business outcomes. This is a consultative, relationship\-driven role that blends fractional CIO leadership with strategic account management: you’ll own client satisfaction, retention, and the long\-term health of roughly 25 client relationships. This is an advisory role, not a sales role; your success is measured by client outcomes and trust, not quota. You won’t just be a vendor contact; you’ll be the person clients call before they make a technology decision. **Who You Are:** Our hiring decisions are based on who you are, not only on what you can do. While skills are important, at Framework we hire the person – not the skillset. We’re looking for someone with our values at their core: * **Teamwork:** We work together and for one another. * **Pride:** We believe in the importance of our work. * **Dynamic:** Life is always teaching, so we will continue learning. * **Integrity:** We believe successful relationships require honesty. * **Open Minded:** We are open to new ideas. **What You’ll Do:** **Strategic Planning \& Advisory*** Serve as the strategic partner and advisor for your client portfolio, building long\-term account plans aligned to each client’s business goals and growth trajectory. * Build and present technology roadmaps that clearly show the ROI and strategic value of IT investments. * Lead strategic planning sessions with executive stakeholders to align IT initiatives with business outcomes. * Run maturity model, security, and stack\-alignment assessments to identify gaps and technology risks, then turn findings into prioritized, budgeted recommendations. * Advise clients proactively on infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud, compliance, and digital transformation, staying ahead of industry trends and emerging technologies (including AI adoption and governance). **Client Relationship Management*** Act as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for a portfolio of approximately 25 managed services clients. * Build deep, consultative relationships with C\-suite executives and key stakeholders. * Lead quarterly and annual strategic business reviews (QBRs/SBRs) with compelling insights, roadmap updates, and actionable recommendations. * Hold regular check\-ins to keep a pulse on client health, priorities, and satisfaction. * Serve as the escalation point for critical business concerns, partnering with our Service Team to ensure swift resolution and client confidence. **Client Success \& Retention*** Identify gaps through stack alignment and Lifecycle Manager data, and recommend the right managed services, security, and cloud solutions to close them. * Partner with Presales and Scoping Engineers to turn roadmap initiatives into scoped solutions and Statement of Works. * Own client health and retention for your portfolio, spotting at\-risk accounts early and executing mitigation plans. **Financial Management \& Budget Stewardship*** Prepare and present clear, accurate IT budgets and technology spend reports to clients and internal leadership. * Help clients negotiate agreements, contracts, and pricing with third\-party vendors. * Maintain an accurate pipeline of recommendations and statement of works to support forecasting. **Collaboration \& Internal Excellence*** Work closely with Sales, Service Delivery, Projects, and Support to deliver a seamless client experience. * Support our Professional Services team on client projects, providing business context, keeping clients informed, and helping resolve gaps. * Help shape Framework IT’s standard technology stack, vCIO playbooks, SOPs, and thought leadership alongside the Manager of Consulting. * Mentor junior team members and contribute to the growth of the vCIO practice. * Keep timesheets, ConnectWise records, Lifecycle Manager roadmaps, and client documentation accurate and up to date. **What Success Looks Like:*** High client satisfaction (CSAT/NPS) and low churn across your portfolio. * Strong contract renewal rates and client adoption of roadmap recommendations. * Healthy account profitability and well\-managed, predictable client IT budgets. * Accurate, timely reporting and forecasting through your recommendations pipeline. * Long\-term account plans executed with measurable, quantifiable business outcomes for clients. * Clients who see Framework IT as their trusted advisor and refer us to others. **What You Bring:*** 5–7\+ years of experience in IT, with at least 3 years in a client\-facing vCIO, technical account management, IT consulting, or strategic account management role; MSP experience strongly preferred. * Exceptional written and verbal communication with executive presence; able to translate complex technical concepts into clear business language and data\-driven recommendations. * Proven track record of building trusted relationships with C\-suite stakeholders and leading QBRs or strategic planning sessions. * A consultative, advisory mindset, comfortable making and defending recommendations, and working in a KPI\-driven environment. * Solid understanding of IT infrastructure, networking, cloud platforms (Microsoft 365, Azure, AWS), cybersecurity, and MSP service offerings. * Working knowledge of security and compliance frameworks such as NIST CSF, CIS Controls, ISO 27001, CMMC, and FINRA; experience with cyber insurance requirements a plus. * Experience with IT budgeting, technology lifecycle planning, and vendor/contract negotiation. * Strong organizational and time management skills, able to juggle multiple high\-priority accounts while working autonomously in a hybrid/remote environment. * Experience with ConnectWise PSA and ScalePad Lifecycle Manager strongly preferred (or similar PSA and vCIO/strategy platforms). * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. **Nice to Have:*** Certifications such as ITIL, CompTIA (Security\+, Network\+), Microsoft (Azure/M365\), CISSP/CISM, or vCIO\-specific programs. * Project management experience or certification (PMP, CAPM). * Experience advising clients across a variety of industries, including regulated environments. **What We Offer:** $85,000 to $105,000 starting salary, commensurate with experience and skills* Robust medical coverage options plus dental and vision * 401(k) with partial company match * Generous PTO and flex time\-off policy * Flexible hybrid or remote work options + Occasional client\-site visits to support relationship and project needs * Ongoing training, professional development, and certification/exam reimbursement * Support to attend industry events and conferences * A defined career path; see below * Collaborative, values\-driven culture **Where This Role Can Take You:** This is a career\-path role within our Consulting practice. High\-performing vCIOs can grow into:* Senior vCIO, leading our most strategic client relationships and mentoring the team * Lead vCIO, shaping playbooks, standards, and the Framework IT technology stack * Director of Consulting and broader leadership roles within Framework IT *Framework IT is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.* G2joJo1urF

Confident, competitive, and results\-oriented professionals who create a track record of success. * **Dedicated achievers.** People who thrive in a fast\-paced environment and will stop at nothing to ensure a project is complete and meets regulations and expectations. ### **Skills Knowledge and Expertise** **What you need:*** Read and understand documents such as policy manuals, safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. * Able to read and interpret complex circuits schematics. * Write technical reports and test procedures. * Work with general guidelines and standardized procedures/instructions. * Able to operate, troubleshoot, and make technical decisions with minimal supervision. * Use standard assembly techniques using soldering iron and standard hand tools. * Use complex machines and electronic test equipment (such as oscilloscope, digital volt meter, function generator). * Effectively communicate information and respond to questions in person\-to\-person and small group situations with customers, clients, the general public, and other employees of the organization. * Identify and learn new technologies related to job duties. * Maintain confidentiality and use discretion with business information **Education and Experience*** Associate’s degree in engineering, engineering technology, design technology, or a related field or equivalent experience (required). * Bachelor’s degree in engineering, engineering technology, design technology, or a related field or equivalent experience (preferred). * 5\+ years of relevant education or experience in electronics, electrical engineering technology, or a related field (required). **Computer Skills*** **Intermediate:** Alphanumeric data entry, spreadsheet * **Basic:** Microsoft Office suite, Python, National Instruments FlexLogger, LabVIEW. jobs.title: Software Engineer III
jobs.description: ***It’s about creating solutions that help people.*** Do others often ask you for technology advice and assistance? Are you always looking for innovative ways to help people? Do you like having the autonomy to build new solutions from the ground up? If so, being a Software Engineer III at Frost could be the job for you. At Frost, it’s about more than a job. It’s about having a flourishing career where you can thrive, both in and out of work. In joining our adaptable, integrity\-driven team, you’ll become part of Frost’s over 150\-year legacy of providing unparalleled banking services. **Who you are:** As a **Software Engineer III** at Frost, *you* are our code guru, not only writing code but understanding the "why" behind it. You welcome a challenge and want to provide next level experiences to every individual that uses our systems. **What you’ll do:** * Design, write, test, implement, and document solutions for assigned program modules. * Collaborate with and provide technical advice to Product Owners, Business Analysts, and lines of business to estimate level\-of\-effort, timing, and feasibility, to design new systems based on business requirements, and to optimize system and program functionality. * Review coding for a group of software engineers to ensure alignment with business needs, change control procedures, and Frost development standards. * Take action using Integrity, Caring, and Excellence to achieve all\-win outcomes. **What you’ll need:** * 4 years of experience in commonly\-used concepts, practices, and procedures associated with programming. * 4 years of experience in building and interfacing with Restful API(s) and in using JSON and XML formats. * 4 years experience in application development using Java, Spring Boot, Angular, Bootstrap, HTML, and CSS. * 4 years of experience in core Java concepts, including object\-oriented programming, generics, collections, multithreading, memory management, and data structures and algorithms. * 4 years of experience in Spring Boot ecosystem, including building RESTful APIs, SOAP Services, implementing microservices architectures with domain driven design, configuring dependency injection, and managing application properties, profiles, and lifecycle hooks. * 4 years of experience in test\-driven development (using JUnit, Mockito), version control with Git, and use of design patterns like Singleton, Factory, and Strategy to ensure code maintainability and scalability. * 4 years of experience in building robust CI/CD pipelines, containerization using Docker, and orchestration via Kubernetes, Openshift. * 4 years of experience in integration with databases (using Spring Data JPA), messaging systems If this sounds like you, we encourage you to apply and see what’s possible at Frost. Experience may be gained concurrently. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Role Summary** Fusion Worldwide is a global open market distributor of electronic components. When a supply chain breaks because of an allocation, a shortage, or a part going end\-of\-life, we're who the world's largest manufacturers call. That business runs on knowing things: which companies are real and active, which parts substitute for which, who is likely to need what. Our traders make those calls in hours, using what the platform shows them. We run a production data and intelligence platform. RMS is our system of record, a custom internal ERP we build and maintain. Every order, quote, and transaction lives there. Our platform sits on top. It reads from RMS, enriches and models that data, and writes operational results back. **Tech Stack** * Data: Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL * Languages: Python, PySpark, SQL, TypeScript * AI: Claude connected directly to our platform for agentic development * Applications: Custom applications in React, APIs consumed by Web RMS * Integration: RMS, HubSpot, vendor APIs * Cloud: Microsoft Azure * Work management: Atlassian (Jira, Confluence) **Platform \& Data** * Work with the object model covering companies, parts, offers, and demand signals. That includes adding object types, properties, and relationships as the data needs them. * Build and maintain ingestion from RMS, Azure SQL, HubSpot, and vendor APIs, along with the transforms, pipelines, and automations behind it. * Build and maintain the quality gates, including data expectations that fail the build, freshness checks against declared SLAs, and tests that catch problems nobody would otherwise notice. * Tune performance across query plans, index design, materialization strategy, and caching. * Help with incident response when pipelines or write\-backs break, which may include on\-call. **System of Record Write\-backs** * Work on the write\-back path into RMS. Scores, enrichment, resolved entities, and operational flags get written back to the system of record. * Handle idempotency, conflict handling, and reconciling the two sides when they disagree. **APIs, Applications \& AI** * Design the APIs that UIs in Web RMS use to pull platform data. You work on the contracts and the versioning, and you make sure the APIs are fast enough for a UI. * Build custom applications. * Build agent workflows that read the object model and act on it, such as triaging inbound RFQs, picking out pricing signals, and flagging anomalies in offers. * Build and maintain the agent setup the team develops with, including instructions, tool connections, and the checks on agent output. **How We Work** Our team built this platform with AI agents, and you'd keep working that way. We're rolling out a federated team model, and this role sits on the core data platform team. Claude connects directly to our platform and writes transforms, queries our data, runs audits, and reads the object model as it goes. You'll have a budget for AI tooling and compute, and we won't make you fight for model access. Agents write most of the code. You build and maintain the agents, including their instructions, the tools and data they can reach, and the checks that catch their mistakes. You review what they produce and fix it when it's wrong. A few things that have gone wrong here: a scoring pass quietly stopped running. An LLM we used to check output lost part of its prompt and started approving everything. A library upgrade changed a default setting and turned off a live feature, and no test caught it. We want someone who has used agents heavily on production systems, had them fail, and changed how they work because of it. Leave your ego at the door. Everyone on the team does hands\-on work, including the tedious parts. We're not interested in self\-promotion. If most of your AI experience is posting about it on LinkedIn, this role isn't a fit. We'll ask what you built, what broke, and what you'd do differently. People who do well here give credit freely and say so when they're wrong. You'll inherit written standards, including runbooks that define "done" for a pipeline, notes on past mistakes, and approved project plans. We'd expect you to follow them and add to them. **What We Build Has to Be Explainable** A trader who disagrees with a number can see where it came from. Parameters and thresholds are stored as versioned data, and every output records which version it used. None are hard\-coded in a transform. Anything an LLM generates comes with a plain\-English reason and a link to the source field. Lineage is kept end to end, so you can trace a wrong number back to the row that caused it. Taking a Feature End to End We have a product manager, and you'd work with them on direction and priorities. They don't have to sit in the middle of every decision. Once you pick up a problem, you'll do most of the scoping, building the POC, iterating, and deciding when it ships. You'll do some of the product work yourself. That includes talking to the trader who raised the problem, deciding what the first version leaves out, and choosing when a rough version is ready to show them. Everything you work on gets a Jira ticket. You'll work in a light Agile process, with story point estimates. The product manager or business analyst writes most tickets, and you'll write your own for improvements, fixes, and iterations, using AI to draft them. **Requirements** * Production data platform experience, on platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Spark, or dbt. * 8\+ years building software, weighted toward backend and data engineering. * Expert SQL and deep experience with relational databases such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle, or MySQL. We run SQL Server. You can read an execution plan, design indexes that hold up under load, and tell when a normalized model is the wrong choice. * Experience writing back into a system of record. Transactional integrity, idempotency, and reconciliation. * API design. You've designed APIs for applications you don't control, changed them without breaking those applications, and shaped them around what a UI needs. * End\-to\-end delivery. You can point to features you drove from idea through POC, build, iteration, and release. We'll ask what you cut from scope, what you shipped rough, and what you killed. * Caching and performance engineering. You've made slow things fast and can explain what you changed. * Git, code review, and CI/CD. You work in Git, review other people's code, and ship through automated tests in a CI/CD pipeline. * Data governance and security. Access controls, handling sensitive data, and meeting audit requirements. * Production LLM systems you built and shipped, including what comes after shipping, such as evaluation, guardrails, cost, and latency. * Day\-to\-day work with AI agents on production systems, with specifics on where they help and where they quietly fail. * Building systems other people can audit. Lineage that holds up, parameters stored as versioned data, and outputs a non\-engineer can challenge. * Clear written communication. We write a lot of documents, and this role writes many of them. **Strongly preferred** * 3\+ years hands\-on experience with a production data platform, including object modeling, building and shipping pipelines, and shipping an application that people use * Python and PySpark, including catching what an agent gets wrong, such as a transform that looks right but skews the join, a window function that silently drops rows, or a fix that passes tests and breaks the contract downstream * Dimensional modeling and schema design judgment * Entity resolution, master data, taxonomies, or knowledge graphs * React * Process mining * Jira, including connecting to it with Claude or other AI tools • ERP integration experience • Streaming and event\-driven ingestion (Kafka, CDC) * Electronics distribution, supply chain, or industrial B2B data **Explicitly not required** * A PhD * Deep learning research or model training. We use frontier models; we don't train them * Prior distribution\-industry experience * Front\-end as a primary skill. The job is data and backend **Ramp** * 30 days: You're shipping transforms and object\-model changes to production through our existing promotion path, and you've found at least one thing we got wrong. * 90 days: You're working across the backend, including the RMS write\-back path, and an application you built is in daily use on the trading floor. Application Question Instead of a cover letter, we'd rather have your answer to one question: Describe something you built on a data platform that you'd model differently if you started again today, and what changed your mind. Our interviews include a hands\-on build session. You'll use Claude, and you'll explain every line you ship.

jobs.title: Sr Site Leader - Digital Technology
jobs.description: At GE Appliances, a Haier company, we come together to make “good things, for life.” As the fastest\-growing appliance company in the U.S., we’re powered by creators, thinkers and makers who believe that anything is possible and that there’s always a better way. We believe in the power of our people and in giving them the freedom to explore, discover and build good things, together. The GE Appliances philosophy, backed by three simple commitments defines the way we work, invent, create, do business, and serve our communities: *we come together*, *we always look for a better way*, and *we create possibilities*. Interested in joining us on our journey? At GE Appliances, a Haier company, we are building world\-class manufacturing operations powered by advanced digital technologies. We are seeking a strategic and hands\-on candidate to drive digital transformation for our Camden, South Carolina manufacturing facility. In this role, you will shape and deploy cutting\-edge technology solutions to enhance efficiency, automate processes, and achieve measurable operational improvements. This role is part of plant staff and will advise plant leadership, set and execute strategic vison, set priority for partnering DT teams to advance our global smart factory vision, as well as technical development and configurations for DT related production equipment, bridging automation, robotics, vision systems, and enterprise data flows.**Position** ------------ Sr Site Leader \- Digital Technology**Location** ------------ USA, Camden, SC**How You'll Create Possibilities** ----------------------------------- Site Leadership \& DT Coordination * Strategic Leadership: Drive the execution and support of plant level Digital Technology (DT) strategies aligned with enterprise goals, serving as a key advisor to plant leadership for Factory Master Plans and deliverables * Operational \& Financial Management: Forecast local IT budget and manage the end\-to\-end on\-time project delivery, resource allocation, asset management. * AI \& Innovation: Promote, encourage, and lead AI initiatives to modernize IT and OT manufacturing processes and drive smart factory advancements. * Systems Integration: Partner with operations to optimize core systems, including development and configuration of MES (Proficy Cimplicity), ERP (Oracle), quality management, and OT security solutions. * Data\-Driven Optimization: Lead data collection strategies within MES platforms to streamline processes and maximize production performance. * Edge Technology \& Infrastructure: Direct the design, configuration, and maintenance of plant systems and edge devices, including barcode scanners, camera systems, printers, and connected hardware. * Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner across teams to establish technology best practices and keep the site aligned with emerging manufacturing IT trends. * Support \& Escalation: Coordinate day\-to\-day site DT needs, partnering with managed services operations team to maintain a high system availability and rapid resolutions. MES \& Systems Analysis (Proficy Cimplicity) * MES Administration \& Optimization: Act as the hands\-on site analyst for Proficy Cimplicity, managing screen/UI configurations, tracking workflows, and troubleshooting daily transaction anomalies. * Data Flow \& Traceability: Partner with site teams to capture shop floor data, ensuring end\-to\-end material tracking, quality verification, and production accuracy. * Continuous Improvement: Analyze application behavior and user feedback to identify system enhancements, ensure high production line yields, and optimize process cycle times. Shop Floor, Controls \& ERP Integration * Controls \& Automation Collaboration: Maintain frequent, close collaboration with plant controls engineers to coordinate data handshakes between automation systems, PLC data, robotics, line scanners (Cognex), and vision systems into Velotic Proficy. * ERP Data Transaction: Coordinate interface logic and transactional data integrity between Proficy Cimplicity and enterprise systems (such as Oracle ERP). * Hardware \& Edge Device Support: Solution shop floor edge hardware, (barcode scanners, label printers, vision systems, industrial PCs, and shop floor terminals) working with local Deskside techs to build and support the factory. **What You'll Bring to Our Team** --------------------------------- Minimum Qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field. * 4\+ years of experience in IT roles within manufacturing environments. * 3\+ years of experience leading complex projects and managing IT professionals. * Strong communication skills with leadership staff, team members, and cross\-functional teams. * Expertise in MES system configuration, screen/UI design, and troubleshooting. * Experience with Oracle ERP, including Procurement and integration/data flow design. * Understanding of networking and cybersecurity principles in industrial/OT settings. * Experience with project management and data analytics tools (e.g., Office suite, Jira, Smartsheets, SQL, Tableau, Power BI). * Proficient in Oracle SQL and comfortable reading code in languages like JavaScript. * Ability to work on\-site in Camden, SC, with flexibility to support production escalations when necessary; occasional travel (\~5%). Preferred Qualifications * Prior direct experience configuring and troubleshooting Proficy Cimplicity. * Familiarity with machine vision and scanning technologies (e.g., Cognex, Keyence, Datalogic) and PLC\-to\-MES data exchanges. * Exposure to or practical interest in applied Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning tools in an industrial or analytics context. * Familiarity with manufacturing IT architectural concepts (such as ISA\-95 frameworks). * Experience with project and workflow tools such as Jira, Smartsheet, ServiceNow, and BI tools (Tableau, Power BI). * Certifications in Lean Six Sigma, Agile, or project management fundamentals. **Our Culture** --------------- Our work is centered on our People and Culture as reflected in our Zero Distance philosophy and we recognize the importance of reaffirming our commitment to inclusion and diversity (I\&D). This underscores our commitment to fostering an environment where every individual feels valued, connected, and empowered to contribute, while positioning our organization to adapt seamlessly to the evolving needs of our workforce and communities. This reflects our dedication to creating solutions that: Empower colleagues by fostering an environment where all voices are heard, valued, and encouraged to contribute. Strengthen communities where we live and work. Reinforce a culture of belonging, purpose, and engagement. Reflect the diversity of the communities we serve through our workforce, products, and practices. By further embedding Zero Distance into our People and Culture framework, we will continue to build a deeply connected organization. We are cultivating a culture of engagement, belonging, and connection, because while attracting new talent remains a priority, retention is a cornerstone of our strategy. GE Appliances is a trust\-based organization. It is important we offer our employees the flexibility they need to do their best work while balancing the needs of the business and individuals. When you join GE Appliances, you will have the opportunity to work with your leader to create a flexible work arrangement that balances the needs of the individual, team, and organization. GE Appliances is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. GE Appliances participates in E\-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I\-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S *If you are an individual with a disability and need assistance or an accommodation to use our website or to apply, please send an e\-mail* *to ask.recruiting@geappliances.com*

We thrive on relentless innovation to exceed our customers' expectations while making a real impact on local communities nationwide. Founded in 1936, GEICO is a member of the Berkshire Hathaway family of companies and one of the largest auto insurers in the United States. When you join our company, we want you to feel valued, supported, and proud to work here. That's why we offer the GEICO Pledge: Great Company, Great Culture, Great Rewards, and Great Careers. GEICO is seeking a Staff Engineer, Applied AI to help shape how Generative AI enhances customer and associate experiences across the enterprise. This is a senior, hands\-on individual contributor role for someone with deep technical expertise, strong collaboration skills, and a proven ability to deliver scalable, resilient, production\-ready AI systems. You will partner with engineering teams, data scientists, and product leaders to design, build, and scale AI\-powered capabilities that automate workflows, improve decision\-making, and elevate user experience. You will also mentor engineers who want to learn AI, LLMs, and agent\-based development, fostering a culture of learning, curiosity, and innovation. **What You Will Do** * Identify and evaluate opportunities for automating business processes using AI, intelligent workflows, and agent\-based systems. * Architect, build, and deploy applied AI solutions across high\-value enterprise workflows including automation, document intelligence, decision support, and intelligent assistants. * Design and implement AI agents and agentic workflows that orchestrate tools, APIs, reasoning steps, and business logic to automate complex processes at scale. * Build systems and services that meet high standards for scalability, resilience, performance, and availability. * Use knowledge graphs to enhance reasoning, entity relationships, context retrieval, and multi\-step workflows. * Collaborate with product, engineering, operations, and analytics partners to co\-create scalable AI solutions and translate business needs into technical designs. * Mentor engineers and scientists who want to develop AI and agentic workflow skills through coaching, pairing, reviews, and architectural guidance on architecture, experimentation, and deployment across multiple teams. * Run rigorous experimentation and evaluation including hypothesis definition, measurement, validation, and iterative improvement in production environments. * Establish and model engineering best practices for reliability, interpretability, safety, governance, and monitoring of production AI systems. **What We Are Looking For (Must Have)** * 8 or more years of professional software engineering or applied machine learning experience, including 2 or more years working with Generative AI or LLM\-based systems in production. * Strong hands\-on experience with Python and modern AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, and OpenAI or Anthropic APIs. * Demonstrated experience designing, building, and operating production AI systems including agentic workflows and intelligent automation features. * Proven experience building scalable, resilient, secure, and maintainable products and systems that run reliably in production. * Strong understanding of agent architectures, workflow orchestration, retrieval\-augmented generation, vector databases, and knowledge graph integration. * Ability to collaborate deeply across teams and co\-create solutions with engineers, product managers, and domain experts. * Experience mentoring engineers and helping others grow in AI, LLM, and agent\-based system design. * A history of delivering measurable business outcomes from AI systems. * Strong competency in distributed systems, service design, performance optimization, and reliability engineering. **Nice to Have** * Experience building advanced Generative AI capabilities including domain\-tuned LLMs, vector reasoning techniques, or specialized retrieval architectures. * Experience with insurance, financial services, or other regulated industries. * Experience deploying AI components in Java ecosystems including Spring AI, LangChain4j, or Embabel. * Background in document intelligence, fraud or anomaly modeling, or complex ontology and knowledge graph design. * Familiarity with AI safety practices, evaluation frameworks, monitoring, and regulatory compliance. * Ability to effectively communicate complex technical topics to senior leadership and non\-technical stakeholders. **Who You Are** * A collaborative engineer who works well with cross\-functional partners and supports the growth of those around you. * A hands\-on builder who ships reliable, scalable, production\-grade systems rather than stopping at proof of concept. * Someone who understands how to design systems that scale smoothly, recover gracefully, and operate reliably under load. * An innovative thinker who explores new approaches, tools, and architectures and applies them thoughtfully. * A natural mentor who enjoys helping others develop AI, LLM, and agentic workflow skills. * A systems thinker who can connect LLMs, vector search, agents, and knowledge graphs into cohesive solutions. * Driven by real\-world impact, customer value, and long\-term engineering excellence. **Why Join GEICO** * Build the next generation of AI\-powered enterprise workflows and intelligent automation. * Work on high\-impact problems at large operational scale. * Collaborate with a talented engineering organization focused on advancing AI capabilities. * Set the standard for responsible and production\-grade AI deployment across the enterprise. * Mentor and inspire future AI builders across the company. **Annual Salary** $115,000\.00 \- $230,000\.00 The above annual salary range is a general guideline. Multiple factors are taken into consideration to arrive at the final hourly rate/ annual salary to be offered to the selected candidate. Factors include, but are not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the role, the selected candidate’s work experience, education and training, the work location as well as market and business considerations. At this time, GEICO will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position. **The GEICO Pledge:** **Great Company:** Protecting customers through life’s twists and turns with innovation and integrity. **Great Careers:**Personalized development programs, mentorship, and certification assistance. **Great Culture:**Inclusive and collaborative culture rooted in shared success. **Great Rewards:**Competitive pay, benefits, and flexibility to support your well\-being and future. The equal employment opportunity policy of the GEICO Companies provides for a fair and equal employment opportunity for all associates and job applicants regardless of race, color, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, age, gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, familial status, disability or genetic information, in compliance with applicable federal, state and local law. GEICO reasonably accommodates qualified individuals with disabilities to enable them to receive equal employment opportunity and/or perform the essential functions of the job, unless the accommodation would impose an undue hardship to the Company. This applies to all applicants and associates. GEICO also provides a work environment in which each associate is able to be productive and work to the best of their ability. We do not condone or tolerate an atmosphere of intimidation or harassment. jobs.description: **Logistics at full potential.** At GXO, we’re constantly looking for talented individuals at all levels who can deliver the caliber of service our company requires. jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **AUTOMATION ENGINEER I** At Gables Engineering, (a HEICO Company), we've been engineering the avionics systems pilots trust since 1946\. We are looking for an **Automation Engineer I** to design, build, and program the test fixtures that verify our electronic and avionics assemblies on the production floor. **About Gables Engineering:** Founded in 1946, Gables Engineering is a leader in avionics controls and advanced cockpit solutions. Based in Coral Gables, FL, and a proud HEICO Company, we partner with airlines and OEMs worldwide to deliver tailored, next\-generation avionics technology. **What You'll Do:** This is an entry\-level, hands\-on role. Reporting to the Director of Automation Engineering and guided by senior engineers, you'll own fixture projects from concept through deployment: designing them, building and wiring them yourself, writing the software that runs them, and training the technicians who use them. It's a great way to grow into broader automation and control system work. **PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Design and build electrical/mechanical test fixtures for functional, in\-circuit, and burn\-in testing, based on product schematics and engineering specifications * Select and wire interface hardware, including connectors, relays, switches, pneumatics, and sensors * Write and debug test scripts and control software (primarily LabVIEW) to run fixtures and record pass/fail results * Prototype each fixture and test it against known\-good and known\-bad units until results are repeatable * Work with the machine shop or outside vendors on machined or fabricated parts * Prepare fixture documentation, including bills of materials, wiring diagrams, and operating instructions * Train test technicians and production operators to set up, run, and troubleshoot new fixtures * Respond to fixture issues on the production floor and get fixtures back in service quickly * Maintain calibration, preventive maintenance, and spare parts for assigned fixtures * Find manual test or inspection steps that could be automated, and propose projects to reduce cycle time and errors * Review new product designs with Engineering to flag features that would be hard or costly to test **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:** * Exposure to LabVIEW, PLCs, or relay logic through coursework, projects, or work * Experience in electronics manufacturing or assembly environments * Aerospace or avionics exposure * Bilingual (English/Spanish) **Why join Gables Engineering?** **Vertical Integration:** We are highly vertically integrated. We control our entire value chain, giving us faster design\-to\-production cycles so we can show customers real solutions and adapt quickly to their needs. **Real Impact:** The work you do here doesn't sit in a lab. It flies in real cockpits, on real aircraft, around the world. **HEICO Backing:** The stability of a major global aerospace leader, with the agility of a close\-knit team. **Nearly 80 Years Strong:** Founded in 1946, Gables Engineering has spent nearly eight decades earning a reputation for precision, reliability, and innovation in avionics. **Excellent Benefits Package:** We take care of our team, because great work deserves great benefits: * Medical, dental, and vision coverage, with a generous employer contribution toward your premium * Company\-paid basic life, AD\&D, short\-term, and long\-term disability coverage * 401(k) with a 100% company match up to 6%, plus an annual discretionary Equity Builder contribution in HEICO stock * Free access to our on\-site gym, **the Gables Sportatorium**, with locker rooms and showers * Employee Assistance Program, legal plan, ID theft protection, and a veterinary discount program * Generous PTO and regular company events **Gables Engineering is a drug free workplace and Equal Opportunity Employer. D/V** Requirements: **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:** * BS degree in Electrical, Mechanical, or Automation/Manufacturing Engineering * 0\-3 years of relevant experience; internships or co\-ops in test fixture, automation, or electromechanical projects are welcome * Basic soldering and hand\-tool skills, and comfort building and wiring fixtures yourself * Working knowledge of electrical schematics and the ability to turn one into a working test setup * Familiarity with data acquisition hardware and basic instruments (multimeters, oscilloscopes, power supplies) * Familiarity with CAD software such as SolidWorks or AutoCAD * Strong written documentation habits * Willingness to spend time on the production floor regularly, not just at a desk

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer, Basketball
jobs.description: **About GameChanger:** We believe in the life\-changing impact youth sports have on and off the field because they encourage leadership, teamwork, responsibility, and confidence—important life lessons that have the power to propel our youth toward meaningful futures. We recognize that without coaches, parents, and volunteers, organized youth sports could not exist. By building the first and best place to experience the youth sports moments important to our community, we are helping families elevate the next generation through youth sports. So if you love sports and their community\-building potential, or building cool products is your sport, GameChanger is the team for you. We are a remote\-first, dynamic tech company based in New York City, and we are solving some of the biggest challenges in youth sports today. **The Position:** At GameChanger, the goal of the Basketball team is to deliver the best possible scoring, stats, and viewing experience for the coaches, parents, and fans of youth basketball. We build features that help coaches capture every possession, analyze performance, and teach their players, while giving families a way to follow the game no matter where they are. As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you'll lead the design and delivery of features that bring basketball to life across our web and backend platforms. You'll own the quality and scalability of the systems that power live game scoring, stats, and other post\-game experience features, and you'll help shape how the sport is represented in GameChanger. You'll collaborate closely with product, design, and fellow engineers, and you will report to our Basketball Engineering Manager. **What You’ll Do:** * Build and improve backend services and APIs that support basketball scorekeeping, stats, and postgame experiences. * Extend existing endpoints and systems to support new product capabilities, including postgame editing. * Develop web features that make basketball box scores and stats accessible to coaches, families, and fans. * Own technical design and delivery for your projects, making architectural decisions that fit our existing systems and product needs. * Partner with mobile engineers to deliver backend capabilities that support iOS and Android experiences. * Collaborate with product, design, and engineers on the other Hoops team, Stats \& Insights, and Gameday to deliver features across teams. * Write well\-tested, maintainable code and improve the reliability and performance of the systems you work on. * Share technical knowledge through code reviews and mentorship, and contribute patterns and tools that help engineers work effectively. **Who You Are:** * Experience delivering backend services and APIs in production, with a strong grasp of software engineering fundamentals. * A track record of building applications with TypeScript and Node.js, plus experience developing web features with React. * Experience extending existing systems and writing scalable, performant code, with particular depth in backend development. * Ability to independently design technical solutions and lead projects from requirements through implementation and release. * Experience collaborating with product, design, and engineers across teams, including mentoring peers and contributing to technical decisions. * Interest in sports and the products that support them. Familiarity with basketball, scorekeeping, or sports statistics is a plus. **Perks:** * Work remotely throughout the US\* or from our well\-furnished, modern office in Manhattan, NY. * Unlimited vacation policy. * Paid volunteer opportunities. * Technology stipend \- $4,000 every 2 years after your start to make sure you have the latest and greatest technology. * WFH stipend \- $500 annually to make your WFH situation comfortable. * Monthly physical, mental, wellness \& learning stipend offered through Holisticly. * Monthly lifestyle stipend offered through Fringe. * Full health benefits \- medical, dental, vision, prescription, FSA, HRA, HSA, and coverage for family/dependents. * Retirement savings \- Traditional and Roth 401K plans are offered through Vanguard, with an immediate company match. * Life insurance \- basic life, supplemental life, and dependent life. * Disability leave \- short\-term disability and long\-term disability. * Company paid parental leave \- up to 20 weeks for birthing parents and up to 12 weeks for non\-birthing parents. * Family building benefits offered through Progyny. * DICK'S Sporting Goods and their family of brands teammate discount. *The target salary range for this position is between $140,000 and $155,000\. This is part of a total compensation package that includes incentive, equity, and benefits for eligible roles. Individual pay may vary from the target range and is determined by several factors including experience, internal pay equity, and other relevant business considerations. We constantly review all teammate pay to ensure a great compensation package that is fair and equal across the board.* * *DICK'S Sporting Goods has company\-wide practices to monitor and protect the company from significant compliance and monetary implications as it pertains to employer state tax liabilities. Due to said guidelines put in place, we are unable to hire in AK, DE, HI, IA, LA, MS, MT, OK, and SC.* We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity in our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. **Our Interview Process \& AI** We recognize that AI has become a common part of everyday life and professional work, and its use continues to evolve rapidly. Our perspective on AI in the hiring process will evolve as well. At this time, we ask that candidates please refrain from using AI tools during interviews and assessments, as we want to see your authentic self. We will clearly indicate if and when AI use is acceptable in the process. If you have any questions or need accommodations, we're here to help. Thanks for helping us keep the process fair and secure for everyone! **IMPORTANT NOTICE:** All official recruitment communications from GameChanger will come from an email address ending in @gc.com or no\-reply@ashby.hq.com. If you receive communication from any other domain, please be cautious, as it is likely fraudulent. Compensation Range: $140K \- $155K

jobs.title: Sr. R&D Statistical Scientist (Statistician) - Golden Valley, MN
jobs.description: **COMPANY OVERVIEW** We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next. **JOB OVERVIEW:** General Mills is seeking a Sr. R\&D Statistical Scientist (Statistician) to join the Data Science \& Modeling team within the Innovation, Technology, and Quality (ITQ) function. The ITQ function is the center of science innovation, product development, and quality activities for the company. In this role, you will be a key player on a team that is solving business problems in product development, consumer testing, nutrition research, and product quality within a data\-rich science and engineering environment. You will have the opportunity to blend statistics, mathematics, modeling, and technology to transform data into actionable insights that drive business results. We are looking for an exceptional statistician who is passionate about engaging with our business partners and providing actionable, data\-driven insights for decision\-making. This individual should also have a passion for teaching and will serve as a trainer and coach for other statisticians across our global team. You will join a successful, multi\-talented, functional analytics team and collaborate with partners inside and outside General Mills to further the growth and impact of data science on our business. A successful candidate will have the right blend of technical skills, business acumen, influential storytelling, and collaborative spirit. **KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:** * Work with R\&D teams and internal stakeholders to solve a wide range of problems using data. This includes an emphasis on product development, quality in manufacturing, nutrition science, consumer and market research, and other scientific domains of ITQ. * Provide excellent statistical consultation in experimental and study design and analysis to scientists and engineers with appropriate methodologies. * Train, mentor, and coach other statisticians in our global team on foundational technical skills and consultative excellence. * Translate and summarize complex analyses into actionable insights and recommendations that directly solve problems and influence business decisions. * Develop statistical and machine learning models with Python, R, or other languages and tools. You will have the opportunity to scale analytics solutions for big data using Google Cloud Platform, working with a wide range of open\-source tools. Build and deploy analytics solutions to internal stakeholders with local or cloud\-based data pipelines that drive data\-driven decision\-making across the organization * **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:** * Ph.D. in Statistics or Biostatistics or relevant field * 3\+ years of work experience in a statistical scientist, statistician, statistical analyst role or related position * Demonstrated ability to define problems and deliver solutions proactively against business or technical challenges. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate and build relationships in\-person and virtually. * Strong attitude for teaching and coaching of cross\-functional partners, internal team members, and project stakeholders. * Experience in using mathematics, statistics, modeling, business analysis, and technology to transform data into advanced analytic solutions * Proficiency in SQL scripting languages, and experience with relational databases such as BigQuery and Oracle. Experience with R and Python analytics programming languages and with source code repositories such as Git. * **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:** * Work experience in food and beverage, nutrition, healthcare, or medical device applications * Experience working within a global team. * Familiarity with a cloud enterprise data and computing platform (GCP, AWS, Azure). * Experience working in an R\&D or scientific organization Experience with partnering to bring statistics to food industry applications * **ADDITIONAL CONSIDERATIONS** * International relocation or international remote working arrangements (outside of the US) will not be considered * Applicants for this position must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis. * General Mills will not sponsor applicants for this position for work visas **SALARY RANGE** The salary range for this position is: $110,800 \- $184,800 Annual At General Mills we strive for each employee's pay at any point in their career to reflect their experiences performance and skills for their current role. The salary range for this role represents the numerous factors considered in the hiring decisions including, but not limited to, educations, skills, work experience, certifications, etc. As such, pay for the successful candidate(s) could fall anywhere within the stated range. Beyond base salary, General Mills offers a competitive Total Rewards package focusing on your overall well\-being. We are proud to offer a foundation of health benefits, retirement and financial wellbeing, time off programs, wellbeing support and perks. Benefits may vary by role, country, region, union status, and other employment status factors. You may also be eligible to participate in an annual incentive program. An incentive award, if any, depends on various factors, including, individual and organizational performance. **ELIGIBILITY** Applicants must meet a minimum 18\-year age qualification. **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER (EOE)** General Mills is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital or familial status, status regarding public assistance, or membership or activity in a local human rights commission. **REASONABLE ACCOMMODATION REQUEST** If you need to request an accommodation during the application or hiring process, please fill out our online accommodation request form by following this link: Accommodation Request .

jobs.title: Front End Developer
jobs.description: **Date:** Oct 2, 2026 **Location:** Downers Grove, IL, US, 60515 **Company:** Glanbia Glanbia Performance Nutrition is a global leader in better for you products. GPN’s brand portfolio consists of **Optimum Nutrition, BSN, Isopure, Think!, Amazing Grass** and more. From athletes to remote workers, people around the world want to eat well and live healthier, more active lives. Whether you want to build muscle, reach peak performance, eat more protein\-rich foods, or lose weight, we have a product to match. Join our team as a **Front End Developer** and play a key role in bringing our brands to life online. You will collaborate with marketing, creative, and business stakeholders to build compelling web and email experiences that showcase our products and strengthen our brand presence. This is a dynamic, multi\-brand position that requires the ability to seamlessly navigate between business priorities, manage content across various CMS platforms, and maintain product catalogs for multiple eCommerce websites. **Front End Developer Responsibilities:** * Oversee the management and execution of tasks across multiple DTC sites for various brands, each on different platforms and developmental stages. * Deploy and QA digital content and promotions across multiple brands using Website \& CRM content management system platforms such as WordPress, Shopify, Emarsys, and Klaviyo. * Improve the front\-end interface of the website to enhance user experience, including navigation, layout, and overall usability, leading to increased customer satisfaction and engagement. * Manage and update the product catalog on the e\-commerce platforms, including adding new products, updating product information, and optimizing product listings for search and discovery. * Implement on\-page and technical SEO best practices to improve website visibility, organic search rankings, and traffic from search engines, resulting in increased organic traffic and revenue. * Collaborate with various stakeholders including designers, product managers, content producers, QA engineers and release engineers, driving projects throughout the development lifecycle. * Use understanding of technology and brand positioning to effectively create product and UX suggestions that balance development effort for the best ROI. * Utilize Google Analytics to analyze user behavior and propose enhancements to optimize the user experience and conversion rates. * Work cross functionally to ensure pricing, product and promo offers are up to date and fully functional across all sites. * Monitor website performance metrics, identify areas for improvement, and implement solutions to enhance website speed, responsiveness, and overall performance, ensuring a smooth and seamless browsing experience for users. * Ensure that the website is fully optimized for mobile devices, providing a seamless and user\-friendly shopping experience for mobile users and maximizing mobile conversion rates. * Develop strategies to optimize conversion rates, such as improving product page design, streamlining checkout process, and integrating persuasive call\-to\-action elements, resulting in increased sales and jobs.title: Founding Forward Deployment Engineer

Turn scattered and conflicting feedback into a clear product direction the team can build against. * **Build data integrations that hold up.** Move and reconcile SKU, inventory, transaction, and invoice data across legacy systems and modern data stacks. Handle undocumented sources, partial data, backfills, and idempotent reprocessing as a matter of course. * **Design patterns that scale.** Build integration approaches that work across customers and ERPs, not one\-off scripts. Plan for failure modes, scale, and future change before they force your hand. * **Make correctness a first\-class requirement.** Build validation, exception handling, and reconciliation into every workflow, especially where AI touches financial data. Know when an AI step shouldn't be used. Help define how Glimpse proves AI\-driven outputs to customers and auditors. * **Set the bar for good code.** Write clean, correct software. Use AI dev tools as a core part of how you work. Reason openly about tradeoffs. * **Make others better.** Unblock teammates, mentor, and build alignment across engineering, product, and customer\-facing teams. ### **What We’re Looking For:** * 5\+ years of software engineering, with real time spent in customer\-facing, solutions, or forward\-deployed work * Hands\-on experience with data pipelines and integrations against financial or operational systems (ERPs, accounting, inventory, order management) * Comfort with messy, legacy, and undocumented data sources * A track record of owning ambiguous projects from first conversation to production * Strong instincts for testing, validation, and auditability, plus a healthy skepticism about where AI belongs in a financial workflow * Daily use of AI\-assisted development tools * Clear communication in conversation, writing, code, and design docs. And you'll have real ownership: of your accounts, your outcomes, and the AM function itself as we build it from the ground up. * Competitive salary with meaningful equity * In\-person team in NYC – high ownership, fast feedback loops * Direct impact on a company growing at an exceptional pace * A front\-row seat to building the operating system for CPG brands *GLIMPSE is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. They work closely with traders, risk, finance, and technology teams to understand how data is produced and consumed and turn that understanding into reliable, well\-modeled, and well\-governed data systems. Data usage is expanding rapidly across every part of our firm, and we are building a next\-generation data platform to support it. Our existing Microsoft\-based environment gives us a strong foundation and deep understanding of our data, but much of what comes next is greenfield. You will work closely with our Principal Data Engineer to challenge and refine architectural decisions, build the platform's core components, and thoughtfully migrate existing workloads into a modern data environment. **THE SKILLSET** We are looking for someone who has built modern data systems before and understands the engineering decisions that determine whether a data platform remains reliable and maintainable as it grows. * Significant professional experience building and operating production data platforms, ideally in financial services or another environment where data accuracy has direct business consequences * Deep hands\-on experience with modern data architectures, including cloud data warehouses or lakehouses, orchestration, transformation frameworks, and streaming or event\-driven ingestion * Expert\-level SQL and strong proficiency in Python or another language used to build production data pipelines and tooling * Strong data modeling skills across analytical and operational use cases, including dimensional modeling and modern alternatives * Experience building reliable production data systems with automated testing, observability, data quality controls, CI/CD, and infrastructure\-as\-code * Working familiarity with the Microsoft data stack\-including MSSQL, SSIS, SSAS, SSRS, and Power BI\-sufficient to understand and migrate existing workloads * Ability to contribute meaningfully to architectural decisions, identify trade\-offs, and turn agreed\-upon designs into production systems * Sound judgment around implementation choices, migration sequencing, reliability, and production change risk * Strong communication skills and the ability to work directly with business users to understand how data is actually used Have you built a modern data platform and learned which decisions matter early, and which can wait? You will own one or more existing data workloads while building components of the new platform and helping establish engineering standards for ingestion, orchestration, testing, observability, and data quality. **Within 6 months**, you will have production workloads running on the new platform and established repeatable patterns for bringing additional datasets and applications onto it. This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who can reason deeply about software architecture, performance, and production behavior. **THE SKILLSET** Our production environment is primarily heavily\-optimized C\#, with C\+\+ integrated into especially performance\-sensitive components. We value demonstrated engineering ability over experience with a particular language, and we embrace agentic AI workflows as a valuable asset to our engineering approach. Our ideal Senior Software Engineer possesses the following: * Substantial professional software development experience throughout the full software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and production support * Strong software engineering instincts, treating abstraction, maintainability, testability, observability, and operational reliability as first\-class design concerns * Experience developing real\-time, high\-throughput software for electronic trading, financial markets, or another performance\-sensitive production environment * Ability to lead technical design discussions, make pragmatic architectural decisions, mentor other developers, and improve engineering standards across the team * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders * A bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience Are you equally comfortable designing new systems in a distributed architecture, reasoning about performance tradeoffs, and diagnosing difficult production issues? Do you take ownership of systems after they are deployed? Can you raise the technical standard of a team while continuing to write and deliver high\-quality software? If yes, you may be a strong fit for this Senior Software Engineer position. **WHAT TO EXPECT AS A SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER** **Within 1 month,** you will complete your initial orientation and begin developing a working understanding of our options market\-making business, trading systems, and production technology environment. You will become familiar with our codebases, system architecture, historical and real\-time data, deployment processes, monitoring tools, and risk controls. You will build working relationships with traders, developers, quantitative researchers, and infrastructure engineers, begin participating in technical design and code reviews, and make initial contributions to the production system. **Within 3 months,** you will take end\-to\-end ownership of a meaningful trading\-system enhancement. This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product\-market fit and world\-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you. At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started. **Role Overview** ================= Harvey's Finance Engineering team is the investment\-side counterpart to our Legal Engineering team: former investment professionals who bring real deal experience to Harvey's prospects and customers. Forward Deployed Finance Engineers lead discovery, demos, pilots, trainings, onboarding, and custom builds alongside our AEs and CSMs. They translate real investment work into Harvey solutions, serving as the trust layer across the entire customer lifecycle, from the first pilot to the most complex, custom\-built workflow. Finance Engineers work on Harvey Deals, a new product built off of Harvey's acquisition of Benchmark. Harvey Deals is where investment teams run their deals — screening, underwriting, diligence, and committee materials — built in the firm's own templates and formats, with every figure traceable back to the document it came from. Harvey works with 150\+ asset management firms and analyzes 178M\+ documents each month; the Finance Engineering team is how that capability meets the way deal teams actually work. Finance Engineers understand how investors think and work, and use that expertise to design, build, and refine solutions that hold up under live deal pressure. In doing so, they don't just drive adoption; they shape Harvey's product roadmap, ensuring every release is grounded in what investment teams actually need. It's a team built to make Harvey the platform investment teams can trust with their most important work. This role is the first Finance Engineer dedicated to private credit. You will build the credit playbook — demo library, workflow templates, use cases — while running live pilots, and lead the credit practice as the team grows. You may be asked to travel around 2–3\+ times per month. Travel is always for a significant business need and typically is for 1–3 days at a time. **What you'll do** ================== Forward Deployed Finance Engineers on the private credit team are former credit investors who left the desk to help build the future of how credit gets underwritten. Working closely with Account Executives, they engage with direct lenders, opportunistic and specialty finance managers, BDC managers, and insurer credit arms throughout the pre\-sales process and stay with them well past it — leading pilots on live opportunities, guiding lenders through what's possible with AI, and sitting down with credit teams to build screening, underwriting, and credit committee workflows in the firm's own templates and formats. The work is the work they did on the desk: lender presentation and CIM review; QoE read\-throughs and data pack analysis; cash flow and leverage modeling; sizing and structuring; covenant and credit agreement review; credit memo drafting; and comps. It continues post\-close into compliance certificate review, covenant tracking, amendment and waiver analysis, and quarterly portfolio reporting, so value compounds after the first deal. Along the way, Finance Engineers bring credit\-team feedback back into the product, helping shape the future of Harvey. **What you have** ================= * 3\+ years on the investment or underwriting team at a direct lender, private credit fund, BDC manager, or insurer private credit arm, with demonstrated ownership of live deal work: screening, underwriting, diligence workstreams, modeling, structuring, and drafting credit committee materials. Asset\-based and specialty finance backgrounds are welcome. Leveraged finance, restructuring advisory, or rating\-agency experience before the principal side is welcome, but principal\-side deal execution is required. * Strong command of the documents and data that drive a credit decision — lender presentation and CIM, QoE and data pack, model, credit agreement and intercreditor, compliance certificates — and an instinct for where the numbers and the paper disagree. * Advanced Excel and financial modeling, comfort with prompting and agentic AI workflows, and a builder's instinct for turning a repeated manual process into a repeatable automation. Python, SQL, or experience building internal tools is a plus. * Executive presence and relationship\-building skills, with the ability to establish credibility from analysts and associates through to partners and credit committee members. * Outstanding communication and presentation skills — comfortable leading a live demo, facilitating a workshop, or holding your own in a technical conversation about a covenant package or an underwriting assumption. * Deep curiosity about AI's potential to transform investment work, paired with a practical, solutions\-oriented mindset and bias toward action. * Track record partnering with senior stakeholders to drive results, with curiosity for testing approaches and optimizing for customer outcomes. * Customer\-facing or commercial experience (LP or investor relations, capital formation, banking coverage, business development) and/or hands\-on experience using AI tools in an investment setting are pluses. **Compensation** ================ $254,600 \- $381,800 USD OTE 75/25 ### **Depending on your location, an Applicant Privacy Notice may apply to you. jobs.title: Solutions Manager
jobs.description: Solutions Manager District of Columbia, District of Columbia **Job Summary** --------------- As an Agentic Forward Deployed Engineer, you operate at the front line of delivery \- embedded with the client, turning ambiguous business problems into production agents, fast. Your deliverable is Business Transformation Agents: autonomous and multi\-agent systems that automate and reimagine real business processes such as invoice disputes, procurement approvals, onboarding, claims and compliance workflows. You own each agent end to end \-conceptualize, build, integrate, evaluate, deploy, and sustain \- and you lead a small team to do the same. You build exclusively in Python using agent development kits, and you bring Agentic AI capabilities to life inside the client's world, with Responsible AI, evaluation and security as non\-negotiables. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Technology mandate** ---------------------- **Language:** Python preferable **Frameworks:** Agent Development Kits (ADKs) ; e.g. Google ADK, LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, AWS Bedrock AgentCore, Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel. Framework choice follows the engagement; the discipline is the same. **Models:** Multi\-LLM via the kit (e.g. Claude on Bedrock, Gemini, Azure OpenAI), selected per use case for quality, latency and cost. **Interfaces:** Tools and Model Context Protocol (MCP) for integration; standards\-based APIs and secure auth for client systems. * **Conceptualize fast:** embed with stakeholders, frame a business process as an agentic solution, and stand up a working agent prototype in days, not weeks. * **Build Business Transformation Agents:** design and ship single\-agent and multi\-agent systems in Python using ADKs that automate and transform real client workflows, with measurable ROI. * **Own efficiency as the scorecard:** drive delivery efficiency and operational efficiency ; shorter cycle times, less manual effort, higher accuracy, lower cost\-to\-serve. * **Engineer the agent core:** apply prompt engineering, context engineering, prompt caching, RAG / context\-graph retrieval, memory, tool / function calling, MCP integration and multi\-agent orchestration. * **Integrate to standards:** connect agents into client ecosystems through proven integration patterns, standards\-based APIs and secure authentication. * **Make reusability and predictability the default:** build reusable agent components, skills, tool libraries and templates; add guardrails so agent behaviour is predictable, safe and repeatable. * **Prototype and iterate quickly:** use the kit's scaffolding to prototype, then harden to production\-grade, well\-tested Python. * **Run eval\-driven development:** build evaluation harnesses and test suites that measure agent correctness, safety and regression before anything ships. * **Own AgentOps / DevSecOps:** CI/CD for agents, versioning, observability and telemetry, shift\-left security, and Responsible AI governance baked in from day one. * **Run a continuous, adaptable feedback loop:** feed production telemetry, evals and client feedback back into prompts, context and agent design. * **Stay ahead of the curve:** adopt evolving agent frameworks and patterns quickly, and bring field learnings back to the practice. * **Lead and mentor:** set technical direction for a lean team of 3 agent engineers, raise the engineering bar, and grow the pod's agentic capability. **Skill Requirements** ---------------------- * **Strong Python engineering ;** idiomatic, typed, tested and packaged code; on a foundation of solid software engineering principles (design, version control, architecture). * **Hands\-on agent building** with at least one agent development kit (Google ADK, LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, AWS Bedrock AgentCore or Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel). * **Solid command of agent engineering:** prompt engineering, context engineering, prompt caching, RAG / context graphs, tool / function calling, MCP, and multi\-agent orchestration. * **Eval\-driven development:** designing evaluation harnesses and measuring agent quality, safety and reliability. * **Standards\-based integration and DevSecOps:** APIs, secure auth, CI/CD, observability and AgentOps. * **Ability to conceptualize a business problem as an agent quickly,** and operate effectively in ambiguous, customer\-embedded settings. * **Client\-facing maturity:** translates fluidly between technical and non\-technical stakeholders, and owns outcomes. **Experience mentoring or leading** small engineering teams. **Other Requirements** ---------------------- * **Fluency across multiple ADKs** and the judgment to pick the right one per engagement. * **Deploying agents to managed runtimes** at enterprise scale (e.g. Vertex AI Agent Engine, Bedrock AgentCore) with governance and cost control. * **Domain depth** in a transformation area \- finance operations, supply chain, HR, claims or compliance. * **Experience with an** enterprise agent platform, including Responsible AI and governance at scale. * **A track record of turning agents into reusable accelerators** or IP adopted beyond a single engagement. Maximum Salary (US): 250000 Minimum Salary (US): 145000
