jobs.title: Forward Deployed Marketer
jobs.description: **ABOUT MINERVA** ----------------- Minerva builds AI for marketing leaders. Our platform lets marketers focus on telling the story of their brand while AI agents handle the operationally intensive work: data management, segment creation, analytics, measurement and reporting. Everything is built on Minerva’s proprietary consumer graph: an identity and attribute layer covering 270M\+ U.S. consumers across 2,000\+ through\-time attributes. On top of it sit two agentic systems built in partnership with OpenAI: an Agentic Data Engineer that unifies and standardizes a brand’s first\-party data in hours, and an Agentic Data Scientist that trains robust targeting models at scale. Together, our data and platform improve the quality of a brand’s first\-party data, lift campaign performance and give marketing teams their time back. We work with leading consumer brands across categories, including the NBA, Capital One, Hard Rock Stadium Group / Miami Dolphins, Wander and Trust \& Will. We’ve raised $20M from The General Partnership, 8VC, Lingotto, NBA Investments, Topology Ventures, Future Positive, Background Capital and many others. Our team brings together operators and investors from Citadel, Dentsu, Bridgewater, Meta Superintelligence and Lazard, alongside researchers from Berkeley, MIT, Stanford and Cambridge. **THE ROLE** ------------ An agent that can do almost anything has the same problem as a blank page. Someone has to decide what it does first. Minerva’s agents can unify a brand’s data, build the audience, train data science models and read the measurement. For a VP of Marketing with a quarter to hit, that range is the hard part. Which use case proves value inside a pilot? Which one comes second? You make that call. You scope every pilot, pick the campaign that will move a real number, and show the customer everything else Minerva can do, so the next request comes from them. This is a senior individual contributor seat with no direct reports. You’ll work directly with the founders, alongside our account executives and forward deployed engineers. **WHAT YOU’LL DO** ------------------ * **Scope every pilot.** Sit in pre\-sale with the AE and pick the use case that will move a brand\-side number inside the trial window. * **Make the call when a number isn’t moving.** Every brand’s first\-party data is shaped by its own history. You tell a data problem from a definition problem, send the first to our FDEs and fix the second yourself. * **Build the first use case with their marketing team.** That means a live audience, activated and measured. You’re done when they run the second one without you. * **Show them the whole map.** Prove one thing first, then make sure the customer knows everything else Minerva can do for them. * **Design what doesn’t exist yet.** When a customer wants something we have no play for, you design it and the account team sells it. * **Generalize the motion.** For each vertical, work out which use case goes first, which audience definitions survive a real campaign, and what the VP needs to see in week two. * **Feed product the specific thing.** What you reached for in the middle of real work shapes what we build next. **WHAT YOU HAVE** ----------------- * **You’ve owned a brand’s marketing outcome.** A campaign or a whole function, with the target and the result in your name. Agency\-side counts if the client’s number was yours. Supporting the person who owned it doesn’t. * **You understand the full cycle,** from strategy through audience, activation and measurement, and you can speak to every stage without handing off. * **You know enough about data to diagnose.** You don’t need to fix a broken pipeline, but you can tell when one is the problem. * **Agent\-native.** You already do a team’s work with AI and can show us the workflows. We test for this live in the loop. * Located in or willing to relocate to New York City. **YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU ARE…** ---------------------------------- * A **client lead at a performance or lifecycle agency** who has owned outcomes across several brands and is tired of handing off the recommendation. * A **growth or lifecycle lead at a consumer brand** who has run the full cycle on one brand’s data and wants to do it across many. * A **strategy consultant who went in\-house** and found they’d rather own the number than advise on it. * A **solutions lead at a marketing data platform** who came up in marketing and wants to own the outcome, not the implementation. * Or you don’t fit any of these neatly, but you can name the number you moved for a brand and walk us through every stage. Apply. **NICE TO HAVES** ----------------- * **SQL,** even basic. This is the highest\-slope accelerant for this seat. **WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE** --------------------------- * **First 90 days:** you’re on every pilot scoping call. At least one brand\-side number has moved because of a use case you designed, and one vertical has a written playbook. * **First 6 months:** you can name the number you moved on every account you deployed this quarter. At least one expansion exists because you designed something new. The roadmap carries items that trace back to you. * **The number you own:** brand\-side outcomes moved per deployed account, per quarter. **COMPENSATION** ---------------- $175,000–$220,000 base salary, depending on experience. Early\-stage equity. Medical, dental and vision. **Apply:** hiring@minerva.io \+ cc justin@minerva.io \| Subject: Forward Deployed Marketer Candidate Skip the cover letter. Send us one marketing outcome you owned, for a campaign or a whole function: the number, what you built and what happened. If you were agency\-side, tell us the client’s number and which part of it was yours. Applications without a number won’t be reviewed.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer - Enterprise AI Platforms & Infrastructure Director
jobs.description: **Join the Team Modernizing Medicine** At **ModMed**, we’re not just building software—we’re reimagining the healthcare experience. Founded in 2010 by a practicing physician and a successful tech entrepreneur, we took a radically different approach: **we hired doctors and taught them how to code.** This "for doctors, by doctors" philosophy has allowed us to create an AI\-enabled, specialty\-specific cloud platform that places patients at the center of care. **A Culture of Excellence** When you join ModMed, you’re joining an award\-winning team recognized for innovation and employee satisfaction. From our global headquarters in Boca Raton Florida, and extensive employee base in Hyderabad India, we are a team of 4,500\+ passionate problem\-solvers on a mission to increase medical practice success and improve patient outcomes: * **Consistently ranked as a Top Place to Work** * **2025 Globee Business Awards:** Gold Globee for “Technology Team of the Year” * **2025 Black Book Awards:** Ranked \#1 EHR in 11 Specialties * **Florida Venture Forum:** Venture\-Backed Company of the Year We are growing fast, thinking big, and we are just getting started. **Ready to modernize medicine with us?** **Job Description Summary:** The **Staff Engineer \- Enterprise AI Platforms \& Infrastructure** is the dedicated technical owner for Claude Enterprise and ModMed's enterprise AI infrastructure, responsible for transitioning these capabilities from distributed, part\-time ownership into a scalable enterprise platform operating model. The role initially leads the technical deployment and operation of Claude Enterprise and Claude Code, establishing the identity, security, endpoint, policy, integration, monitoring, and operational foundations required for enterprise adoption. The role then expands those capabilities into a broader enterprise AI platform that securely connects AI assistants and agents to ModMed applications, APIs, data platforms, and business systems through reusable infrastructure and governed services. **Your Role:** **Claude Enterprise Platform Engineering \& Operations:** Owns the technical architecture, deployment, migration, configuration, and ongoing operation of Claude Enterprise and Claude Code across ModMed. Responsibilities include enterprise identity and SSO integration, domain configuration, user provisioning, role and permission design, endpoint configuration, enterprise policy enforcement, usage/spending controls, security configurations, deployment standards, and operational support. Establishes the migration path from individually managed or unmanaged Claude/Claude Code usage into the governed enterprise environment. **Enterprise AI Infrastructure \& Platform Engineering:** Designs, builds, and operates the shared infrastructure required to support enterprise AI platforms, assistants, agents, and AI\-enabled applications. Establishes reusable capabilities for authentication, authorization, secrets management, networking, API access, service discovery, policy enforcement, logging, deployment, and runtime operations. Builds infrastructure\-as\-code, deployment pipelines, configuration standards, runbooks, and reference architectures. **MCP Gateway, AI Gateway \& Enterprise Connectivity:** Builds and operates ModMed's enterprise MCP and AI connectivity infrastructure, including the MCP gateway and related services. Federates enterprise MCP servers and connectors behind governed infrastructure and establishes repeatable patterns for connecting AI platforms to enterprise applications, APIs, data platforms, and services. Owns platform deployment, networking, TLS/certificates, authentication flows, scaling, availability, upgrades, and disaster recovery. **AI Identity, Access \& Platform Security Engineering:** Engineers the identity and access architecture supporting enterprise AI platforms and agents. Integrates AI infrastructure with enterprise IAM, including Okta, OAuth/OIDC, scoped tokens, service identities, user\-to\-agent attribution, secrets management, and least\-privilege access. Partners with Security, Privacy, and Compliance to translate policy requirements into enforceable technical platform controls. **Platform Observability, Reliability \& Operation**s: Establishes enterprise monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, usage telemetry, capacity management, and operational health standards across AI infrastructure. Defines service\-level expectations and monitors platform availability, latency, errors, utilization, authentication failures, connector health, and consumption. Leads technical incident response, root\-cause analysis, lifecycle management, upgrades, and operational improvement. **AI Platform Architecture \& Technical Roadmap:** Defines and maintains ModMed's enterprise AI platform and infrastructure architecture and technical roadmap. Evaluates emerging AI infrastructure technologies and determines how capabilities such as Claude Enterprise, AWS Bedrock, MCP, AI gateways, Databricks AI capabilities, cloud services, and enterprise application integrations fit into the target architecture. Creates reference architectures and platform standards that enable teams to consume AI capabilities without rebuilding foundational services. **Skills \& Requirements:** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cyber Security, AI, Applied AI or related. * 10\+ years in platform/infrastructure or security engineering, with demonstrated deep hands\-on delivery at a IAM and OAuth/OIDC; API gateways; cloud (GCP and/or AWS); infrastructure\-as\-code; observability/monitoring; security and compliance frameworks (HIPAA, SOC 2\); scripting/automation. ***ModMed Benefits Highlight:*** At ModMed, we believe it’s important to offer a competitive benefits package designed to meet the diverse needs of our growing workforce. Eligible Modernizers can enroll in a wide range of benefits: **United States** * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, including a company Health Savings Account contribution, * 401(k): ModMed provides a matching contribution each payday of 50% of your contribution deferred on up to 6% of your compensation. After one year of employment with ModMed, 100% of any matching contribution you receive is yours to keep. * Generous Paid Time Off and Paid Parental Leave programs, * Company paid Life and Disability benefits, Flexible Spending Account, and Employee Assistance Programs, * Company\-sponsored Business Resource \& Special Interest Groups that provide engaged and supportive communities within ModMed, * Professional development opportunities, including tuition reimbursement programs and unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning, * Global presence and in\-person collaboration opportunities; dog\-friendly HQ (US), Hybrid office\-based roles and remote availability for some roles, * Weekly catered breakfast and lunch, treadmill workstations, Zen, and wellness rooms within our BRIC headquarters. **PHISHING SCAM WARNING:** ModMed is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving imposters posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews," and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from ModMed without a formal interview process, and valid communications from our hiring team will come from our employees with a ModMed email address (first.lastname@modmed.com). Please check senders’ email addresses carefully. Additionally, ModMed will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you are receiving communications as described above, please report them to the FTC website.

PowerPoint and Word) **Responsibilities:** The responsibilities of the Mining Engineer include but are not limited to: * Responsible for effective coordination of daily mining operations to ensure jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** The Lead Software Engineer is a senior technical contributor and customer\-facing engineering leader responsible for the architecture, design, development, delivery, and support of embedded firmware and system software for custom hardware platforms. This working lead position combines hands\-on coding, debugging, testing, and hardware bring\-up with technical leadership and direct customer engagement. The role translates customer needs into reliable, maintainable software solutions and provides technical direction to team members across the full product lifecycle. **What You Will Do** · Lead the architecture, design, development, testing, and maintenance of embedded firmware and system software for custom hardware platforms. · Use modern development, automation, and AI\-assisted engineering tools responsibly to improve delivery speed, code quality, test coverage, documentation, and debugging effectiveness. · Be the lead voice actively involved in implementation by writing, reviewing, testing, debugging, and optimizing production\-quality embedded software for the software team. · Serve as a primary software technical interface for customers during requirements discussions, design reviews, project updates, troubleshooting, and solution development. · Translate customer business needs, use cases, and application requirements into practical software architectures, technical designs, estimates, and feature implementations. · Create and clearly articulate software architectures from high\-level product designs, including key interfaces, dependencies, risks, tradeoffs, and implementation plans. · Lead technical design reviews and guide software decisions so solutions are scalable, testable, maintainable, secure, and aligned with customer and product requirements. · Take ownership of critical software components and deliver complete solutions within agreed schedules and engineering\-hour estimates. · Lead root\-cause analysis and resolution of complex product, integration, field, and customer issues while clearly communicating impact, status, approach, and expected effort. · Support new product introduction, board bring\-up, system integration, verification, validation, manufacturing readiness, deployment, and post\-release support. · Work closely with electrical engineering and QA to define interfaces, test strategies, acceptance criteria, diagnostics, and defect\-resolution plans. · Establish and reinforce software development best practices, coding standards, architecture documentation, peer review, configuration management, and verification processes. · Provide day\-to\-day technical guidance and mentorship to software engineers and global team members while promoting clear ownership and timely, high\-quality delivery. · Communicate proactively with customers and internal stakeholders, identify design gaps and risks early, and drive issues to resolution. **What We Are Looking For** · Demonstrated experience designing and developing touch screen based customer facing software, embedded firmware or system software for custom electronic products and hardware platforms. · Background and interest in using AI tools as a primary part of executing and improving daily work and planning. · Strong hands\-on proficiency in embedded software development, debugging, testing, code review, and maintenance using languages and tools appropriate to the product environment. · Ability to work close to the hardware and diagnose issues across firmware, software, electronics, communications, timing, interfaces, and system\-integration boundaries. · Experience defining software architecture, decomposing requirements, producing technical designs, estimating effort, and leading implementation from concept through release. · Strong customer\-facing communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts, guide design discussions, clarify tradeoffs, respond to concerns, and build confidence with technical and non\-technical stakeholders. · Proven ownership mindset with the ability to independently drive ambiguous or complex problems toward a verified resolution. · Ability to lead through technical influence, provide constructive feedback, mentor engineers, and coordinate effectively with U.S. and international engineering teams. · Experience collaborating with electrical engineering, QA, manufacturing, product management, and project management throughout the embedded product lifecycle. · Strong working knowledge of maintainable design, source control, peer review, defect tracking, automated or structured testing, documentation, and release discipline. · Ability to prioritize competing technical and customer needs while delivering on time and within estimated engineering effort. · Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, software engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Why Join NTX Embedded · Direct influence on customer\-facing embedded products used in demanding industrial and commercial environments. · Meaningful ownership of software architecture, implementation, customer solutions, and product outcomes. · Close collaboration with customers, company leadership, and global engineering, quality, manufacturing, and operations teams. · Opportunity to improve embedded software practices, technical leadership, development automation, and AI\-assisted engineering across NTX programs. **Location and Work Environment** This is an on\-site position in Carrollton, Texas, in a customer\-facing product\-development environment. *NTX Embedded is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law. Candidates who require an accommodation to apply may contact operations@ntxembedded.com.* Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $130,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) 4% Match * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid holidays Work Location: In person

solid understanding of Advance Operating Systems, Advance Database, Computer Architecture and Distributed systems. * AI / ML Fluency: Experience developing AI/ML applications, integrating with various features and applications. * Proven record of designing scalable, secure solutions for products. **Ways to stand out from the crowd:** * Experience programming and debugging skills for SOC platforms with experience on various devices, across x86 \& ARM system architecture. * In depth knowledge on Linux and / or Windows OS, Networking, virtualization. * Demonstrated proficiency in C/C\+\+ along jobs.title: Associate Director, Billing Strategy - Denials & Appeals
jobs.description: **Associate Director, Billing Strategy – Denials \& Appeals** ============================================================= **Position Summary** -------------------- Natera is seeking an Associate Director, Billing Strategy – Denials \& Appeals to lead the strategy, performance, and optimization of denied claims and appeals. This is a senior individual contributor role responsible for shaping denial management strategy, driving payer advocacy, and partnering cross\-functionally to improve reimbursement outcomes. This role will also play a key part in supporting automation initiatives across denial and appeals workflows—translating operational expertise into system logic and partnering with engineering and vendors to scale processes through technology. The Associate Director will oversee this function from three angles: * Operational: Oversight and performance management of outsourced RCM teams handling denials and appeals. * Analytical: Root cause analysis and data\-driven insights to improve denial rates and recovery. * Technical: Defining and supporting system enhancements and automation strategies tied to denial workflows. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **Strategy \& Payer Advocacy** * Lead denial management and appeals strategy across all payer types. * Define and track overturn rates, appeal timelines, and recovery performance. * Act as an internal expert on payer policies and medical necessity criteria for laboratory testing. * Interpret payer policies and guide teams on defending medical necessity in appeals. * Identify payer behavior patterns to inform contracting strategy and escalation pathways. ### **Operations \& Root Cause Analysis** * Partner with eligibility, prior authorization, coding, and billing teams to proactively prevent denials. * Audit BPO/vendor performance using data to identify workflow gaps, enforce accountability, and drive improvements. * Develop job aids and standardized workflows to improve consistency and quality. * Analyze denial trends to distinguish between avoidable operational issues and systemic or payer\-driven challenges. ### **Data, Systems \& Automation** * Translate denial and appeals workflows into system logic, partnering with engineering and vendors to support automation buildout. * Define requirements for rules\-based workflows, denial routing, and appeal triggers within billing systems (e.g., AMD). * Support automation initiatives (e.g., rules engines, RPA, AI\-driven workflows) by providing domain expertise and guiding design decisions. * Lead UAT and QA for system changes, ensuring outputs align with payer policy and real\-world denial scenarios. * Identify opportunities to reduce manual work by transitioning denial and appeal processes toward scalable, low\-touch or unattended workflows. * Proactively identify edge cases, failure points, and gaps in automation logic before and after deployment. * Analyze datasets using tools such as Power BI, SQL, Excel, or Snowflake to quantify denial drivers and financial impact. **Qualifications** ------------------ ### **Required** * 8–12\+ years of experience in healthcare Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), with deep focus on denials and appeals. * Expertise in laboratory billing, CPT coding, and reimbursement methodologies. * Strong knowledge of commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, and managed care payer policies. * Demonstrated success improving appeal overturn rates and resolving medical necessity denials. * Experience working with BPO or offshore RCM vendors. * Strong analytical skills with experience using tools such as Power BI, Excel, SQL, or Snowflake. * Experience leading cross\-functional initiatives and influencing stakeholders without direct authority. ### **Preferred** * Experience supporting automation initiatives in revenue cycle (e.g., rules engines, RPA, or workflow automation tools). * Experience partnering with engineering teams or vendors to implement billing system enhancements. * Familiarity with AI\-driven workflow concepts (e.g., intelligent routing, decisioning) in an operational setting. * Experience with AMD or similar billing platforms. * Experience with tools such as Jira or similar workflow tracking systems. **Key Traits for Success** -------------------------- * Investigative: Relentless in understanding why denials occur and how to prevent or overturn them. * Systems Thinker: Able to connect operational workflows with system logic and automation opportunities. * Data\-Driven: Uses data to inform decisions and influence stakeholders. * Cross\-Functional Operator: Effectively partners with engineering, operations, and leadership teams. * Builder Mindset: Proactive in identifying opportunities and driving improvements with a high degree of ownership. * Low Ego, High Accountability: Focused on outcomes and team success over individual recognition. **OUR OPPORTUNITY** Natera™ is a global leader in cell\-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women's health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives. The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world\-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you'll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you'll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management. **WHAT WE OFFER** Competitive Benefits \- Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program! For more information, visit www.natera.com. Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws. *If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents.* Link: https://www.natera.com/notice\-of\-data\-collection\-california\-residents/ Please be advised that Natera will reach out to candidates with a @natera.com email domain ONLY. Email communications from all other domain names are not from Natera or its employees and are fraudulent. Natera does not request interviews via text messages and does not ask for personal information until a candidate has engaged with the company and has spoken to a recruiter and the hiring team. Natera takes cyber crimes seriously, and will collaborate with law enforcement authorities to prosecute any related cyber crimes. For more information: * BBB announcement on job scams * FBI Cyber Crime resource page

This role will also play a key part in supporting automation initiatives across denial and appeals workflows—translating operational expertise into system logic and partnering with engineering and vendors to scale processes through technology. The Associate Director will oversee this function from three angles: * Operational: Oversight and performance management of outsourced RCM teams handling denials and appeals. * Analytical: Root cause analysis and data\-driven insights to improve denial rates and recovery. * Technical: Defining and supporting system enhancements and automation strategies tied to denial workflows. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **Strategy \& Payer Advocacy** * Lead denial management and appeals strategy across all payer types. * Define and track overturn rates, appeal timelines, and recovery performance. * Act as an internal expert on payer policies and medical necessity criteria for laboratory testing. * Interpret payer policies and guide teams on defending medical necessity in appeals. * Identify payer behavior patterns to inform contracting strategy and escalation pathways. ### **Operations \& Root Cause Analysis** * Partner with eligibility, prior authorization, coding, and billing teams to proactively prevent denials. * Audit BPO/vendor performance using data to identify workflow gaps, enforce accountability, and drive improvements. * Develop job aids and standardized workflows to improve consistency and quality. * Analyze denial trends to distinguish between avoidable operational issues and systemic or payer\-driven challenges. ### **Data, Systems \& Automation** * Translate denial and appeals workflows into system logic, partnering with engineering and vendors to support automation buildout. * Define requirements for rules\-based workflows, denial routing, and appeal triggers within billing systems (e.g., AMD). * Support automation initiatives (e.g., rules engines, RPA, AI\-driven workflows) by providing domain expertise and guiding design decisions. * Lead UAT and QA for system changes, ensuring outputs align with payer policy and real\-world denial scenarios. * Identify opportunities to reduce manual work by transitioning denial and appeal processes toward scalable, low\-touch or unattended workflows. * Proactively identify edge cases, failure points, and gaps in automation logic before and after deployment. * Analyze datasets using tools such as Power BI, SQL, Excel, or Snowflake to quantify denial drivers and financial impact. **Qualifications** ------------------ ### **Required** * 8–12\+ years of experience in healthcare Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), with deep focus on denials and appeals. * Expertise in laboratory billing, CPT coding, and reimbursement methodologies. * Strong knowledge of commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, and managed care payer policies. * Demonstrated success improving appeal overturn rates and resolving medical necessity denials. * Experience working with BPO or offshore RCM vendors. * Strong analytical skills with experience using tools such as Power BI, Excel, SQL, or Snowflake. * Experience leading cross\-functional initiatives and influencing stakeholders without direct authority. ### **Preferred** * Experience supporting automation initiatives in revenue cycle (e.g., rules engines, RPA, or workflow automation tools). * Experience partnering with engineering teams or vendors to implement billing system enhancements. * Familiarity with AI\-driven workflow concepts (e.g., intelligent routing, decisioning) in an operational setting. * Experience with AMD or similar billing platforms. * Experience with tools such as Jira or similar workflow tracking systems. **Key Traits for Success** -------------------------- * Investigative: Relentless in understanding why denials occur and how to prevent or overturn them. * Systems Thinker: Able to connect operational workflows with system logic and automation opportunities. * Data\-Driven: Uses data to inform decisions and influence stakeholders. * Cross\-Functional Operator: Effectively partners with engineering, operations, and leadership teams. * Builder Mindset: Proactive in identifying opportunities and driving improvements with a high degree of ownership. * Low Ego, High Accountability: Focused on outcomes and team success over individual recognition. **OUR OPPORTUNITY** Natera™ is a global leader in cell\-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women's health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives. The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world\-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you'll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you'll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management. **WHAT WE OFFER** Competitive Benefits \- Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program! For more information, visit www.natera.com. Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws. *If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents.* Link: https://www.natera.com/notice\-of\-data\-collection\-california\-residents/ Please be advised that Natera will reach out to candidates with a @natera.com email domain ONLY. Email communications from all other domain names are not from Natera or its employees and are fraudulent. Natera does not request interviews via text messages and does not ask for personal information until a candidate has engaged with the company and has spoken to a recruiter and the hiring team. Natera takes cyber crimes seriously, and will collaborate with law enforcement authorities to prosecute any related cyber crimes. For more information: * BBB announcement on job scams * FBI Cyber Crime resource page

jobs.title: Regulatory Affairs Advisor
jobs.description: **POSITION SUMMARY** **Title:** Regulatory Advisor \- FDA Pharma \& IVDR Natera is a clinical genetic testing company specializing in non\-invasive, cell\-free DNA (cfDNA) and liquid biopsy testing. The Regulatory Advisor plays a key role in developing and driving regulatory strategy on behalf of the regulatory affairs (RA) team, specifically focusing on FDA Pharma and IVDR initiatives. At Natera, we remember there is a person behind every sample. This role combines strong technical knowledge and an understanding of regulatory requirements (US FDA, CAP/CLIA/NYS, EU, or Japan) to support the approval and registration of products that proactively inform disease management. You will represent the RA team to internal and external stakeholders through written and verbal communication. This role maintains product registrations, change assessments, post\-market surveillance reports, and records of communication with regulatory authorities. You will support the overall effectiveness of the RA team through contributions to staff development, process improvements, and maintaining a deep understanding of current regulatory requirements in the evolving diagnostics landscape. **PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES** * Represent the regulatory function on designated cross\-functional teams. * Conduct business interactions with customers and regulatory authorities regarding regulatory pathways, performance claims, supporting data, and labeling in the context of submissions or registrations. * Build and execute bold, practical regulatory strategies for complex regulatory affairs programs, with a heavy emphasis on FDA Pharma, IVDR, and In Vitro Diagnostic (IVD) systems. * Advocate for the least burdensome approaches to product clearance and approval while strictly interpreting and adhering to regulatory requirements. * Coordinate and prepare regulatory submissions with minimal supervision, including EU/IVD/IVDR Technical Documentation, classification requests, pre\-submissions, 510(k) premarket notifications, investigational device exemptions, NYS DoH submissions, and critical worldwide registrations. * Mentor regulatory associates and support their career advancement. * Deliver training on regulatory topics across internal teams. * Lead cross\-functional teams to address major regulatory changes, compliance with new registration requirements, or process improvements. * Contribute to setting individual and departmental annual goals aligned with business objectives. * Review and ensure regulatory compliance of advertising, promotion, and labeling across a common product line. * Take personal accountability for identifying gaps in processes and proactively build data\-driven solutions to improve them. * Evaluate product changes for global regulatory submission impact. * May lead small teams. * Other duties as assigned. **QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor's degree in a life science field (biology, microbiology, chemistry, engineering, medical technology, regulatory science, etc.) or equivalent. Advanced degree in life sciences (MS, PhD, etc.) and/or MBA preferred. * Regulatory Affairs Certification (RAC) preferred. * Minimum of 8\+ years of direct applicable regulatory experience in medical devices, laboratory\-developed tests (LDTs), or pharma. * Direct experience with FDA Pharma and IVDR submissions is highly preferred. * Experience in Organ Health or Women's Health diagnostics is ideal and strongly preferred. * In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD) and Companion Diagnostics (CDx) experience is a plus. * PMA experience preferred. **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES** * Working knowledge of U.S. and EU Medical Device/IVD/IVDR, FDA Pharma, and/or laboratory developed test regulatory requirements. * Proactive, self\-directed, and highly engaged. * Emphasis on talent development and team building. * Use sound scientific judgment to solve problems and make decisions even when rigid policies do not exist. * Manage multiple projects with urgency, staying organized and focused on delivering results. * Demonstrated ability to effectively formulate and drive change. * Experienced in continuous improvement projects, project management, and product development processes. * Thrive in ambiguity by navigating rapid change and actively building structure and standard operating procedures where they are missing. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate across cultures, work effectively with technical and scientific personnel, and negotiate clearly with Regulators. * Computer literacy (PC, Microsoft Word/Excel/PowerPoint). **OUR OPPORTUNITY** Natera™ is a global leader in cell\-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women's health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives. The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world\-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you'll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you'll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management. **WHAT WE OFFER** Competitive Benefits \- Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program! Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide. jobs.title: BESS Engineer 1 (Controls)
jobs.description: **BESS Engineer 1 (Controls)** **Job Description** **Position Type:** Full\-Time **Travel Requirement:** Required **Job Location:** Multistate **About Us** **National Electrical Engineering Consultants (NEEC)** provides full\-service engineering and field support for utilities and renewable developers across the United States. Our core expertise includes **Protection \& Control (P\&C) Substations, Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), Solar, and Renewable Energy Integration.** NEEC’s commissioning team ensures that every system operates safely, efficiently, and in compliance with the highest industry standards. **About the Role** This is a full\-time, field\-based role for a BESS Engineer I supporting NEEC projects throughout the United States. The role supports the testing, commissioning, startup, troubleshooting, and technical verification of utility\-scale Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS). Candidates with backgrounds in controls, industrial automation, electrical engineering, instrumentation, mechatronics, or PLC/SCADA systems are strongly encouraged to apply. Previous BESS experience is preferred but not required. **Key Responsibilities** * Support the testing, commissioning, startup, troubleshooting, and maintenance of utility\-scale Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS). * Assist with testing and verification of BESS equipment, including battery systems, PCS/inverters, transformers, switchgear, auxiliary power systems, fire suppression systems, thermal management systems, and associated controls and communications. * Perform electrical and functional testing using approved procedures, drawings, and appropriate test equipment. * Troubleshoot electrical, mechanical, communication, and control\-related issues and assist with identifying root causes and corrective actions. * Read and interpret single\-line diagrams, electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, control schematics, I/O lists, network drawings, and technical documentation. * Verify and document power, communication, and control signals between BESS equipment and associated systems. * Support point\-to\-point checks, I/O verification, functional testing, and system validation during commissioning. * Work alongside OEM and controls teams during the integration and troubleshooting of BMS, PCS/inverters, SCADA, EMS, PPC, PLCs, and plant communication systems. * Gain hands\-on exposure to industrial communications and networking used within BESS facilities, including Ethernet, fiber optics, IP\-based equipment, managed switches, and industrial communication protocols. * Monitor and troubleshoot alarms, fault codes, equipment parameters, interlocks, permissives, and operating sequences during commissioning. * Support Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), startup, and integrated system testing when required. * Review electrical and control drawings in the field, identify discrepancies, and assist with redlines and as\-built documentation. * Maintain accurate test records, commissioning documentation, deficiency logs, troubleshooting notes, and daily activity reports. * Collaborate with NEEC engineers and technicians, OEM representatives, EPC contractors, utilities, customers, and other project stakeholders. * Execute assigned project activities with attention to detail, effective communication, and awareness of project milestones. * Follow all NEEC, customer, and site\-specific LOTO, electrical safety, PPE, and high\-voltage safety requirements. * Travel extensively throughout the United States and work outside normal business hours when required by project commissioning schedules. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering required, preferably Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Automation/Controls Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline. * 0–3 years of relevant experience in electrical systems, controls, automation, commissioning, renewable energy, or industrial environments. * Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, single\-line drawings, and control documentation. * Strong electrical and technical troubleshooting skills. * Familiarity with PLCs, SCADA/HMI, instrumentation, I/O, industrial controls, or communications systems preferred. * Ability to perform system inspections, functional testing, and use common electrical test equipment. * Strong documentation, reporting, communication, and teamwork skills. * Expert with Microsoft Office Suite Programs. * Ability to work independently while following LOTO and site safety requirements. * Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel extensively throughout the United States. **Preferred Skills and Experience:** * Experience or exposure to BESS, PCS/inverters, EMS/SCADA, solar, wind, or other power systems. * Familiarity with Rockwell, Siemens, Schneider, Automation Direct, or similar controls platforms. * Exposure to industrial networking, Ethernet, fiber optics, Modbus, or similar communication systems. * Previous commissioning, FAT/SAT, point\-to\-point, or I/O checkout experience. **What We Offer** * Competitive compensation * Overtime pay for hours worked over 40 per week * A competitive and comprehensive benefits package * Medical, dental, and vision coverage * Life \& AD\&D insurance * 401(k) plan with company match * Vacation, sick time, and company holidays * Annual performance incentive opportunities * Professional development and career growth opportunities * A dynamic, growth\-oriented work environment committed to innovation and excellence **Equal Employment Opportunity** *NEEC is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity, or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.*

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Distribution Control and Integration
jobs.description: Team **Engineering** Business Unit **New England Jurisdiction** Requisition No. **12050** City **Northboro, US, 01532** Date posted **1 October 2026** **Senior Engineer, Distribution Control and Integration** ========================================================= Every day we deliver safe and secure energy to homes, communities, and businesses. We are there when people need us the most. We connect people to the energy they need for the lives they live. The pace of change in society and our industry is accelerating and our expertise and track record puts us in an unparalleled position to shape the sustainable future of our industry. To be successful we must anticipate the needs of our customers, reducing the cost of energy delivery today and pioneering the flexible energy systems of tomorrow. This requires us to deliver on our promises and always look for new opportunities to grow, both ourselves and our business. National Grid is hiring a **Senior Engineer** for our **DC\&I Engineering** department in **Northboro, MA** ### **Job Purpose** As a Senior Engineer in DC\&I, you will serve as a technical leader supporting National Grid’s ESMP‑aligned Grid Modernization initiatives, with a primary focus on operational technology (OT) network engineering and communications for distribution field devices outside of the substation. This role enables the reliable, safe, and secure operation of distribution automation systems such as DERMS, FLISR, Volt/VAR Optimization (VVO), and other intelligent grid applications deployed across the distribution network. In this position, you will own and influence OT communications architecture and network design for grid‑edge devices including reclosers, voltage regulators, switches, RTUs, and other distribution automation assets. As a senior engineer, you will act as a technical subject‑matter expert and escalation point, working hands‑on with IP‑based networking, field and wide‑area communications, and cybersecurity controls. You will collaborate closely with DC\&I peers, SCADA/ADMS, IT, telecom, and cybersecurity teams to deliver scalable, resilient, and secure communications solutions, while helping guide technical standards and mentor engineers supporting distribution automation. ### **Key Accountabilities** * Serve as a technical lead for OT network engineering and communications architecture supporting distribution field devices deployed outside of substations, including reclosers, voltage regulators, switches, RTUs, and other grid‑edge automation assets. * Design, implement, and support IP‑based network architectures enabling reliable and secure communications between distribution field devices, control centers, and enterprise systems. * Own and influence field area and wide‑area communications solutions leveraging technologies such as private LTE, carrier Ethernet, MPLS, and SD‑WAN to support real‑time distribution automation and control. * Support the deployment, integration, and operation of distribution automation and grid modernization applications including DERMS, FLISR, Volt/VAR Optimization (VVO), and Conservation Voltage Reduction (CVR). * Apply deep working knowledge of TCP/IP networking (routing, switching, VLANs, subnetting, segmentation) to ensure resilient, scalable, and observable OT communications. * Collaborate with IT, telecom, and cybersecurity teams to design and implement secure OT network solutions, including firewalls, access control, segmentation, monitoring, and secure remote access, aligned with industry and regulatory requirements. * Act as a technical subject‑matter expert and escalation point for complex communications and networking issues impacting SCADA, ADMS, DERMS, and other distribution automation systems across lab, pilot, and production environments. * Evaluate emerging technologies, participate in equipment specification and selection, and lead validation, testing, and integration of new distribution communications and automation solutions. * Contribute to the development and maintenance of technical standards, design patterns, and best practices for distribution OT networking and communications. * Mentor and provide technical guidance to engineers and project teams, supporting consistent and high‑quality implementation of distribution automation solutions. * Support project planning and execution to deliver grid modernization capabilities aligned with ESMP vision, operational needs, and safety priorities. ### **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline from an accredited institution is required. * 6\+ years of relevant experience, or equivalent demonstrated expertise, supporting distribution automation, OT networking, or control system communications in utility or mission‑critical environments preferred. * Strong hands‑on experience with IP‑based networking in OT environments, including routing, switching, VLANs, subnetting, segmentation, and network troubleshooting preferred. * Working knowledge of distribution automation and control systems such as SCADA, ADMS, DERMS, FLISR, VVO, or similar intelligent grid applications preferred. * Understanding of cybersecurity principles for OT and industrial control systems, including defense‑in‑depth, network segmentation, access control, monitoring, and secure remote access preferred. * Ability to translate operational and engineering requirements into robust network and communications designs, and to interpret network diagrams and interface specifications preferred. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical concepts to engineering peers, operations personnel, and leadership. * Willingness to work flexible hours and travel as needed. * A valid driver’s license is required. ### **About The Department** The DC\&I Engineering team at National Grid drives the development and implementation of advanced grid modernization technologies. Our core mission is to equip the Distribution and Transmission Control Centers with innovative solutions that enhance efficiency, reliability, and above all—safety of grid operations. As Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) continue to expand across the power system, we apply our deep expertise to advance grid\-edge technologies that enable seamless integration of these assets into our Distributed Energy Resource Management System (DERMS). Salary $134,000 \- $157,000 a year National Grid will not be providing visa sponsorship for this position now or in the future. You must have the ability to work without a need for current or future visa sponsorship. National Grid utilizes an assessment that evaluates the job qualifications/characteristics using AI or statistically based scoring. This position has a career path which provides for advancement opportunities within and across bands as you develop and evolve in the position; gaining experience, expertise and acquiring and applying technical skills. Candidates will be assessed and provided offers against the minimum qualifications of this role and their individual experience. National Grid is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment regardless of protected class. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. National Grid maintains affirmative action programs for individuals with disabilities and protected veterans. Our employment practices are designed to ensure that all individuals are treated fairly and with respect throughout the hiring process and during employment. National Grid complies with all applicable federal, state, and local anti\-discrimination laws. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace that is free from unlawful discrimination and harassment, and we encourage a culture of respect for all.

jobs.title: Expert Data Scientist (AI)
jobs.description: As the digital arm for the world's largest food and beverage company, Nestlé IT \& Digital Americas harnesses the power of data, analytics, and innovative technology to deliver transformative solutions and business resiliency for Nestlé businesses and iconic brands from Purina® to Nescafé®. We’re innovators, strategic collaborators, value multipliers, and digital business leaders committed to delivering results that create meaningful experiences and drive value, enabling Nestlé to win in the marketplace. By joining, you become part of a 150\-year legacy and a global team of 270,000\+. We invest in our people—their growth, development, and sense of belonging. This shared unity and purpose is what motivates individuals to join, stay, and advance their careers within Nestlé. *This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.* **Position Summary** Join Nestlé IT \& Digital as an Expert AI Data Scientist supporting Nestlé USA (NUSA). You'll sit at the seam between business and technology, framing ambiguous business problems and then owning the AI solution end\-to\-end, from problem definition through adoption. This is a hybrid role, equal parts product manager and technical engineer. You won't just build models; you'll direct AI agents, build the verification and workflow scaffolding that lets a product team ship reliably, and leave behind reusable assets that make the next project easier. Success is measured by durable impact and adoption, and as agents and the surrounding tooling keep reinventing themselves, you'll help shape how NUSA scales AI responsibly. * Serve as a thought leader on emerging AI, GenAI, and agentic technologies, translating breakthrough capabilities into scalable applications aligned with Nestlé's business priorities and enterprise value * Partner with stakeholders to translate ambiguous business needs into clear, precise specifications, surfacing data requirements, tradeoffs, and failure modes, and act as an internal consultant who scopes problems, defines success criteria, and drives alignment across the lifecycle * Own AI applications end\-to\-end, from use\-case concept and experimental design through industrialization, deployment, and adoption, staying accountable across the full lifecycle rather than a single phase * Orchestrate AI agents across parallel streams of work, turning repeated tasks into reusable workflows the broader team can leverage, and incorporate agents into new and existing solutions as the technology landscape evolves * Design evaluation frameworks, conformance checks, and monitoring that validate AI output against defined specifications before rollout, including detection of silent errors, and sustain solutions in production through agent\-assisted diagnosis of data\-quality and pipeline issues * Strengthen the team's collective capability by documenting decisions, learnings, and incidents in shared resources, and coach business users and teammates to elevate performance across projects * Partner across global and regional IT \& Digital teams to co\-create and scale AI solutions, navigating platform roadmaps and enterprise processes to secure approval for needed features and capabilities * Build solutions with security and resilience in mind, protecting sensitive data and safeguarding the critical business processes they touch, and anticipating failure and misuse so AI systems remain safe, trustworthy, and reliable in production **Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, or a related field * 7\+ years of experience partnering with cross\-functional stakeholders to translate business needs into technical solutions and drive adoption * 5\+ years with a demonstrated track record of building and shipping AI/ML solutions that real users adopted * 3\+ years of experience deploying and scaling solutions at enterprise scale, including MLOps and cloud platforms such as Databricks and Snowflake * 3\+ years of experience delivering production solutions with emerging technologies, advanced data and automation capabilities, or machine learning, with a recent focus on AI, GenAI, LLMs, agentic workflows **Other** * Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, or a related discipline is preferred * Experience directing AI agents or agentic workflows to do substantive work, not just single\-prompt usage, is preferred * Experience driving AI concepts from idea to enterprise\-scale adoption, ideally in consumer products, CPG, Supply Chain, or Commercial environments is preferred * Strong hands\-on engineering fluency in Python (or similar) for building, deploying, and integrating AI solutions, including modern LLM and agent patterns Track developments in agentic AI tooling and enterprise automation platforms, and form a defensible view on what is worth adopting, at what pace, and for which use cases. **Focus Area — Client Experience (40% of the Role)** ==================================================== In addition to the common core above, this role owns what the client sees and touches: * Build and operate the external\-facing interfaces and portals through which clients interact with Orbis capability. * Design and automate client onboarding: provisioning, configuration, and the first\-run experience. * Build the support workflows behind client requests — intake, triage, escalation, and resolution — and instrument them so performance is measurable. * Hold the reliability and accuracy bar on anything client\-facing, including documented failure modes and response commitments. * Turn client frict oding using Python * **Interface build:** a modern front\-end framework such as React; API design for external consumers; accessibility and usability practice * **Support tooling:** integration with ticketing or CRM platforms such as Zendesk, ServiceNow, or Jira Service Management * **Client accountability:** defining and reporting against service commitments; running client feedback loops or usability research * **Bridging technical and operational teams:** prior work as a solutions consultant, technical program manager, forward\-deployed engineer, or in a product\-adjacent role * **AI reliability practice:** monitoring, evaluation, or observability tooling for AI systems in production; automated evaluations or regression checks for LLM\-based workflows; human\-in\-the\-loop review steps that maintain quality without creating bottlenecks * **Process design:** designing SOPs or escalation frameworks that hold up across multiple stakeholders * **AI\-assisted development tooling:** working fluency with Claude, Copilot, or Cursor * **Mission environment:** operating within or supporting a government or defense program; OSINT, DIGINT, or intelligence analysis workflows and tradecraft; data governance concepts, federated access control models, or zero\-trust architectures * **Operating range:** a track record of coming up to speed quickly on unfamiliar systems, and effectiveness in a distributed, multi\-program environment with competing priorities **Physical Requirements** ========================= * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer * Participation in virtual and in\-person meetings * Ability to attend planned meetings and/or work in classified spaces for extended periods within the specified work regions **Travel: Occasional (up to 10%), which may include international travel.** **Orbis Benefits** Beyond the opportunity to work alongside practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, joining Orbis means real ownership over outcomes that matter; the chance to build technology that gives the United States Government and its allies a genuine decision advantage, not just another dashboard. From competitive retirement matching to a PTO policy that encourages real time off, we're committed to creating an environment where our team can do their best work and still have a life outside of it. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. A full list of benefits is shared with candidates following an initial conversation with our HR team, so you'll have a clear picture of the support and resources available to you as part of the Orbis team. **Orbis Locations** Orbis works in whatever arrangement the mission requires. Depending on the role, that might mean five days a week on a customer site, full\-time in one of our offices, a hybrid schedule, or fully remote work; our team is spread across 25 states and four countries to match. We make sure every team member has the tools and access needed to do the work, wherever that work happens. Travel is common across many Orbis roles, particularly those supporting customer missions in the field. Orbis is headquartered in McLean, VA, with additional office locations in Taipei, Taiwan, and Canberra, Australia. *Orbis is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. jobs.description: **Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human** Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. If you are too, let's talk. ### **The Role** You'll join the team designing **Okta for AI Agents** — one of Okta's newest and most critical strategic initiatives, providing identity management, access control, and governance for AI agents and non\-human identities. Our customers are IT and security admins, AI developers, and system architects who need to safely deploy and govern how AI agents interact with corporate data, tools, and production environments. As a designer on this team, you'll own key workflows end\-to\-end, from early\-stage concepting of novel interaction models (there's no established pattern library for "agentic permissioning" yet) to hardening flows for scale as the product matures. You'll partner closely with product managers, engineers, researchers, and content designers, and work closely with our Principal and Staff designers, to turn ambiguous, highly technical agentic problems such as delegation, policy, audit, and trust boundaries between humans and agents into experiences that feel simple and safe. hardening and polishing flows as the product matures and scales to millions of customers. * Bring a systems\-thinking lens to connect user insights with business goals, creating experiences that keep customers and their users and AI agents safe every day in this rapidly evolving space. * Design experiences across multiple personas i.e Security Admins, AI Engineers, Enterprise End\-users, and IT Admins, tackling complex scenarios like AI agent lifecycle management, permission scoping, human\-in\-the\-loop authorization, and policy enforcement across the Okta portfolio. * Contribute to scalable, usable design patterns for non\-human identity and agent management and security that hold up under scale, meet a high bar for quality, and improve consistency across the product. * Regularly present work, concepts, and new ideas to cross\-functional partners and senior leadership, driving alignment and gathering input to sharpen your designs. * Actively experiment with AI in your design process, using AI tools for brainstorming, rapid prototyping, exploring edge cases, and iterating on solutions, while developing judgment on where AI genuinely accelerates the work versus Engineering in shaping strategic and operational product and UX outcomes. * You are comfortable owning all stages of design and collaborating across teams. * You have experience working with design jobs.title: CNC Programmer
jobs.description: Job ID: 529544 Oldcastle, a CRH company, is reinventing what's possible in building solutions. We are the leading provider of innovative outdoor living products and utility infrastructure solutions for the water, energy, and communications markets throughout North America. We're a trusted and strategic partner to engineers, contractors, distributors, specifiers, retailers, and homeowners alike as the manufacturer of precast concrete, polymer concrete, and plastic infrastructure products. Our portfolio of brands includes Oldcastle APG, Oldcastle Infrastructure, Belgard® hardscape, Echelon® Masonry, RDI® railing, Catalyst™ Fence Solutions, Sakrete® packaged concrete, Amerimix® mortar, Pebble Technology International® pool finishes, and Techniseal® sands and sealant technologies. **Job Summary** The CNC Programmer is responsible for developing, testing, and optimizing CNC and Wire EDM programs to support the efficient production of high\-quality metal components. This position translates engineering drawings and design specifications into accurate machine instructions, sets up tooling and fixtures, and ensures machining processes meet established quality, productivity, and safety standards. The CNC Programmer utilizes CAD/CAM software, precision measuring equipment, and lean manufacturing principles to improve operational efficiency, reduce waste, and maintain dimensional accuracy. Working closely with engineering, maintenance, and production teams, this role plays a key part in troubleshooting machining issues, supporting continuous improvement initiatives, and ensuring reliable performance of CNC machining operations. **Job Responsibilities** * Program CNC \& Wire EDM to create profiles for Extrusion Operations \& Maintenance * Develop, test, and refine CNC programs for various machines including CNC lathes, milling machines, and 5\-axis CNC machines using CAD/CAM software such as SolidWorks, CATIA, or AutoCAD * Interpret mechanical blueprints, schematics, and engineering drawings to accurately translate design specifications into machine instructions * Set up CNC machining tools and fixtures, ensuring proper alignment and calibration using precision measurement instruments like bore gauges, micrometers, calipers, and coordinate measuring machines (CMM) * Optimize machining processes by applying lean manufacturing principles to improve efficiency, reduce waste, and enhance quality * Troubleshoot programming issues or machining defects promptly to minimize downtime and maintain production schedules * Conduct quality control inspections utilizing precision measurement tools to verify dimensional accuracy against specifications * Collaborate with engineering teams to improve tooling designs, machining parameters, and overall manufacturing processes **Job Requirements** * Proven experience programming CNC Machinery such as Fanuc controls, CNC Milling machines, CNC Lathes, or 5\-axis CNC Machines * Strong Knowledge of CAD software including SolidWorks, AutoCAD, or CATIA for engineering design and Schematics interpretation * Familiarity with CAM software for generating tool paths and machining strategies * Ability to read and interpret complex blueprints with GD\&T (Geometric Dimensioning \& Tolerancing) standards * Mechanical knowledge with experience in metal machining processes like electrical discharge machining (EDM) is preferred * Skilled in measuring parts using precision instruments such as micrometers, bore gauges, calipers, dial indicators, and coordinate measuring machines (CMM) * Understanding of lean manufacturing principles to promote continuous improvement in production workflows * Excellent math skills for calculating dimensions, feeds, speeds, and tolerances required for precision machining * Ability to Lift, push or pull up to 50lbs * Repetitive motion of the limbs * Be able to bend, twist, squat, and reach * Able to be comfortable in an excessive noise environment * Stand and walk for long periods of time **What CRH Offers You** * Highly competitive base pay * Comprehensive medical, dental and disability benefits programs * Group retirement savings program * Health and wellness We are a collection of hundreds of family businesses, regional companies and large enterprises that together form the CRH family. Please complete your online profile and it will be sent to the hiring manager. Our system allows you to view and track your status 24 hours a day. Thank you for your interest! jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: OneMagnify is an AI native, platform\-enabled B2B digital agency operating at the intersection of data, technology, and creativity. We help complex organizations drive measurable business outcomes by building smarter customer experiences and delivering highly integrated solutions across digital, media, and technology. By combining deep industry expertise with advanced analytics and artificial intelligence, we enable our clients to make better decisions, move faster, and compete more effectively in dynamic markets. **Role Summary** As a Senior Data Engineer on our Customer Analytics team, you'll own the data foundation behind CRM analytics, measurement, and data science work for major enterprise brands. You'll design and run production pipelines on Google Cloud and decide how data gets modeled, validated, and delivered. Your work turns messy source data into something analysts, data scientists, and clients can trust. When our insights shape how a client spends its marketing budget, your pipelines are the reason those numbers hold up. **The Impact You'll Have** Our clients are large, data\-savvy organizations that expect every recommendation to come with proof. Their CRM programs, campaign measurement, and customer segmentation all depend on data you build and maintain. A late or broken feed means a wrong answer in a client meeting. A well\-engineered one means faster decisions and measurable ROI. You'll work between data science, analytics, BI, and client teams. You'll be the person who turns a business question into a data design, and the one who keeps a platform running that serves every discipline on the account. AI and ML work is moving from experimentation into production across our client environments. You'll help make that happen by building the data plumbing that lets models and agents run reliably inside GCP, instead of stalling in a notebook. **What You'll Do** **Build the Pipelines That Power Client Analytics** * Design, build, and maintain batch data pipelines on GCP using BigQuery, Dataform, Cloud Composer/Airflow, and Dataflow. Take a SQL\-first approach and build to scale as client data grows. * Write and optimize complex SQL that keeps BigQuery fast and costs predictable. * Build external data API integrations on Cloud Run to bring third\-party and platform data into a single, usable environment. **Own Data Quality End to End** * Own the validation and cleansing pipelines that catch data problems before they reach a dashboard, a model, or a client. * Troubleshoot pipeline failures quickly, including tracing issues upstream, and fix root causes so the same failure doesn't come back. **Fuel Data Science and Analytics** * Partner with data scientists and analysts to deliver reliable, well\-documented datasets that shorten the path from question to insight. * Work with the data science team on AI/ML integrations in GCP so models can move into production workflows. **Translate Business Questions into Data Solutions** * Lead requirements conversations with client and internal stakeholders, and turn loosely defined asks into clear data designs. * Build and maintain dashboards and handle ad\-hoc client data requests. Where it makes sense, turn one\-off requests into repeatable assets. **Engineer with Discipline** * Use Git, pull request workflows, and CI/CD automated deployments to ship changes safely and often. * Raise the team's engineering standards through code reviews and shared best practices. **What You'll Need** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience * 3\+ years of data engineering experience, including production batch pipelines on GCP (BigQuery, Cloud Composer/Airflow, Dataflow) * Advanced SQL skills, with experience building SQL\-first pipelines in BigQuery * Strong Python skills * Experience building API integrations, ideally on Cloud Run * Hands\-on experience with version control and CI/CD (Git, PR workflows, automated deployments) * Ability to gather requirements from technical and non\-technical stakeholders, and confidence working directly with clients * The judgment to make design tradeoffs and explain them clearly **Future\-Ready Skills (Nice to Have)** * Experience with Dataform or dbt for modular, tested, version\-controlled transformations * Experience building with Gemini Enterprise agents (formerly Vertex AI) * Background in consumer or marketing data, such as CRM, campaign response, or customer identity data * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools to speed up pipeline builds, testing, and documentation **Benefits** We believe great work happens when people have the support and flexibility they need to thrive. Our benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) retirement plan, paid holidays, and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can take time away to recharge when you need it. We also offer additional programs focused on wellness, financial security, and professional growth. **We are an equal opportunity employer** We believe that innovative ideas and solutions start with unique perspectives. That's why we're committed to providing every employee a workplace that's free of discrimination and intolerance. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and actively search for like\-minded people to join our team. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform job functions, and to receive benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
