jobs.title: Front-end Software Engineer (React)
jobs.description: ### **Who You Are** You are an outstanding front\-end software engineer who wants to build React applications on top of a service layer powered by cutting\-edge Machine Learning and AI technologies. You excel at building modern browser\-based JavaScript applications that make Ajax calls to RESTful Microservices. You have worked with React and Redux; you want to go deep with these technologies to build the next generation of web applications. You also enjoy building compelling data visualizations. You hold yourself to a high standard when it comes to writing clean, performant, and maintainable code that powers well\-designed web applications. You are very productive and deliver extremely high quality front\-end code where the separation of concerns is clear and follows architectural best practices. You apply software patterns well and take testing your code seriously. You write unit tests while writing production code rather than as an afterthought. Your code meets the rigorous standards needed for Continuous Integration workflows involving multi\-environment feature validation and frequent deployments to customers. You care deeply about your work and its impact on your team's productivity. You work well in cross\-functional settings where you are expected to collaborate with members of wide\-ranging disciplines including Design, DevOps, Product, and Data Science. You value the security of a company with a proven business model and enjoy the opportunities a startup offers. You have a great work ethic and are able to take on major projects from start to finish, either solo or collaborating with other engineers. On a personal note, you are a kind and understanding team member who is friendly and eager to work with others and help them grow in their roles as you grow in yours. You maintain a positive attitude throughout the Agile Sprint cycle and help the team deliver at a steady pace on a week\-to\-week basis. **Who We Are** -------------- Quantifind helps some of the world's biggest banks catch money laundering and fraud. Quantifind also works with government agencies to use the same platform to uncover criminal networks and combat money laundering committed by internationally sanctioned entities. Unlike other players in this space, Quantifind delivers results as software\-as\-a\-service (SaaS) with consumer\-grade user experiences. Quantifind is a data science technology company whose AI platform uncovers signals of risk across disparate and unstructured text sources. In financial crimes risk management, Quantifind's solution uniquely combines internal financial institution data with public domain data to assess risk in the context of Know Your Customer (KYC), Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Fraud Risk Management, and Anti\-Money Laundering (AML) processes. Today these compliance processes are burdened by ever\-increasing regulatory responsibilities and an expectation of frictionless transactions. Legacy technologies demand increasingly more human resources as the operations expand; Quantifind's SaaS solution offers a way to cut through the inefficiency and enhance effectiveness simultaneously. We process terabytes of data each day on our own dedicated Hadoop clusters. We use real\-time data services to enable interactive investigations in our SaaS applications and APIs. We use Kubernetes and Docker for our container ecosystem, and we develop standalone services in Scala and Python and use Spark for MapReduce jobs. To help you succeed, we provide a supportive environment that fosters collaboration between teams and team members, where learning and professional growth are considered a key part of your success, and of ours. We offer a flexible work environment with a family friendly work\-life balance. ### **What a Great Candidate Looks Like:** * Professional front\-end software engineer experience using React for at least 2 years * BS or MS in Computer Science * Outstanding written and verbal communication skills * Previous experience at a software startup preferred * Professional experience with JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3 * Professional experience developing rich, powerful, and reusable components with client\-side JavaScript in React * Professional experience using Redux to manage application state * Experience with data visualization * Strong UX and design sensibilities and attention to detail * Familiarity with server\-side JavaScript using Express.js is a plus * Familiarity with SQL databases such as Postgres * Professional experience writing unit tests and automated integration tests * Professional experience working with REST APIs * Previous exposure to Agile software development and Scrum methodology, with the willingness and ability to adapt to a formalized system of ticket management that helps us build and deliver on a well\-organized schedule ### **The Opportunity We Offer** Quantifind is seeking a Front\-end Engineer for our Front\-end team in Palo Alto, CA. You will create browser\-based, responsive applications built with React components. The Front\-end team works closely with our Data Scientists and Platform Engineers to build an interactive product that helps our customers visualize risk factors. Quantifind's development team is centered in Palo Alto, California, and we have technology hubs in Atlanta, Georgia, and in Washington, D.C. Quantifind is currently using a hybrid mix of working from home and in the office, with regular in\-person touchpoints and shared office space. **A highlight of our benefits:** * Competitive salary * Company Equity * Exceptional benefits package * Flexible Vacation \& Paid Time Off * Employer\-matched 401(k) plan * A fun environment where work\-life balance is valued The California base salary range for this full\-time position is $125,000 to 150,000\. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location, role\-related knowledge and skills, depth of experience, relevant education or training, and additional role\-related considerations. Depending on the position offered, equity, bonuses, commission, or other forms of compensation may also be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and other benefits. Experience with other RDF triplestores (**GraphDB, Amazon Neptune, Virtuoso, Anzo**) counts as transferable if you’re ready to go deep on Stardog. * Strong command of **semantic web standards**: RDF, RDFS, OWL, SKOS, SHACL and SPARQL. * Practical **ontology and taxonomy modelling** \- able to move from stakeholder conversations and messy source data to a model that holds up in production. * Experience **mapping and virtualising** relational and semi\-structured sources into a graph. * Solid **Python** and **SQL** for data preparation, transformation, automation and troubleshooting. * Comfortable with **Git\-based workflows and CI/CD** (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps). * Experience working with **life science or healthcare data**, and comfortable with the quality and regulatory expectations that come with it. * **Autonomy and ownership**: you scope your own work, propose an approach, defend it, and bring the team along — rather than waiting for a fully specified ticket. * Working knowledge of **data quality**, validation frameworks, and test\-driven data development. * Team\-first mindset and experience in **agile environments** (Scrum or Kanban). ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Familiarity with public life science ontologies and terminologies (e.g. SNOMED CT, MeSH, ChEBI, UMLS, LOINC). * Exposure to at least one life science domain: clinical and clinical trial data (CDISC, SDTM), R\&D and drug discovery, regulatory (RIM, IDMP), or manufacturing, supply chain and quality. * Understanding of GxP or other healthcare data regulations. * Familiarity with FAIR data principles. * Experience combining graphs with AI — GraphRAG, vector search, or LLM\-assisted ontology work. * Exposure to property graphs (e.g. Neo4j) and how they compare with RDF. * Knowledge of data lineage, catalog and governance tooling. * Infrastructure automation using Terraform, Bash, or PowerShell, and containers (Docker, Kubernetes). ### **Additional information** **Great talent should benefit from a great work environment. Founded in 2020, Radiant is on track to test its first reactor at the Idaho National Laboratory this summer, with initial customer deliveries beginning in 2028\. **About the Role** ------------------ Radiant is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to own the frontend for our in\-house telemetry and fleet management platform. You’ll join the Mission Software team, build on top of a highly technical telemetry streaming platform, and work on fleet monitoring systems for Radiant’s portable nuclear reactor, Kaleidos. You’ll also build additional features for engineers and operators, adding new data analysis and configuration capabilities to a critical platform. The ideal candidate is outgoing and organized, ready to collaborate with other engineers. ------------------------------ * Own critical parts of the frontend for our internal telemetry and fleet management platform, working in a modern React \+ TypeScript \+ Vite codebase. * Develop highly reliable, performant systems for data review and analysis. * Develop frontend pages for complex device configuration and telemetry systems. * Collaborate with other members of the Mission Software team and reach consensus among stakeholders across the company. **Required Qualifications \& Skills** ------------------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, SPAs, testing with Jest \+ Playwright * Experience building highly performant, complex, mission\-critical systems using technologies like WebSockets, WebRTC, or SSE. * Has worked on a complicated UI system before, driving forward critical features * Strong code review \& debugging skills. **Desired Qualifications \& Skills** ------------------------------------ * Experience using the following technologies: TanStack Query \+ React Router, Pixi.js \+ WebGPU, Yjs or similar CRDT * HMI or dashboarding design experience * Hands\-on hardware tech experience, working closely with hardware engineers to develop deeply coupled applications. **Our Tech Stack:** ------------------- * Typescript * React * Vite * Pixi.js \& Yjs * Rust \+ Axum Web / Python \+ FastAPI **Additional Requirements:** ---------------------------- * Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as necessary to accomplish our mission. * Must work 100% onsite at El Segundo HQ. **Benefits and Perks** ---------------------- * Stock: Substantial incentive stock plan for all full\-time employees. * Medical: 100% up to base silver level plan for employee \+ 50% dependents, offers up to Platinum plans. * One Medical: Sponsored memberships for employees and their dependents. * Vision: 100% top tier plan coverage \+ 50% for dependents. * Dental: 100% top tier plan coverage, orthodontia For more than 50 years, Ralph Lauren's reputation and distinctive image have been consistently developed across an expanding number of products, brands and international markets. At Ralph Lauren, we unite and inspire the communities within our company as well as those in which we serve by amplifying voices and perspectives to create a culture of belonging, ensuring inclusion, and fairness for all. We foster a culture of inclusion through: Talent, Education \& Communication, Employee Groups and Celebration. **Position Overview**The **DevOps Engineer** is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining the automation, infrastructure, deployment, and operational processes that enable reliable and efficient software delivery. This role works closely with development, QA, security, infrastructure, and operations teams to build and maintain **CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, containerized environments, monitoring solutions, and automated deployment processes**. The DevOps Engineer will help improve application availability, scalability, security, deployment frequency, and overall engineering productivity by applying **Infrastructure as Code, automation, DevSecOps, cloud technologies, and modern software delivery practices**. Devops Engineer should also be supporting production operations and monitoring the platforms. **Essential Duties \& Responsibilities*** Design, develop, and maintain **CI/CD pipelines** for automated build, test, deployment, and release processes. * Automate application and infrastructure deployment across development, testing, staging, and production environments. * Implement and manage **Infrastructure as Code (IaC)** using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible. * Build and maintain cloud infrastructure using AWS**, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform**. * Develop and manage containerized applications using **Docker and Kubernetes**. * Implement automated configuration management, provisioning, and environment management. * Manage source\-code repositories and branching strategies using **Git, GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, or Azure Repos**. * Integrate automated **unit, integration, security, performance, and regression testing** into CI/CD pipelines. * Implement DevSecOps practices, including vulnerability scanning, secrets management, dependency scanning, and security controls within pipelines. * Establish and maintain application and infrastructure **monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability using DataDog, CatchPoint.** * Troubleshoot deployment failures, infrastructure issues, performance problems, and production incidents. * Participate in **incident management, root\-cause analysis, and corrective/preventive action planning**. * Implement high\-availability, scalability, backup, disaster\-recovery, and business\-continuity solutions. * Automate repetitive operational activities. * Collaborate with developers to improve application architecture, deployment processes, and operational readiness. * Support release management and production deployments while minimizing deployment risk and downtime. * Establish DevOps standards, best practices, reusable pipeline templates, and engineering guidelines. * Continuously evaluate new tools and technologies to improve **deployment speed, reliability, scalability, and engineering efficiency**. * Maintain technical documentation for infrastructure, deployment procedures, architecture, troubleshooting, and operational processes. **Experience, Skills, and Knowledge****Cloud Platforms** * AWS, Azure, ETL * Cloud networking, IAM, compute, storage, databases, and security * High availability and disaster recovery concepts **CI/CD \& DevOps** * Jenkins * GitHub Actions * GitLab CI/CD * Azure DevOps * Bitbucket **Containers \& Orchestration** * Docker * Kubernetes **Infrastructure as Code \& Automation** * Terraform * CloudFormation * Python **Source Control** * Git * GitHub * GitLab * Bitbucket **Monitoring \& Observability** * Catchpoint * Datadog * CloudWatch/Azure Monitor **Security / DevSecOps** * SAST/DAST * Container security * Dependency and vulnerability scanning * Secrets management * IAM and RBAC * Security compliance automation * Sonar Cube **Operating Systems \& Networking** * Windows Server * TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS * Load balancers * Firewalls * Networking and troubleshooting * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. * 3\+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, SRE, Infrastructure Engineering, or related roles with Automation mindset. * Understanding of **Agile/Scrum and AI SDLC methodologies**. * Experience with production incident management and troubleshooting. * Knowledge of **DevSecOps and cloud security** practices. * Relevant cloud or DevOps certifications are a plus. * Knowledge of SFCC platform.

jobs.title: Civil Engineer / Senior Civil Engineer – Data Centers
jobs.description: **Company Description** Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation\-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll in the Americas has thousands of experts working across more than 70 offices. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Environment \& Health, Water, Energy, and Planning \& Urban Design. **Job Description** **Hybrid\-based position in our Pennsylvania, Seattle, Texas, or Louisiana** **office.** Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis. No sponsorship is available for this position We invite you to bring your civil engineering and land development experience into play as you support the planning, permitting, and design of data center and other large\-scale industrial sites. This role will provide hands\-on technical leadership for site feasibility, conceptual layouts, grading, drainage, stormwater management, utilities, access, and civil permitting. The successful candidate will have direct experience coordinating with local AHJs and will help strengthen Ramboll's technical capabilities in one or more strategic U.S. data center markets. To succeed in this role, you should have a bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering and approximately 5\+ years of relevant experience. Are you excited about understanding, interpreting, and navigating complex projects with real\-life implications? Are you motivated by creating sustainable change that benefits society and nature? Are you a curious and open\-minded person? If this sounds like you, or you’re curious to learn more, then this role could be the perfect opportunity. Join our Environment \& Health Division as our new **Civil Engineer / Senior Civil Engineer – Data Centers** and work with us to close the gap to a sustainable future. **Your new role** You will join Ramboll's Civil Engineering and Design team within the Environment \& Health business. The team supports data center, mission\-critical, industrial, and other large\-scale development programs through site due diligence, conceptual master planning, preliminary engineering, permitting, detailed design, and construction support. You will collaborate with civil engineers, CAD designers, environmental specialists, geotechnical engineers, transportation professionals, utility specialists, and other technical disciplines. **Your key responsibilities will be:** * Lead civil engineering and land development services for data center, mission\-critical, and large industrial projects from site selection through construction. * Manage project scope, schedule, budget, staffing, risk, client communication, proposals, and subconsultants across multiple projects. * Direct technical work including site layout, grading, stormwater, drainage, utilities, access roads, erosion control, and permitting. * Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams, clients, agencies, and authorities while navigating codes, permitting requirements, and development standards. * Review technical deliverables, mentor engineers and CAD staff, support team growth, and contribute to client development and market expansion. **Qualifications** **About you** * Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Civil Engineering with approximately 5\+ years of relevant civil/site engineering experience. * Professional Engineer (PE) license strongly preferred, with ability to obtain licensure by comity in target states. * Extensive experience with land development and site civil design for large, complex projects, ideally in industrial, logistics, manufacturing, or mission\-critical environments. * Strong project management and technical expertise, including grading, drainage, stormwater, utilities, permitting, budgeting, scheduling, and client coordination. * Experience working with AHJs and leading multidisciplinary teams; familiarity with Civil 3D and permitting practices in Pennsylvania, Washington, Texas, or Louisiana preferred. **Additional skills:** * Strong ownership of project outcomes with a practical, solutions\-oriented approach. * Clear communication skills with the ability to explain technical issues to clients and nontechnical stakeholders. * Strong commercial judgment and ability to manage scope, schedule, budget, and risk. * Collaborative leadership style with strong prioritization and mentoring skills. * Client\-focused approach with a commitment to safety, quality, and professional standards. **Additional Information** **What we can offer you** * Investment in your development * Being valued for the unique person you are * Never being short of inspiration from colleagues, clients, and projects * The long\-term thinking of a foundation\-owned company **Salary Transparency Statement** At Ramboll, we are committed to fair and transparent compensation practices that support our people and our purpose of creating sustainable societies. The anticipated base salary range for this position is $81,515 \- $101,894 per year. This range reflects the compensation we reasonably expect to offer at the time of posting. Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and internal equity. Because we operate across multiple U.S. markets, pay may differ depending on the cost of labor in specific locations. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for bonus, overtime or other forms of compensation and we offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports well\-being, professional development, and work\-life balance. Our recruiters are happy to share more about the specific salary range and total rewards package applicable to your location during the hiring process. **Ready to join us?** Please submit your application with your up\-to\-date CV. We invite diversity in all its forms and encourage applicants from all groups to apply. Thank you for taking the time to apply! We look forward to receiving your application. **Work at the heart of sustainable change with Ramboll in the Americas** Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation\-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll in the Americas has thousands of experts working across more than 70 offices. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Environment \& Health, Water, Energy, and Planning \& Urban Design. **Where People Flourish** Our mission is to create sustainable societies where people and nature flourish. This means that a culture of inclusion is embedded in everything we do. Our people bring diverse backgrounds and experiences to the company, enabling us to deliver innovative and forward\-thinking solutions to our clients. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. We are committed to equal employment opportunity, regardless of age, disability or medical condition, gender identity, marriage and domestic partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, ancestry, or national origin, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation, military service and veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Ramboll wants to ensure opportunities are accessible to candidates with disabilities. So, please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it more comfortable for you. You can contact us at job.advert.accessibility@ramboll.com with such requests.

jobs.title: Quality Specialist
jobs.description: Description: The Quality Specialist is the document control and program verification owner within the Quality department at Reader Precision Solutions. This role ensures that all quality documentation for every job is accurate, complete, and at the current revision; that the CMM, Keyence, Oasis, and High QA programs used to inspect each job match the most current customer print and internal documentation; and that inspection methods are proven out at setup inspection so they are robust and ready for operator use. The Quality Specialist also completes outside process and final inspection, assists with daily MRB disposition, and prepares all client\-required documentation, including PPAPs, FAIs, critical characteristic reports, Cpk studies, and SPC data. By catching revision mismatches and documentation errors before a job reaches the floor or ships, the Quality Specialist protects product conformity, prevents escapes and rework, and keeps Reader Precision Solutions audit\-ready under AS9100 and ISO 9001\. **Essential Duties \& Responsibilities include but are not limited to:** **Documentation Accuracy \& Control:** * Own the quality workbook for each job, including the Gage List, Setup Inspection, Inspection Instructions, Work Instructions, Quality Alerts, and Quality Standards \& Defect Guides, ensuring each is accurate, complete, and aligned to the current customer print revision and purchase order requirements. * Review new and revised customer prints, specifications, and engineering changes; identify what changed and update all affected quality documents promptly. * Manage document revision control: assign revision levels, route documents for approval, remove and archive obsolete revisions, and ensure only current, approved documents are available at the point of use. * Maintain accurate, organized quality records in accordance with QMS procedures and AS9100 record retention requirements. **Inspection Program Verification:** * Verify that CMM, Keyence, and Oasis programs and High QA inspection plans for each job match the current print revision and quality documentation, including characteristics, tolerances, balloon numbers, and revision levels. * Maintain a program register that links each part number and revision to its approved inspection program(s), program revision, and date last verified. * Document and communicate any program\-to\-documentation discrepancies to the Metrology Technician \- Programming and Quality Engineer, notify the Quality Engineer when poor material quality is found, and track each item through correction and re\-verification. * Perform periodic audits comparing programs in use at inspection equipment against approved masters to confirm no unapproved changes have been made. **Setup Inspection \& Inspection Readiness:** * Perform setup inspections on new, revised, and returning jobs, verifying first pieces against the current print, Setup Inspection sheet, and inspection programs before the job is released to production. * Use each setup inspection to prove out the job's documentation and programs: confirm every characteristic is covered, the correct gages and program revisions are called out, and instructions can be followed as written. Correct documentation issues directly and route program issues to the Metrology Technician \- Programming. * Evaluate inspection methods for robustness, including gage selection, repeatability, frequency, and practicality at the machine, and recommend improvements to the Quality Engineer where methods are unclear or unreliable. * Confirm that operator\-facing inspection instructions, gage lists, and Quality Alerts are clear, current, and ready for operator use, and support operator training on new or revised inspection methods. * Document setup inspection results and findings, and track all documentation and program clean\-up items through to closure. **Outside Process, Final Inspection \& Client Requirements:** * Inspect parts returning from outside processes (such as plating, heat treat, and passivation), verifying conformance to print and purchase order requirements and reviewing supplier certifications before parts move forward. * Perform final inspection to confirm that every client requirement is met and all required documentation is complete before a job ships. * Complete PPAPs, FAIs, and other client\-required documentation packages, verifying that each submission references the correct drawing, documentation, and program revisions. * Identify and monitor critical characteristics, and prepare critical characteristic reports, Cpk (process capability) studies, and SPC data as required by the client. * Escalate out\-of\-control SPC trends or capability results below client requirements to the Quality Engineer and Quality Supervisor for containment and corrective action. **MRB Support:** * Assist the Quality Technician III with daily MRB dispositions (rework, sort, or scrap) to keep product moving through production. * Ensure dispositioned m ship with a near site local clinic for **FREE** health services including primary \& preventative care, walk in visits, labs, prescriptions, etc. * FREE vision insurance! * 401(k) retirement savings plan with up to 4\.5% company match (immediately vested!) * Vacation accrual starts upon hire \- accrue up to 2\.5 weeks in first year! * 11 paid holidays * Education assistance up to $5,250 annually (after 12 months of service) * Professional development opportunities – internal \& external (cross\-departmental training, PMPA conferences, IMTS\-Chicago, local technical colleges/universities, \& more…) * Career advancement – ongoing training \& mentoring with opportunity to grow your skills * Performance bonus – potential to receive a discretionary year\-end bonus based on individual and group performance * Company paid Short\-Term Disability policy * Company events – team lunches, summer picnic event, holiday party * Company zoo pass to Milwaukee County Zoo * Holistic wellness program – earn up to $700 in incentives through points accumulation for accomplishing a variety of wellness activities. Also offered by the Company are employer paid onsite flu shots, biometric screenings, free health coaching \& MUCH more! * Employer paid life insurance – $50,000 policy with options for voluntary life up to $400,000 benefit maximum * Financial planning resources \& onsite financial wellness workshops * Employer subsidized work shoes \& safety glasses program * Reader Precision Solutions branded attire – $100 annual allowance * Employee Referral bonus – $1,000 * Satisfying work…leaving work at the end of the day knowing that the GREAT work you do is meaningful and appreciated by the Company, our clients, and end users who benefit from the high\-quality components we manufacture for them! **Core Competencies – Reader Precision Solutions Four Pillars: Innovation, Empowerment, Integrity \& Respect** * ***Innovation*** – we apply creative solutions to exceed expectations internally and externally. We deliver creative solutions by pursuing continuous improvement, challenging the limits of conventional thinking to drive positive change, and engaging our customers to achieve synergy. * ***Empowerment*** – we equip our employees to succeed. We nurture success by setting realistic goals and standards; with accountability and regular performance feedback, providing training opportunities for growth and learning and offering employees a safe and modern work environment. * ***Integrity*** – our reputation is everything. We preserve and enhance our reputation by operating with the highest ethical standards, focusing on customer needs, and contributing positively to our community and environment. * ***Respect*** – we act with honor in all our interactions. In our interactions, we accept and value individual differences, work together with a positive attitude and promote open and honest communication in a team\-based environment. **Physical/Environmental Demands:** The incumbent typically works in an office environment or out on the manufacturing floor. In the office, the incumbent will utilize a computer, telephone, and other office equipment as needed to perform assigned duties. On the manufacturing floor, the incumbent may need to gather information, troubleshoot manufacturing components, or prove out projects. The noise level in the office is typical of an office and the noise level on the manufacturing floor does not require hearing protection although it is provided. This role may encounter frequent interruptions throughout the workday. This role may regularly require the incumbent to sit, talk, or listen; frequently required to use repetitive hand motion, fine motor skills, and stand, walk, reach, and/or bend. May occasionally lift up to 50 pounds. **Reader Precision Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We respect and seek to empower each individual and support the diverse cultures, perspectives, skills and experiences within our workforce.**

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description: **Project Manager** Program Management \| Full\-Time, Salaried \| Reports to the Co\-CEOs **Company** Seeking.com (Reflex Media) **Location** Remote, anywhere in the USA. **Compensation** $75,000 to $105,000 base. **Travel** Occasional travel to Las Vegas for quarterly planning and major project kickoffs. **About the Role** Seeking.com is the world's largest premium dating platform, founded and led by an MIT alumnus and headquartered in Las Vegas. We are hiring a Project Manager to join our Program Management team, reporting directly to the Co\-CEOs. You will work side by side with our Director of Program Management, the senior member of the team, and take full ownership of a slate of live projects across engineering, product, AI, and marketing. Your job is delivery. You take each project from intake to closeout: scope, plan, schedule, risks, dependencies, status, and the retrospective at the end. On any project you own, leadership always knows where it stands and the team always knows what happens next. Technical work runs in Jira. Marketing work runs in Monday. Documentation lives in Confluence. You work fluently across all three. **Who Should Apply** We are especially open to candidates from these backgrounds: * Project Managers at software, digital, or product companies who have run several concurrent projects and can show the numbers they moved * Technical Project Managers who have delivered engineering work and are comfortable coordinating with marketing * Agency or professional services Project Managers who have owned SOWs, scope changes, and client reporting and want to go in\-house * Marketing or Growth Operations professionals who have grown into full\-lifecycle project ownership Titles vary. A track record of shipping on time is the bar. **What You'll Find on Day One** * Operations and technical teams actively running their work in Jira, with sprints, boards, and owners in place * A backlog of legacy epics from projects abandoned as far back as seven years ago, ready to be reviewed and cleaned up * Marketing projects running in Monday, with hand\-offs to engineering that need a clear owner * A draft intake and governance framework that needs to be tested on real projects * A Director of Program Management as your senior teammate, and Co\-CEOs who read project status every week * Permission to fix what you find. If a workflow is slowing delivery, you change it. **What You'll Own** **Project Delivery, End to End** * Own a slate of concurrent projects from intake through closeout. Write the project charter for each: objective, success metric, sponsor, scope, milestones, and budget where one applies. * Break scope into a work breakdown, a realistic schedule, and a critical path. Keep baselines honest as the work evolves. * Choose the delivery approach that fits the work: predictive, Agile, or hybrid. * Run kickoffs, working sessions, and project standups for the projects you own. Facilitate sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives where a team needs them. * Close every project with a retrospective and a lessons\-learned entry in Confluence. **Scope, Change, and Risk Control** * Guard scope. Every change request gets a written impact on timeline, cost, and resources, and a named decision\-maker. * Maintain a RAID log (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies) for every project. Surface each risk early with a proposed mitigation. * Map dependencies between engineering and marketing and resolve them before they become blockers. * Manage vendor and contractor deliverables against their statements of work. **Status, Reporting, and Stakeholder Communication** * Publish a weekly status for each project: health, progress against milestones, risks, and decisions needed. Short, specific, and read once. * Feed accurate project\-level data into the portfolio view the Director of Program Management presents to the Co\-CEOs. * Tailor communication to the audience. An engineer, a marketer, and a Co\-CEO each get the level of detail they need. * Escalate early when a project is at risk. Bring the problem, the options, and your recommendation. **Tool Hygiene and Process Improvement** * Keep every project you own clean in Jira and Monday: named owners, due dates, current status, and a definition of done. * Lead the cleanup of legacy epics from abandoned projects. Confirm status with the original teams, archive or close what is finished or dead, and re\-plan anything that still matters. * Apply the draft intake and governance framework on live projects and report back on what works and what needs to change. * Build templates, checklists, and runbooks so each new project starts faster than the last. **Supporting the OKR Cadence** * Link each of your projects to the Key Result it serves, so every project has a clear line to a company objective. * Support the Director of Program Management in running quarterly OKR planning and weekly check\-ins in Monday: prepare the data, collect updates, and track follow\-ups to clo  this week and improve it next week. * Written Discipline. Every meeting has an outcome. Every decision has an owner and a date. Everything lives in Confluence. * AI as Leverage. You use AI to move faster and you verify what it produces. **Cultural Fit: Who Thrives Here** Be honest with yourself about whether this is your environment: * You take ownership. When you see a stalled epic or a missing owner, you fix it. * You ask the sharp question early and save the team a week of rework. * You lead through influence. You get results from teams you do not manage. * You are a builder. Configuring a Monday board, writing a runbook, or cleaning up a Jira workflow is comfortable ground. * You believe in the brand. You understand that better execution translates directly into a better product and a better member experience. * You want direct exposure to the Co\-CEOs and a clear path to grow. **Day in the Life** * Morning scan of your projects in Jira and Monday. Flag anything at risk before standups start. * Quick sync with the Director of Program Management on priorities and hand\-offs for the day. * Run a standup for a cross\-functional launch and clear two blockers by lunch. * Review a change request from marketing, write up its impact on the engineering timeline, and get a decision from the sponsor. * Update RAID logs and send the weekly status for your active projects. * Use Claude to draft meeting notes and the action list, then verify and send. * Close out a finished project with a retrospective and a Confluence write\-up. **How We Will Measure Success in the First 12 Months** * 30 days. Fluent in Jira, Monday, and Confluence. An initial slate of projects handed over from the Director of Program Management, each with a charter, named owner, schedule, RAID log, and weekly status. * 90 days. A full slate of concurrent projects under your ownership. On\-time milestone delivery tracked and trending up. Legacy epic cleanup complete, so Jira reflects only live work. The Director of Program Management has meaningful time back for OKR and governance work. * 6 months. Stakeholders treat your status reports as the source of truth. The intake framework has been applied on live projects, with documented recommendations. Reusable templates and runbooks live in Confluence. * 12 months. A full year of projects delivered with a clear, measurable record. You are ready to take on larger, higher\-stakes initiatives on a path to Senior Project Manager.ƒGroth **Why This Role Matters** Seeking is running a brand transformation and a product transformation at the same time. Both depend on dozens of projects landing on time and in the right order. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: About Rev.io Rev.io provides configurable software for billing, customer management, business management, payments, analytics, provisioning, and automation to service providers in telecommunications, Wireless \& IoT, managed IT services, A/V, security integration, and other related industries. Our modern, cloud\-based software delivers the industry’s most complete quote\-to\-cash experience, enabling our clients to grow their revenue efficiently. Rev.io is an Atlanta\-based company with offices in Atlanta and West Virginia. We have more than 21 years’ in business serving our clients. While we are very experienced in what we do, we are still growing rapidly and we are looking for exceptional people who are excited to join us on a career\-defining journey. In all of our daily work, each of us are guided by our mission, vision and “ACT TOP” values. Our Mission: To help clients grow revenue efficiently. Our Vision: To be the best billing \& back\-office software company in the world by providing innovative solutions and extraordinary service to our clients and end users. Our ACT TOP Values: * Achieving Extraordinary Results: Doing more than expected and pursuing a higher standard of work without compromising your job responsibilities. * Caring For Employees, Clients and Community: Demonstrating empathy and concern by helping those who are most in need. * Take Responsibility and Act Like An Owner: Being accountable and doing the right thing even when no one is watching. * Transparent Leadership: Communicating openly, regardless of title or situation. * Opportunity To Make a Positive Difference: Recognizing situations and taking action to produce a better outcome. * Passion For Innovation: Enthusiastically finding new solutions to improve efficiency. In a recent national survey, 89% of our employees agreed that Rev.io is a Great Place to Work. Compared to 57% agreement at comparable US\-based companies, Rev.io stands out as a place where team, values and culture combine to create an amazing work environment! **About The Role:** We are looking for a Data Engineer to join our team in Atlanta, GA. The purpose of a **Data Engineer** is to migrate and curate a client's data from their legacy system into the Rev.io system in a structured, scalable manner that provides our clients with accurate billing and superior customer management capabilities This is a dynamic role with a responsibility for the detailed design, coding and maintenance of migration projects to move data from a variety of legacy systems. Problem solving will be a big part of the role, as legacy systems need to be deciphered, documented and methods of accessing them designed. The role requires you to be a self\-driven, highly motivated individual with strong customer facing, teamwork, and support skills. This is an IT Billing Operations role supporting client data migrations and billing analytics. **Job Objectives and Responsibilities:** * Work with client teams of Billing and Mediation Specialists, and Database Administrators responsible for all clients billing and rating operations * Migration of legacy data to specified SQL Server database structure * Configure database and DBMS parameters. * Monitor successful completion of all scheduled jobs for implementation; troubleshooting any job failures and DBMS issues. * Communicate and update on task due dates, requirement needs and overall project status to the Implementation Team and Vice President of Operations. * Provide hands\-on assistance in research and resolution of client billing issues and inquiries * Create, modify and test custom SQL queries and stored procedures to provide maximum visibility into billing details and accuracy and customer billing formats to large wholesale and enterprise customers * Manage complex call records mediation and rating engine to ensure all usage elements are properly applied to customer accounts * Validate results by testing Rev.io instance for each implementation, including standard and custom fields. * Dual bill run testing and rating to ensure the customer is billing correctly out of Rev.io. * Analyzing rating, MRCs, NRCs for accurate billing between a customers legacy system and Rev.io. * Assist clients with guidance on data migration standards and best practices for utilizing Rev.io functionality * Foster ideas on how to improve client relationships and operational efficiencies * Develop a foundation and the recommendation to steam line and define the data migration process by product type and monthly recurring revenue. **Skills Needed:** * A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business, or Information Technology recommended. * Knowledge and working experience of SQL Server and DTS packages are essential. * Familiarity with CDR formats (e.g. BAF, EMI), types and jurisdictions * Familiarity with telecom tax engines and data feeds (e.g. SureTax, Avalara) * Experience of analysis of data structures and development of tools to parse and restructure data. * Client\-facing skills together with the ability to work independently in the field interpreting specific requirements * In\-depth understanding of SQL queries, statements, and stored procedures * Experience of problem solving, database installation and management procedures in development and production environments. * Knowledge of ODBC/ADO and accessing remote systems using various methods. * T\-SQL experience and programming in SQL Server, SQL scripting and SQL database design. Experience of applying data modeling tools would be an advantage. * Management of database systems. **Benefits and Perks:** * Excellent medical, dental and vision coverage, with plan options and rates comparable to larger companies * Generous HSA employer contribution * 401k with generous company match and immediate vesting * Unlimited PTO * Paid Parental Leave * Company paid for life and disability insurance * Monthly tech reimbursement * Monthly fitness reimbursement * Education and development stipend * Time off to volunteer at the organization of your choice, as well as company\-level volunteer opportunities * Clear and documented career path for your position * True open\-door policy with opportunities to give feedback to leadership on a continual basis through 1:1 sessions multiple times per year *At Rev.io no employee or applicant will be treated less favorably on the grounds of their sex, marital status, race, color, nationality or ethnic or national origin, disability, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, pregnancy or maternity, marital or civil partner status, or religion or belief. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Internal Systems
jobs.description: At Rigetti, our mission is to build the world's most powerful computers to solve the world's most challenging problems. Rigetti is a pioneer in superconducting qubits and full\-stack quantum computing systems. In addition to introducing the first multi\-chip quantum processor, Rigetti has led the way in software systems for quantum computing, with a distributed operating environment for hybrid quantum\-classical computing and a state\-of\-the\-art characterization and measurement platform. To continue advancing this work, we're expanding our Internal Software (ISW) team. ### **The Opportunity** ISW enables Rigetti's physicists and fabrication engineers to build better quantum hardware. Our work spans the measurement and characterization platform our quantum engineers rely on every day; the design, layout, and process tooling in our in\-house chip fabrication facility; the cloud and on\-site infrastructure underneath both; and the analytic environments in between. We also support external customers through our cloud services and on\-site deployments. Our users are deeply expert in their own fields, and our job is to give them software that helps them move faster and trust their results. We're a small, senior team that enjoys hard problems and working alongside people who know things we don't. The work is a mix of strengthening the experimental Python systems our scientists depend on and building new ones as the science moves forward. Because ISW touches so much of the company, there's real room to grow, whether that means going deeper in an area you care about or taking on something new as Rigetti evolves. It's a rare chance to do serious software engineering a few steps from the hardware itself: the code you write shapes how quantum chips are designed, built, and measured. We're looking for intellectually curious software engineers who want to grow alongside supportive, like\-minded colleagues in an R\&D\-driven environment. No domain background required; you'll learn it from some of the best people in the field. ### **Key Responsibilities** **What You’ll Be Doing** * Own, maintain, and improve data\-intensive Python services and applications, mostly backend, sometimes full stack * Work directly with internal customers, including quantum engineers and fab engineers, to understand what they actually need and turn it into scalable, sustainable software * Keep data trustworthy as systems evolve: schema migrations, compatibility across clients, testing, CI * Measure and improve performance of user\-facing workflows and the observability of the platforms behind them * Help scientists and engineers outside the software team use AI coding agents safely and sustainably by building the frameworks, guardrails, and patterns that make that possible * Keep users informed on priorities and roadmap * Mentor and collaborate with other engineers on the team ### **Qualifications** **What You Bring** * Strong Python, with experience building and running production backend or serving systems * Experience working in large, evolving codebases, and the judgment to improve them without slowing down the people who depend on them * Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases; PostgreSQL a plus * Experience with AWS and a typical cloud stack (Kubernetes, Kafka, Postgres, Grafana or equivalents) * A track record of working cross\-functionally with scientists or other deeply technical peers, and genuine enjoyment of helping them do their best work, especially as requirements change with the science * Product instinct and independence: you can sit down with a user, understand the underlying problem, define what to build, and drive it forward without close supervision * Curiosity regarding quantum computing and what Rigetti is building **Nice to Have** * Scientific computing, data\-science, or AI/ML tooling backgrounds * HPC, national lab, semiconductor, or other hardware\-forward R\&D environments * DevOps, SRE, or cloud engineering * Frontend or data visualization experience, including building tools that help scientists explore and understand their data * Physics, math, or quantum background of any depth is a plus, but not a requirement *Base Salary* Rigetti complies with all local and state regulations in regards to displaying salary ranges. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidate’s relevant work experience, skills, and geographic location. Rigetti offers a full slate of benefits from competitive salaries, equity, medical, dental and vision for employees as well as a 401(k) plan, a paid parental leave program, rejuvenation days, and a vacation policy that aligns with local regulations and industry standards. As engineering leaders, we value diversity and are committed to building a culture of inclusion to attract and engage innovative thinkers. Our technology, meant to serve all of humanity, cannot succeed if those who built it do not mirror the diversity of the communities we serve. Applications from women, minorities, and other under\-represented groups are encouraged. **About Rigetti** Rigetti Computing is a pioneer in full\-stack quantum computing. The company has operated quantum computers over the cloud since 2017 and serves global enterprise, government, and research clients through its Rigetti Quantum Cloud Services platform. The company’s proprietary quantum\-classical infrastructure provides ultra\-low latency integration with public and private clouds for high\-performance practical quantum computing. Rigetti has developed the industry’s first multi\-chip quantum processor for scalable quantum computing systems. The company designs and manufactures its chips in\-house at Fab\-1, the industry’s first dedicated and integrated quantum device manufacturing facility. Rigetti was founded in 2013 and today employs more than 150 people with offices in the United States, U.K., and Australia. Learn more at www.rigetti.com. Don't see the job you want? Apply here so we can keep in touch with you when the right role opens up in the future! **Export Licensing Compliance** Rigetti is committed to full compliance with applicable anti\-discrimination laws. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We strive to create an inclusive work environment and will not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: ### **RESULTS. INNOVATION. VALUES. ACCOUNTABILITY.** That's RIVA. We're a mission\-driven IT services company and systems integrator supporting digital transformation and modernization for federal government agencies. Since 2009, we've partnered with our customers to solve complex challenges through smart, practical innovation to deliver real outcomes where they matter most. Our teams are made up of industry\-leading experts who are passionate about doing great work and making a difference. We don't just develop solutions, we support efforts that strengthen communities and serve the public good. RIVA's culture is built on four core values: Results, Innovation, Values, and Accountability. They guide how we work, how we collaborate, and how we measure success. Our employee\-first approach is rooted in trust, ownership, and meaningful work. By investing in our people and fostering a flexible, supportive environment, employees have the opportunity to grow their skills, contribute ideas, and make an impact from day one. all while supporting missions that matter. ### **POSITION OVERVIEW** RIVA Solutions is seeking an Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Engineer to support the USPTO P\-TACTS program, the Patent Trial and Appeal Board case tracking and electronic filing system. This role designs, builds, and deploys production AI and ML solutions, with an emphasis on large language models, retrieval augmented generation, and scalable cloud deployments including on Databricks and within the program AWS Cloud environment. The engineer works directly with government stakeholders and technical teams to turn mission needs into working, maintainable applications ### **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. * 5\+ years of applied ML and AI engineering experience. * Strong Python skills and hands\-on experience with ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit\-learn, and Keras. * Practical experience with LLMs, RAG architectures, and vector databases. * Cloud platform experience with \[AWS or GCP — confirm USPTO environment], including deployment of ML workloads. * Experience across supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning approaches. * Eligibility to obtain a USPTO Public Trust and authorization to work in the U.S. * Databricks Certified Machine Learning Engineer, AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer or an equivalent cloud certification. ### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Experience with generative and multimodal AI applied to documents and images, such as OCR, layout analysis, and information extraction from scanned filings. * Databricks Certified Machine Learning Engineer, AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer or an equivalent cloud certification. * MLOps experience with pipeline orchestration. * Full\-stack development experience integrating ML services with web interfaces. * Databricks Certified Machine Learning Engineer, AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer or an equivalent cloud certification. * Prior experience delivering on federal government contracts. * Experience with USPTO, PTAB, or patent and intellectual property data. Experience supporting a FISMA Moderate system through security authorization and continuous monitoring. * ### **EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY \& ACCOMMODATION** We believe great teams are built from different backgrounds, perspectives, and lived experiences, and we mean that beyond the buzzwords. RIVA is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by law. If you need an accommodation at any point in our process, send an email to talent@rivasolutionsinc.com, we'll be happy to help. ### **VETERAN SUPPORT \& ACCESSIBILITY** As a federal contractor, RIVA follows the requirements of the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act (VEVRAA) and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act, supporting the employment and advancement of protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. If you're a veteran, we encourage you to self\-identify during the application process, it helps us track our hiring commitments and, in some cases, may support priority referral for open roles. RIVA also invites applicants to voluntarily self\-identify as having a disability during the application process, not because it affects your chances of being hired, but because it helps us measure how well we're living up to our commitments and identify where we can do better. Your response is confidential and entirely optional.

jobs.description: San Mateo, CA, United StatesEngineeringID: 30809 Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators. At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there. A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone. As a full stack Senior Software Engineer you'll help build Global Actions: the systems that make core actions work consistently across every surface and platform on Roblox. Your first focus will be the Affinity System, which powers how people save and organize the things they care about on Roblox: a unified affinity system covering Saves, Collections, and Wishlists, replacing today's fragmented Favorites experience. You'll work across the stack, from backend APIs and data models to cross\-platform React based UI solutions. **You Will** * Design and build the backend APIs and services, covering collections, items, pagination, and batching, that power Saves, Collections, and Wishlists * Lead the migration from Favorites to Saved without losing user data, across web, mobile, desktop, console, and VR * Build user facing surfaces, including the Saved Library and Collections pages, in partnership with Product and Design * Design for privacy and safety, so users only see content and Collections they're allowed to view * Extend the system to new entity types as the platform grows **You Have** * 3\+ years of experience building full\-stack systems, including backend, APIs, and frontend applications at scale. * Experience with React, TypeScript/JavaScript or similar * Experience with data modeling for systems with complex relationships, such as privacy and visibility rules **You Are** * Systems thinker: strong understanding of client server architecture, data modeling, and API design at scale. * Analytical: tackles ambiguous problems, like moderation, eligibility, and migration edge cases, systematically. * Collaborative: thrives in cross functional environments and enjoys mentoring. For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job\-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. jobs.title: Sr. Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior Data Engineer** ======================== Location: This position can be located in the following area(s): United States (remote) **Company Overview** -------------------- Robots \& Pencils is an applied AI engineering firm building the next frontier of business architecture. We design and ship AI co\-workers that integrate into enterprise operations and deliver measurable results for our clients. We're all in on AWS, combining deep UX capability with senior engineering talent to get AI into production fast and keep it there. We've earned the trust of leaders across Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, and Manufacturing and more, and earned a reputation as the nimble alternative to traditional global systems integrators. Founded in 2009, with delivery centers in Canada, the United States, Eastern Europe, and Latin America, we are smaller, faster, and more senior by design. Our teams average 15\+ years of experience. We move fast, sweat the details, and build things that actually ship. **Position Overview** --------------------- We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and deliver the data and AI infrastructure behind an enterprise agentic AI platform. This role is ideal for an engineer with several years of experience who can confidently own features end\-to\-end, contribute to architectural decisions, and bring strong technical judgment to the problems they take on. In this role, you will work as a key contributor on a cross\-functional team alongside AWS Professional Services, embedded with a large enterprise client. You'll help scale an observability data platform from an initial single\-agent pilot to a fully automated, end\-to\-end operations model, building the data pipelines, observability, and agent\-enablement tooling around it. You'll be joining real, in\-flight work where reliability, security, and scalability matter. You'll collaborate with experienced engineers to enhance existing systems, deliver new capabilities, and contribute to the technical decisions that shape how the platform scales over time. **Why This Role Matters** ------------------------- At Robots \& Pencils, we design AI systems for a human world. Our name says it all. Robots and pencils means engineering paired with creativity, because every agent we ship has to work for real people in real workflows. That balance is baked into how we operate. Every role here contributes directly to that mission. Here, you shape how AI systems integrate into enterprise operations, how teams move at real velocity, and how products create measurable impact for clients and the people they serve. We ship production\-ready AI in 30 to 45 days. That pace demands people who take ownership, lead with craft, and care deeply about what they put their name on. **What You'll Do** ------------------ ### **Craft** **\& Delivery** * Design, implement, and deploy data and AI/ML systems on AWS end\-to\-end, from concept through production, including data lake pipelines, observability instrumentation, and optimization for performance, reliability, and cost * Maintain and evolve platforms in production, monitoring for drift, debugging issues, and driving ongoing improvements to reliability and scalability * Bring an AI\-forward coding mindset to your daily work, using tools like Claude and Cursor to ship higher\-quality work at pace ### **Collaboration \& Communication** * Partner closely with AWS Professional Services, client engineering, and data teams to align the work with broader platform and business goals * Translate technical tradeoffs, system behavior, and constraints into terms non\-specialists can act on * Participate actively in code reviews and design discussions, raising concerns and offering constructive feedback ### **Leadership \& Influence** * Contribute to data and AI architecture decisions with thoughtful perspective on tradeoffs and long\-term implications * Take ownership of meaningful work end\-to\-end, including the unglamorous parts of getting AI into production * Raise the bar on engineering practices through your own work and by supporting more junior engineers when opportunities arise **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * 5\+ years professional software or data engineering experience, with 2\+ years building data platforms or AI/ML systems in production on AWS * Strong software engineering background (Python and SQL, or similar) * AWS Certified Data Engineer – Associate. Candidates without it are considered if there is a clear, near\-term path to earning it * Hands\-on experience building data lakes on AWS, including S3, Lake Formation, Glue, Athena, and Iceberg or Parquet, with exposure to streaming on Kinesis or MSK * Experience with observability for distributed and AI systems, including CloudWatch, X\-Ray, OpenTelemetry/ADOT, Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus and Grafana, and drift monitoring with SageMaker Model Monitor * Working knowledge of agent e ents * Experience shipping agentic or ML systems in production environments * Experience with MLOps and LLMOps practices, including evaluation, deployment, and monitoring of models and agents * Experience with infrastructure as code using AWS CDK, and CI/CD for data and AI systems * Understanding of IAM and KMS security, data governance, responsible AI principles, and PII handling * Cost optimization experience across storage, query, compute, and model usage * Experience delivering solutions in a consulting or professional services setting, working alongside client and partner teams * Demonstrable, day\-to\-day usage and knowledge of AI\-forward coding tools such as Claude Code and Cursor * Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to navigate ambiguous technical challenges with sound judgment **Helpful Extras and Unique Skills** ------------------------------------ * Experience in regulated enterprise environments such as financial services * Additional AWS certifications such as Machine Learning Engineer – Associate, Security – Specialty, or Solutions Architect – Professional * Prior work with AWS Professional Services or other AWS partner delivery teams * Experience with agent frameworks and orchestration tools, such as Strands Agents or LangGraph * Open\-source contributions or deep familiarity with the OpenTelemetry ecosystem **You'll Do Well Here if You Are** ---------------------------------- * **A doer.** You see something broken and fix it. You'd rather move on clarity than wait for certainty. * **A fast learner who knows you don't know everything.** The AI landscape changes weekly. You're senior enough to know better and curious enough to keep learning anyway. * **Direct in a way that makes the work better.** You give honest feedback. You'd rather have the hard conversation than blow smoke. * **Obsessed with craft.** You know genius is in the details. You ship exceptional, not perfect, and you don't put your name on work you wouldn't stand behind. * **Built for ownership.** You honor commitments, admit mistakes fast, and back your teammates when a decision costs something. No handoffs, no finger\-pointing. * **All in.** You treat clients' businesses like your own. You take the work seriously without taking yourself seriously. * **Resourceful when the budget, timeline, or team is tight.** Constraints don't slow you down. They sharpen you. * **Glad to be in the room with people who care as much as you do.** Our teams average fifteen\-plus years of experience. We hire people who push each other to do better work. *The below range reflects the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. An employee's position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue\-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. The salary range for this role is $119,514 USD \- $164,899 USD.* *We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.* *An offer of employment may be conditional upon successful completion of a background check in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice. Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission. We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for all job applicants and employees. Employment decisions are based upon job\-related reasons regardless of an applicant's race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, marital status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by law.* "Craft" could be customize based on role

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us! jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern - Property Management Data & AI
jobs.description: About Us SCG America Group Inc. is a New York City\-based company with operations in construction, property management, and food \& beverage. We are looking for a hands\-on Software Engineer Intern to help us build a practical, AI\-assisted internal tool for day\-to\-day property and administrative management. About the Project Our property management work currently lives across Microsoft To Do, Excel, Word, PDFs, and email. Tasks, contracts, tenant insurance, leases, and payment records are scattered, sync between phone and desktop is unreliable, and key dates depend on manual tracking. This project will replace that patchwork with a single web\-based system that combines simple to\-do reminders, spreadsheet\-style structured data, document management, and built\-in AI assistance. You will work directly with the end user, turning real daily pain points into working features. What You Will Build * Tasks \& Reminders: create tasks with due dates, recurring reminders, priority, status (Not Started / In Progress / Done), and categories (Property, Contract, Insurance, Payment, Tenant, Vendor, Other), with fast search and filtering. * Structured Records: spreadsheet\-style tables for properties, contacts, contract dates, insurance expirations, amounts, status, notes, attached files, and next actions; sorting, filtering, and Excel import/export. * Property \& Tenant Tracking: lease expirations, renewal notices, rent escalations, tenant insurance, maintenance follow\-ups, and document receipt; views such as "tenant items due in the next 30 days" or "lease renewals in the next 90 days." * Vendor / Subcontractor Directory: a searchable contact directory linked to related records. * Contracts \& Key Dates: track effective, expiration, renewal, and notice deadlines, payment milestones, and insurance requirements, linked to the source documents. * Payments, Invoices \& Recurring Items: track vendor/subcontractor invoices, payment applications, pending approvals, missing documents, recurring payments, and payroll/timesheet checks to prevent missed or duplicate payments. * Unified Workspace: each item brings together its tasks, deadlines, contacts, structured data, contracts/PDFs, invoices, email records, history, and AI analysis in one place. * Built\-in AI Features (using free, open\-source models that run locally): summarize contracts, insurance certificates, leases, and other PDFs; extract dates, company names, amounts, and expiration terms from documents; natural\-language search across stored records and files; answer questions from documents with source citations for human verification; analyze spreadsheet data and generate management summaries and follow\-up suggestions. * Cross\-Device Access: browser\-based on desktop with a mobile\-friendly interface, one shared data source, and backup/export capabilities. Technical Constraints * $0 initial cost: open\-source frameworks, a free local database, free local development tools, open\-source local AI models, and free document\-processing/search components. * Must install and run on an existing laptop; may integrate with existing OneDrive / Microsoft 365 storage where applicable. Qualifications * Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field * Experience building web applications (front end and back end) through coursework, projects, or prior internships * Working knowledge of at least one modern stack (e.g., Python, JavaScript/TypeScript) and relational databases (e.g., SQLite, PostgreSQL) * Interest in applied AI: local LLMs, document parsing, or retrieval\-augmented search * Able to work independently, communicate clearly in English, and translate non\-technical requirements into working features Nice to Have * Experience with open\-source local LLM tools (e.g., Ollama, llama.cpp) and PDF/OCR processing * Familiarity with Excel data import/export and responsive (mobile\-friendly) web design * A portfolio or GitHub profile showing completed projects Internship Details * Location: Remote (must reside in the United States) * Schedule: Part\-time, 20\-30 hours per week * Duration: 3 months; may be extended depending on project progress * An internship completion letter will be provided upon successful completion. * Work Authorization: Must be authorized to work in the U.S.; F\-1 students eligible for CPT or OPT are welcome to apply. Visa sponsorship is not available. How to Apply Please apply through Indeed with your resume. A link to your GitHub or portfolio is strongly encouraged. Expected hours: No more than 30\.0 per week Work Location: Remote

ACH mechanics including submission windows, returns, return codes, NOCs, and retry rules. * Ensure correctness in the domain, maintaining complete audit trails and producing reconciliation evidence. * reconciliation and settlement. * Strong understanding of **webhooks, retries, idempotency, asynchronous processing, and distributed\-system failure scenarios**. * Experience designing relational data models for transaction\-heavy systems. * Understanding of **PCI DSS** and payment\-security patterns such as tokenization and isolation of sensitive payment data. * Strong attention to correctness and edge cases, especially in financial systems. * Fluency with modern AI\-assisted development tooling. * **Strong English communication skills** and confidence working directly with a US\-based team. * Ability to work with **4–6 hours of daily overlap with US Central Time**. **Bonus points** ---------------- * Experience with platform, marketplace, or facilitator models (split payments, sub\-merchant onboarding, multi\-party flows). * Experience with payouts and disbursement rails, including bank\-account collection, verification, and payout status handling. * Experience with fraud and risk tooling, and bank\-account validation services. * Experience with e\-commerce plugin or SDK development (WooCommerce, Shopify, Magento). * Knowledge of multi\-currency, cross\-border, or alternative payment methods. * Experience with event sourcing applied to financial state, and double\-entry ledger design. **Reveal great tech solutions** Join the team of experts who create custom, cutting\-edge tech solutions for world\-renowned businesses, fueling clients growth. Unleash your potential, tackle new challenges, and be part of a team that values your skills and contributions. Focus on long\-term impact and building tailored, long\-lasting partnerships with our clients. **Experience an agile and flexible working environment** Work fully remote around the globe, or in a hybrid work model from our office hubs which are equipped with everything needed for comfortable work. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Digitech - Remote
jobs.description: The Sarnova Family of companies includes Digitech Computer, Bound Tree Medical, Tri\-anim Health Services and Cardio Partners.
