Since its founding in 1984, Digitech has refined its software platform to create a cloud\-based billing and business intelligence solution that monitors and automates the entire EMS revenue lifecycle. Digitech leverages its proprietary technology to offer fully outsourced services that maximize collections, protect compliance, and deliver results for clients. **Summary:** The Software Engineer works closely with our development team and company leaders to deliver high\-quality software to our users, using the latest and best coding strategies and practices. As part of a small development team, the individual in this role will participate in program/site related development and user experience decisions and is expected to use their skills and experience to create innovative solutions. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** * Develop, test, and maintain software using established programming languages, technical standards, and development methodologies * Test, analyze, and debug solutions across development, testing, and production environments * Provide production support to ensure applications operate reliably by proactively identifying issues and implementing effective solutions * Develop Proofs of Concept to evaluate the feasibility and viability of proposed technical approaches * Evaluate, recommend, and adopt new technologies that enhance product development, performance, and user experience * Collaborate closely with developers, designers, and business stakeholders to ensure solutions align with functional and user requirements * Clearly present and justify technical decisions using sound engineering judgment and fundamental programming principles * Stay current with emerging technologies, tools, and industry trends * Promote high quality user experiences and adherence to development best practices * Contribute to individual, departmental, and organizational initiatives as needed * Additional job duties as assigned **Skills/Experience Required:** * Education: Bachelor's Degree in computer science, software engineering or related field is strongly preferred; High School Diploma and equivalent experience will be considered * 1\-3 years of full\-stack development experience preferred * Proficiency in either C\#/SQL Server or Java/MySQL Server required; other languages are beneficial * Experience in usability/interface design * Familiarity with advanced SQL queries preferred * Healthcare experience a plus * Demonstrated strong attention to detail and delivering a high quality product the first time. * Effective communication skills (verbal and written) * Exceptional time management, organization, and planning skills with proven track record of managing multiple projects simultaneously, prioritizing key initiatives and hitting deadlines * Demonstrated ability to build relationships and work effectively with employees within and across departments * Highly self\-motivated with a sense of urgency, bias for action and anticipatory qualities * Curious, driven to achieve and willingness to challenge the status quo * A desire to continually learn and grow in your career * Ability to independently manage all aspects of the job role including required goals and business practices in a remote environment Sarnova is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Our mission is to be the best partner for those who save and improve patients’ lives. Excellence in delivering upon our mission is dependent upon having a diverse team that is empowered to bring their full, authentic self to work each day. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve, and we are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity. \#Digitech

Create. Simplify. * Perform other duties as assigned. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline. * Minimum of 8 years of relevant experience with electric power systems or industrial automation system practices. * Demonstrated knowledge of electric power system protection and control, integration, automation, and communications applications. * Demonstrated knowledge of electric power system design, studies, information and communication technology (ICT), and protective relay applications. * Ability to work on multiple solutions simultaneously * Proven ability to lead and supervise project teams. * Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills. * Strong organizational and problem\-solving abilities. * Ability to learn new skills and assume new responsibilities. * Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment. * Willingness to travel domestically and internationally up to 25%, depending on project and focus area requirements. * Satisfactory background check results. * Successful completion of required drug screening. **Preferred Qualifications** * Professional Engineer (PE) license or equivalent professional certification. * Experience with an electrical utility, industrial plant, consulting engineering firm, or system integrator. * Project management experience. * Working knowledge of Vision or other project management tracking software. **Why Join SEL?** At SEL, you'll help solve complex technical challenges while working alongside industry experts committed to innovation, quality, and customer success. This role offers the opportunity to influence major projects from proposal development through execution, while supporting critical infrastructure around the world. If you are a technically driven engineering professional with a passion for developing solutions and leading successful projects, we encourage you to apply. **Competitive pay. Superior benefits. Retirement benefits include an employer funded stock ownership plan (ESOP) and personal 401(k) options. * We offer top tier medical, prescription, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance. * We recognize the importance of a healthy life balance and offer: 10 paid holidays, annual vacation accrual starting at 12 days, 9 paid sick days, and paid family and medical leave that covers 90% of your pay. * We foster growth and development of our employees through avenues such as STEM courses, apprenticeships, tuition assistance, and engineering development programs. * Ask our team about other benefits including wellness, fertility, adoption, and flexible spending benefits. Embrace the charm of small\-town living with spacious surroundings, no traffic hassles, and easy access to outdoor adventures in nearby mountains, rivers, and forests. jobs.title: AI Workflow Engineer
jobs.description: Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960\. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again. But Scout is more than just a brand, it's a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work. The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn't been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all\-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built\-in gas\-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range. At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go\-getter with unrivaled passion. Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now! #### **What you'll do** Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick\-up truck \& rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following: * Build and orchestrate automation workflows using n8n, LLMs, and agentic frameworks. * Utilize ML flow to automate the training of ML models for forecasting and intelligent decision support. * Integrate AI tools into business processes and data platforms. * Develop intelligent agents capable of autonomous task execution and reasoning. * Implement AI\-powered chatbots and assistants. * Leverage Streamlit to build interactive AI dashboards and applications. * Use OpenWebUI to create user\-friendly interfaces for LLM\-based tools and workflows. * Parse and extract structured data from documents using LlamaParse and similar tools. * Implement semantic search and retrieval systems using vector databases like Pinecone. * Utilize OpenAI APIs, Anthropic Claude and others for LLM\-based tasks. * Ensure AI systems meet compliance, security, and ethical standards. **Location \& Travel Expectations**: * This role may be based out of the **Scout Motors corporate headquarters in Charlotte, NC or Columbia, South Carolina**. * This role requires 4\-5 days per week in the office, with regular in\-person meetings and events. * Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time. #### **What you'll bring** We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You'll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment. You'll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring: * Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or related field or equivalent work experience. * 4\+ years of hands\-on experience with AI\-powered automation workflows using n8n and LLMs. * Proven experience in designing and deploying ML models and intelligent agents. * Experience with OpenWebUI interfaces for LLM\-powered tools. * Proficiency in OpenAI, Anthropic, and vector databases. * Strong Python skills and understanding of ML/AI frameworks. * Knowledge of Streamlit\-based AI dashboards and applications. * Familiarity with infrastructure as code (Terraform). * Excellent problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills. * Effective communication and collaboration skills. You treat colleagues with respect. You have a desire for clean implementations but are also humble in discussing alternative solutions and options. * Minimum of High School Diploma, GED or equivalent required for all roles at Scout Motors, Inc. #### **What you'll gain** The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up. This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation. In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights: * Competitive insurance including: + Medical, dental, vision and income protection plans * 401(k) program with: + An employer match and immediate vesting * Generous Paid Time Off including: + 20 days planned PTO, as accrued + 40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually + Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for biological and adoptive parents of all genders + Paid leave for circumstances related to bereavement, jury duty, voting time, or military leave #### **Pay Transparency** This is a full\-time, exempt position eligible to receive a base salary and to participate in an annual performance bonus program. Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience. The annual performance bonus program is preset and not candidate dependent. Initial base salary range \= $120,000\.00 \- $145,000\.00 Internal leveling code: IC9 **Notice to applicants:** * To be considered for career opportunities at Scout Motors, applicants must be 18 years of age or older. * Residing in **San Francisco**: *Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.* * Residing in **Los Angeles**: *Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.* * Residing in **New York City**: *This role is not eligible for remote work in New York City.* **Equal Opportunity** Scout Motors is committed to employing a diverse workforce and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, disability, pregnancy, or any other characteristics protected by law. Scout Motors is committed to compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre\-employment testing, or a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact ScoutAccommodations@scoutmotors.com.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Location Note:** This a hybrid role for our Wakefield, MA office (In\-office one day per week, plus additional in\-person trainings and workshops as needed) **The Purpose of Your Role:** The Data Engineer is part of the development team responsible for building, maintaining, enhancing, and integrating Sentinel’s data pipelines, data platforms, and connected systems. This role owns the design and delivery of secure, scalable, reliable, and well\-documented data solutions that support Sentinel’s applications, reporting, analytics, and business decisions. A Data Engineer works across the full data engineering lifecycle: understanding business and technical requirements, defining architecture, documenting technical specifications, designing data models, developing and reviewing code, validating data quality, troubleshooting production issues, and supporting releases. This role provides technical leadership, makes sound engineering decisions, improves our standards and processes, and mentors other engineers while remaining hands\-on in the work. **What you'll bring to Sentinel:** * A strong commitment to building secure, maintainable, testable, observable, and cost\-effective data systems. * Demonstrated expertise designing and operating production\-grade data pipelines and data platforms. * Advanced SQL skills and strong programming experience with Python or another language used for data engineering. * Deep understanding of data modeling, data warehousing, data lakes, ETL/ELT, and workflow orchestration. * Experience designing cloud\-based solutions, preferably using AWS and its data services. * Strong judgment when balancing scalability, reliability, performance, security, delivery speed, and cost. * A quality and reliability mindset, including ownership of data accuracy, lineage, monitoring, and operational readiness. * The ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and build consensus across teams. * A mentoring mindset and willingness to improve engineering practices across Sentinel. * Curiosity about how AI can responsibly improve engineering productivity, data quality, testing, and operational support while protecting sensitive information. **What you'll be responsible for:*** Lead the design, development, and evolution of end\-to\-end data pipelines, integrations, data models, and platform capabilities. * Own production data systems and contribute to their availability, monitoring, incident response, root\-cause analysis, and continuous improvement. * Develop and own a long term vision for our data landscape. * Translate business and technical requirements into clear architecture, implementation plans, and incremental deliverables. * Design and implement scalable ETL/ELT workflows that ingest, transform, validate, and deliver data from APIs, databases, files, and other systems. * Define and jobs.title: Commissioning Engineer (Electrical) - Memphis
jobs.description: SpaceXAI's mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands\-on and to contribute directly to the company's mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates. ### **ABOUT THE ROLE:** We are seeking an Electrical Commissioning Engineer to execute the buildout, startup, and handover of electrical systems for SpaceXAI's high\-performance data centers. This is a hands\-on role where you will commission, test, troubleshoot, and turn over critical systems that support next\-generation AI supercomputing infrastructure. You will work closely with construction, engineering, operations, EPC contractors, and OEM vendors to deliver safe, reliable, and high\-quality electrical systems. This is a full\-time, onsite role with travel to SpaceXAI data center construction sites across the United States. ### **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Execute all electrical commissioning activities for MV/LV switchgear, generators, UPS systems, PDUs, ATS/STS, transformers, relays, busway, and associated controls in hyperscale data center environments. * Execute functional performance testing, pre\-functional testing, site acceptance testing, load\-bank testing, protection\-relay testing, integrated system testing, and system turnover to operations. * Troubleshoot and resolve complex electrical, controls, and process issues during pre\-commissioning, commissioning, and startup phases. * Develop and review detailed commissioning test procedures, scripts, checklists, and documentation in alignment with project specifications, industry standards, and SpaceXAI requirements. * Coordinate with EPC contractors, OEM vendors, design engineers, and SpaceXAI stakeholders for system energization, startup sequences, and integrated system validation. * Champion safety by enforcing strict adherence to LOTO, NFPA, OSHA, and SpaceXAI safety protocols; participate in daily safety briefings and job hazard analyses. * Maintain comprehensive as\-built documentation, test records, issue logs, and final commissioning reports. * Support and deliver training programs for operations and maintenance teams on commissioned systems. * Participate in constructability reviews, design feedback sessions, and lessons\-learned meetings to continuously improve installation quality and future project execution. * Support commissioning schedules and punch\-list resolution to meet aggressive project timelines. ### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:** * Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering. * 5\+ years of experience in commissioning for electrical systems. ### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:** * Working knowledge of commissioning test equipment (power analyzers, insulation testers, hipot testers, torque tools, IR cameras, load banks, relay test sets, etc.), or demonstrated aptitude to learn it in the field. * Familiarity with relevant codes and standards (NEC, NFPA 70/70B/70E, IEEE, NETA, NESC, Uptime Institute). * Ability to read, interpret, and redline electrical drawings, one\-lines, three\-lines, control schematics, and sequence of operations; update as\-built models after commissioning. * Experience coordinating with multi\-discipline teams, contractors, and vendors in construction environments. * Ability to work safely in industrial construction environments and follow LOTO, NFPA, OSHA, and SpaceXAI safety protocols. * Commissioning experience, including functional performance testing, pre\-functional testing, site acceptance testing, load\-bank testing, protection\-relay testing, integrated system testing, and system turnover. * Data center systems and prior work on mission\-critical projects * Hands\-on experience with EPMS, BMS/BAS, and power\-system controls troubleshooting and integration (Modbus, BACnet, etc.). * Knowledge of refrigerant systems, direct liquid cooling, and advanced heat rejection technologies. * Current OSHA 30 certification or equivalent. * Proficiency with commissioning management platforms (CxPro, Procore, PlanGrid, or similar). * Experience implementing integrated systems testing, owner's project requirements verification, and feeding as\-built data back into the sitewide power model (load flow, short\-circuit, coordination, arc\-flash). ### **ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:** * Willingness to travel extensively and work extended hours, nights, and weekends during critical commissioning and startup windows. * Ability to travel extensively to SpaceXAI construction sites and remain onsite for extended periods during peak commissioning phases. * Physical capability to work in industrial environments, climb ladders/stairs, lift moderate loads (up to 50 lbs), and wear full PPE for long durations. * Valid driver's license and ability to meet SpaceXAI's driver eligibility requirements. *SpaceXAI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our* *Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

As an Optical Engineer, you will own the physical optical layer of that computer: fiber layout, link design, connector and polarity architecture, optics selection, and production of a plant that can be built, tested, and repaired at AI cluster scale. ### **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Own end\-to\-end optical and fiber design for AI training and inference fabrics: fiber cabling, cassette/panel architecture, polarity, breakout, reach, and connector strategy (MPO\-12/16, SN, MDC, LC, OSFP / QSFP\-DD) * Write and verify link budgets for scale\-out and scale\-up interconnect (SMF/MMF, AOC/DAC, DR/FR/LR, InfiniBand and Ethernet), including loss, reflections, FEC, and realistic install margins * Develop and implement factory tests for optical interconnects including insertion loss, return loss, and polarization * Select and qualify optics, fiber, and connectivity (transceivers, patch, trunks, cassettes, harnesses); own vendor bring\-up, failure analysis, and fleet reliability of the optical layer * Deploy and verify end\-to\-end optical interconnect into the manufacturing line * Lead commissioning and debug: inspect/clean, power meter, OTDR, BER/FEC stats, and volume failure modes (dirty connectors, wrong polarity, wrong map, damaged end\-face) * Evolve connectivity toward the next speed and density (800G / 1\.6T, CPO/NPO awareness, tighter reaches, higher fiber count per rack) * Work with mechanical and network teams to design structured cabling and raceways with the rack and facilities teams: tray fill, bend radius, pre\-term vs field\-term, labeling, and a plant that can be built and repaired at hall scale ### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:** * Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, optical engineering, physics, or a related engineering discipline * 2\+ years of professional experience in fiber layout, optical link design, and/or datacenter/HPC optical engineering ### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:** * Demonstrated ownership of fiber or optical design that was installed and turned up in a datacenter, HPC, or AI\-compute environment * Working command of single\-mode vs multimode, MPO polarity, insertion/return loss, and 100G\+ transceiver classes * Hands\-on optical test: inspect/clean, power meter, OTDR or equivalent * Fiber interconnect ownership for AI / high\-compute clusters (GPU scale\-out fabric, InfiniBand NDR/XDR, RoCE Ethernet 400/800G) * High\-density pre\-terminated trunk/cassette design and rack\-to\-spine optical mapping at hall scale * Optics vendor qualification at volume (OSFP, 800G DR8/2xFR4, AOCs, and the failure modes that show up in a real fleet) * Experience designing optical harnesses or cassettes for a manufacturing line, including test coverage and yield * DWDM / campus DCI for cluster\-to\-cluster or building\-to\-building connectivity * Familiarity with CPO/NPO, linear\-drive optics, and next\-gen packaging as it hits the rack * Time at a high\-velocity AI cloud, GPU cloud, or custom\-compute hardware team ### **ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:** * Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed to support design releases, line bring\-up, and cluster deployments * Must be willing to travel to manufacturing and datacenter sites * Ability to work in active datacenter and factory environments, including fiber inspection, cleaning, and live debug *SpaceXAI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our* *Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

High\-power rack electrical integration: busbar, PDU, 48V, high\-current 3\-phase, grounding, and service safety * Cable and fiber physical design inside the rack (MPO/OSFP dress, bend radius, service Comfort in a factory or datacenter build environment, including first articles, yield, and hardware debug on the floor ### **ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:** * Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed to support design releases, line bring\-up, and cluster deployments * Must be willing to travel to manufacturing and datacenter sites * Ability to lift up to 25 lbs. unassisted and work around active factory and datacenter hardware *SpaceXAI is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description: **About Spark Advisors** ------------------------ We're building healthcare tech for a system that desperately needs it. Each year, millions of Americans deal with confusing changes to their Medicare plans that impact their prescriptions, access to care, and pocketbooks. These aren’t just inconveniences – they are potentially life\-altering changes that leave seniors medically and financially vulnerable. Independent Medicare advisors play a crucial role in guiding seniors through this complexity and helping them find the right coverage for their needs. But their ability to be effective healthcare advocates has long been hamstrung by broken tools and outdated systems. Spark is fixing that. We’re the fastest\-growing Medicare platform in the country, combining AI, an industry\-leading CRM, and client services to transform how 10,000\+ brokers acquire, enroll, and support clients in their local communities. Join a talent\-dense team from Square, Ramp, Yext, Oscar, and Cedar — backed by Primary Ventures and Viewpoint Ventures — that is serious about building technology to expand access to quality healthcare. We offer remote work, sabbaticals, company retreats, and other generous benefits that earned us recognition as one of Inc. Magazine’s Best Workplaces of 2025 Healthcare is overdue for innovation. Let’s redefine what its future looks like — together. **Summary** ----------- Spark is hiring an Engineering Manager to lead the team behind our broker productivity product. Our web\-based broker platform is the best in the industry, and our customer base is growing fast. You'll make sure the platform keeps up with that growth and stays reliable, scalable and easy to maintain. This is a hands\-on leadership role. You'll own engineering for your squad from start to finish. You'll partner with Product and Design to understand how our services and workflows run today and find ways to improve them. You'll coach and guide a team of software engineers as they design and ship full\-stack solutions. You'll also work with other engineering leaders to grow our technical foundation and keep quality and performance high. This is a fully remote position. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Build and guide the development of new product features to enable a frictionless broker experience * Architect and design elegant technical solutions with a focus on impact * Review code and specs and guide the technical direction of the team * Support the development and prioritization of our tech infrastructure roadmap * Provide mentorship and career coaching to direct reports, meeting individuals where they are * Balance hands\-on work with higher level technical guidance * Coordinate with product to drive planning, prioritization, and execution of the roadmap * Sequence and scope projects to align with business goals * Manage team processes and productivity to ensure alignment and timely delivery of projects **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 5\-8\+ years in full stack software engineering in a startup environment * Strong technical foundation in developing software with Python and Django or similar * Experience architecting and owning production systems and complex frameworks * Experience using javascript frameworks such as Vue or React * 1\+ years in leading engineering teams in a management capacity * Player/coach leadership style, balancing hands\-on work with team management * Experience hiring, growing and managing software engineers * Ability to collaborate directly with product, design, data and cross\-functional stakeholders * Ability to understand complex business problems and scope and develop elegant technical solutions * Strong project management, planning and prioritization skills with a focus on delivery * Strong communication skills **More about our stack and the role** ------------------------------------- * Our stack is Python, Django, Celery, Vue, Redis and Postgres * We run on AWS and use modern tools for version control, continuous deployment, testing and observability * You'll manage a team of 3\+ engineers **Compensation** ---------------- *Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our company’s size and industry, and are one part of the total compensation package that also includes equity, benefits, and other opportunities at Spark. In accordance with New York City, Colorado, California, and other applicable laws, Spark is required to provide a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. Individual pay decisions are ultimately based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, geography, and balancing internal equity. A reasonable estimate of the current salary range is* *listed below**. We expect most candidates to fall in the middle of the range. We also believe that your personal needs and preferences should be taken into consideration, so we allow some choice between equity and cash.* Base Salary $200,000 \- $225,000 USD **Why you should join our team** By joining Spark, you will get in on the ground floor of a fast\-moving, well\-funded, and mission\-driven startup where you will have a profound impact on the brokers and beneficiaries we serve. And you'll learn, grow, be challenged, and have fun with your team while doing it. We strive to help you and your family thrive. We're committed to supporting your happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing a comprehensive benefits program. In addition to your base salary, we also offer: * Equity compensation * Health care, including dental and vision through our PEO Sequoia * Flexible work location; co\-working available * 401k * Paid Time Off * Monthly Remote Work Stipend (help cover costs of home\-office needs) * Paid Parental Leave * Up to 14 weeks for birthing parents * Up to 8 weeks for non\-birth parents * 11 paid holidays * 2 week sabbatical at 5 years of employment * Wellbeing Perks through SpringHealth, OneMedical, PerkSpot, and SoFi **Compliance** Spark is a proud participant in E\-Verify. As part of our commitment to compliance, we use the E\-Verify program to confirm the employment eligibility of all employees working in the United States. For more information about E\-Verify, please visit www.e\-verify.gov. Furthermore, for security and compliance requirements, we’re unable to accommodate international remote work. While we fully support travel and time off, all work must be conducted from an approved location within the U.S. At Spark, we are committed to hiring the best team to serve our clients regardless of their background. We need diverse perspectives to reflect the diversity of our problems and the population we serve. We look to hire people from a variety of backgrounds, including, but not limited to, race, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, disability, and veteran status. **AI Notice:** We may use AI\-enabled tools to assist with certain aspects of our hiring process. These tools do not replace human decision\-making, and all employment decisions are made by qualified team members in compliance with applicable laws.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Industrial AI
jobs.description: **Who we are.** =============== Spot AI turns cameras into coworkers. We are building the category of AI coworkers for the physical world. Our platform helps businesses understand, automate, and act across their environments in real time. Spot AI is relied on at over 10,000 locations by more than 1,000 customers across manufacturing, construction, logistics, and retail. We are backed by over $110 million from investors including Scale, Redpoint, Qualcomm Ventures, StepStone, and Bessemer. We move fast, take ownership, and focus on outcomes. We are building a company for people who want to solve real problems and have a direct impact on how businesses operate. Ready to learn more? Connect with us on LinkedIn \| X \| YouTube **We’re looking for a builder to help scale our AI Agents for manufacturing.** ============================================================================== Manufacturing represents Spot AI's strongest growth driver. Our AI Ops Assistant and autonomous agents are actively deployed on production lines across major national manufacturers, driving continuous demand for expanded floor level capabilities. We are seeking a Product Manager to own execution for our manufacturing agents product line and convert this momentum into a scalable enterprise product. In this role, you will identify high impact customer challenges, develop reusable platform capabilities, and transform custom implementations into a scalable business model. This domain involves complex, unstructured environments. You will partner with operational leaders who manage intricate workflows, navigate high stakes environments, and demand immediate, measurable value from technology. Successful product managers at Spot AI act as hands on builders. They collaborate closely with engineering to resolve technical tradeoffs, conduct direct plant floor evaluations, and launch products that achieve sustained operational adoption. Prior domain expertise in manufacturing is not required. We prioritize candidates with a demonstrated track record of building B2B products from ground zero, who are AI native, and have helped scale a product customers are already pulling for. **Your assignment.** ==================== ##### ***Uncover High Value Opportunities*** * Engage directly with clients, account executives, sales engineers, channel partners, FDE, and field teams to map out workflows, operational friction, budget parameters, and key success metrics. * Identify top tier use cases by evaluating genuine strategic value and recommend appropriate priorities ##### ***Develop Scalable Platform Core Capabilities*** * Transform custom, single client solutions into standardized product features that seamlessly scale across multiple facilities and organizations. * Recognize core components within each implementation to accelerate future deployments at scale. ##### ***Collaborate Closely with Technical Teams*** * Partner directly with engineering teams on AI models, evaluation pipelines, system architecture, and iterative prototyping. * Own technical prioritization for your product area, by deciding what features to develop, postpone, or reject. ##### ***Partner on Go\-to\-Market Strategy \& Execution*** * Establish an end to end framework spanning discovery, proof of concept testing, full production rollout, and commercial scaling. * Align with sales, marketing, and customer success leadership on market positioning, pricing models, demonstrations, and ROI case studies to streamline commercial adoption. **Who you are.** ================ Whether you have operated as a founder, product manager, technical product lead, or forward\-deployed engineer, what we value most is your proven track record of directly building products and delivering them to real\-world users. Ideal candidates bring the following qualities: * Entrepreneurial Mindset: Experience as a founder or early stage startup builder who has shipped B2B products from concept to market adoption and revenue growth under resource constraints. * High Agency \& Speed: You move quickly and can clearly demonstrate what you built, scaled, and delivered over the last six months. * Real World AI Expertise: A strong grasp of AI model behavior in practical deployments, including accuracy trade\-offs, false positives, latency, and cost. * Hands\-On Problem Solving: A builder who actively prototypes, analyzes data, and works directly alongside engineering teams instead of depending on static spec sheets. * Customer \& Commercial Orientation: Eager to collaborate closely with sales teams and customers to unearth key insights that drive product decisions. * Strong Interpersonal \& Technical Credibility: Ability to seamlessly navigate conversations ranging from deep technical reviews with engineers to onsite customer meetings. * Scalable Product Judgment: Sharp instincts for separating unique, isolated customer requests from repeatable, platform\-level features. * Clear \& Impactful Communication: Ability to convert ambiguity into crisp product requirements, go to market strategies, and compelling business models. * A background in computer vision, video AI, industrial automation, robotics, or forward deployed engineering is a strong plus. *Note that this is an IN PERSON role at our office located at 650 5th St. (near Oracle Park) in San Francisco. There will also be occasional travel to customer sites.* *Unfortunately we are not able to offer relocation assistance or visa sponsorship for this opportunity.* ##### ***You could be an ideal fit if you:*** * Are eager to expand and scale a product customers are actively pulling for. * Thrive in ambiguous environments and excel at spotting underlying trends within custom client requirements. * Are equally passionate about partnering with engineering teams and spending time onsite with customers. * Can articulate how you will help shape the product experience and platform capabilities for manufacturing customers. ##### ***This role is probably not a good fit if you:*** * Favor following a pre\-established roadmap over uncovering and defining new product directions. * Prefer authoring strategy documents rather than actively building and launching features. * Feel more at home in a hierarchical product management structure than taking an entrepreneurial, founder\-like approach. * Are unable or unwilling to work on site from our San Francisco office location. **Compensation and Benefits.** ============================== * Target Annual Base Salary Offer Range: $195,000 \- $210,000 in the San Francisco Bay Area. The offered salary will depend on the offered candidate’s demonstrated skills and competencies for the role. * Meaningful early stage equity. * Medical, dental, and vision plan options with little to no cost for employees and dependents. * Company paid short and long term disability plans. * Company paid life insurance. * 401K with employer match. If you want to define a new category of AI for the physical world, and build the product that makes every deployment faster than the last, we should talk. *The full annual base salary range for this position is $195,000 \- $225,000\. We hire within the target range so every new Spotan has meaningful room to grow their pay over time.* *We are creating and cultivating a diverse and inclusive culture where we celebrate individuals for what they accomplish, no matter who they are. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: Being good neighbors – helping people, investing in our communities, and making the world a better place – is who we are at State Farm. It is at the core of how we operate and the reason for our success. We're moving with urgency to become a Next Gen Good Neighbor, with technology that strengthens human connections and enhances the customer experience. As an employee, you'll spend less time navigating systems and more time applying judgment, empathy, and expertise in the moments that matter most. **HYBRID:** Qualified candidates (in or near hub locations listed below) should plan to spend time working from home and some time working in the office as part of our hybrid work environment. Hybrid work arrangement for Enterprise Technology is defined as residing with a 180\-mile radius of the Hubs and Corporate. **HUB LOCATIONS:** Richardson, TX or Bloomington, IL **SPONSORSHIP: Applicants are required to be eligible to lawfully work in the U.S. immediately; employer will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work authorization (e.g., H\-1B visa) for this opportunity.** Grow Your Skills, Grow Your Potential: Responsibilities: The Agent Office Identification (AOI) team builds the technology that connects State Farm customers with their agents — the Agent Locator, Agent Search, agent microsites, and the APIs that power them. If you've ever searched for a State Farm agent online or visited an agent web page, you've used something our team built. As an engineer here, you'll own solutions from concept through production — not just write code to a spec. You'll work directly with product, business partners, analytics, UX, and other engineers to figure out what's broken, shape the fix, and ship it. You'll have real input into technical decisions early in your career, not just once you're senior. Our platform runs on AWS and Red Hat OpenShift Service on AWS (ROSA). Right now, we're modernizing legacy systems into reusable services, strengthening data quality and security, and using AI\-assisted tools like GitHub Copilot, Codex to build faster and better. You'll be learning modern cloud\-native engineering practices from engineers who are actively modernizing a platform that touches millions of customer interactions — not maintaining something static. If you want to grow fast, take real ownership early, and see your code affect how customers actually find and connect with an agent, this is that role. What we're looking for: 2\-3 years of professional software development experience, or a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field plus relevant internship/project experience. Qualifications: **Key Skills \& Abilities:** * Ability to build relationships across multiple teams and levels of the organization * Ability to quickly adapt to a changing environment * Ability to foster innovation, encourage diversity of thought, and incorporate new ideas * Experience or comfort working in an agile environment * Strong communication skills, both verbal and written **Technical competencies:** Primary Skills * Full\-stack development experience with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and JavaScript. * Hands\-on experience deploying and supporting applications on cloud/container platforms such as AWS, OpenShift, or Kubernetes. * Ability to design scalable, object\-oriented applications using modern design patterns. * Understanding of software engineering best practices, including code quality, automated testing, maintainability, and working with relational databases. * Experience using AI\-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Codex to accelerate development, testing, debugging and documentation. Desired Skills * Experience with Angular, JavaScript, and modern front\-end frameworks. * Experience with ROSA/OpenShift and cloud\-native application deployment. * Experience delivering software from concept through production. * Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams. Our Benefits: Because work\-life balance is a priority at State Farm, compensation is based on our standard 38:45\-hour work week!* Potential starting salary range: $85,500 \- $125,000 + Starting salary will be based on skills, background, and experience + High end of the range limited to applicants with significant relevant experience * Potential yearly incentive pay up to 15% of base salary **At State Farm, we offer more than just a paycheck. Check out our suite of benefits designed to give you the flexibility you need to take care of you and your family!*** **Get Paid!** On top of our competitive pay, you are eligible for an annual raise and bonus. * **Stay Well!** Focus on you and your family’s health with our robust health and wellbeing programs. State Farm pays most of your healthcare premium, and we offer multiple healthcare plan options, including a high deductible plan. All medical plans provide 100% coverage for in\-network preventative care, AND you and your family have access to vision, dental, telemedicine, 24/7 mental health professionals, and much more! * **Develop and Grow!** Take advantage of educational benefits like industry leading training programs, top\-notch tuition assistance programs, employee resource groups, and mentoring. * **Plan Ahead!** Plan for those big moments in life with benefits like fertility/IVF/adoption assistance, college coaching, national discount programs, interactive monthly financial workshops, free financial coaching, and more. You can also start a savings account or consider financing through our State Farm Federal Credit Union! * **Take a Little “You” Time!** You will have access to our generous time off policies designed so you can plan around holidays, family events, volunteering, or just to take a relaxing day off. With the opportunity to initially earn up to 20 days annually plus parental leave, paid holidays, celebration day, life leave (40 hours/year), bereavement leave, and community service/education support days, there will be plenty of time for you! * **Give Back!** We offer several ways to give back through our Matching Gift Program, Good Neighbor Grant Program, and the Employee Assistance Fund. * **Finish Strong!** Plan for retirement using free financial advisors and a 401(k) plan with company contributions of up to 7% of your salary. **Visit our** **State Farm Careers** **page for more information on our** **benefits****,** **locations****, and the** **hiring process** **of joining the State Farm team!**

jobs.title: Oracle Database Administration Supervisor I
jobs.description: Job Summary \- Why you’ll love this position **Location**: Office of State Courts Administrator, Jefferson City, MO **The salary reflected represents the base pay for this position and does not include any differential for time\-of\-service pay for state tenure.** **Why you'll love this position:** A position with the Office of State Courts Administrator provides you the opportunity to work with a variety of exceptional, hardworking people and to gain a valuable and rewarding career. It takes many types of talent to advance the mission of the Missouri Judiciary and to keep operations running smoothly. We have opportunities for individuals seeking meaningful work in providing administrative, business and information technology services to the Missouri courts. We are recruiting to fill a Oracle Database Administration Supervisor I position to supervise Oracle Database Administration staff in all areas, set priorites for staff, ensuring those priorities align with orginzational goals. This role also works as a Senior Oracle Database Administrator and performs installation and configuguration of the database software, research and planning of new releases and upgrades, and supporting the deployed products. They perform hands\-on database administration including the maintenance, backup, recovery, tuning and monitoring of all databases. This role requires a proactive approach to risk management, particularly concerning information security risks, and ensures optimal database performance through tuning and maintenance. In addition they are able to work as the highest level support engineer with knowledge and ability to respond to on\-call situations. Responsibilities \- What you’ll do * Trains, supervises, mentors, evaluates and motivates assigned staff * Determines and defines work assignments, delegates work related to the efficient operation of all OSCA computer systems analysis and design or other information technology specialties * Confers with management relative to strategic planning, long term priorities and agency goals; implements data\-gathering and programming techniques; directs feasibility studies; recommends computer information technology solutions; and manages project implementation * Communicates with vendors on hardware and software developments, and directs or conducts the research, recommendation, and preparation of requests for proposals or bid specifications for hardware and software purchases * Supervises the development and application of standards and procedures necessary to develop, install, and maintain efficient computer information technology systems. * Supervises and participates in computer systems disaster recovery plan maintenance and implementation. * Manages and maintains all organizational Oracle Windows, Linux, and Exadata Systems that utilize technologies including RAC, ASM, Active Data Guard, and RMAN to complete and validate backups, monitor performance and troubleshooting errors * Develops and executes database strategies to ensure data integrity and availability, including backup, restore, restart and recovery routines (and if appropriate, disaster recovery); collaborates with relevant specialist teams in the wider organization * Collaborates with cross\-functional teams to develop and implement database solutions to support business needs * Monitors database security to ensure data is protected and complies with data privacy regulations, in conjunction with the wider security team * Monitors performance, service\-level adherence and trends to alert management, development and operations teams about runtime performance problems * Creates and maintains database documentation, including data standards, procedures and definitions * Plans and executes database installs, updates and migrations to new hosts, working closely with technical teams to ensure minimal downtime and impact on users * Collaborates with vendors to resolve database\-related issues and implement new features Qualifications \- All you need for success **Minimum qualifications:** Bachelor's degree with at least 15 semester hours in computer science, computer information systems, or closely related areas and 7 years of professional and technical computer information systems experience, including 2 years of experience as an Oracle Database Administrator, and 2 years of experience as a Senior Oracle Database Administrator, and at least 1 year of supervisory experience; Or 2 years of experience as a Senior Oracle Database Administrator with the Office of State Courts Administrator. Additional experience above the minimum stated may be substituted on a year for year basis for the required education. Job Details \- More reasons to love this position The State of Missouri offers an excellent benefits package that includes a defined pension plan, generous amounts of leave and holiday time, and eligibility for health insurance coverage. Your total compensation is more than the dollars you receive in your paycheck. More information regarding employment and benefits can be found here: OSCA Benefits. To review an interactive total compensation calculator, click the following link: Compensation Calculator Contact Details \- If you have questions or require any accommodations to participate in the application or interview process please contact: Please send inquiries regarding this position or questions regarding employment with the Office of State Courts Administrator to: OSCAHumanResources@courts.mo.gov The State of Missouri is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to developing and maintaining a talented workforce.

jobs.title: Machine Vision System Programmer
jobs.description: Description: **Give Machines the Power to See.** At Steven Douglas Corp. (SDC), we design, engineer, and build custom automation systems that solve complex manufacturing challenges for customers across medical, consumer products, industrial, automotive, and other industries. No two projects are the same. Our engineers work on high\-performance custom equipment from concept through startup, solving new technical challenges every day instead of maintaining the same production line. If you enjoy building machines from the ground up, collaborating with a talented team, and seeing your work come to life on the customer's floor, we'd love to talk with you. **What You’ll Do****:** * Own the vision system portion of multiple automation projects from concept through customer acceptance. * Design, develop, and implement industrial machine vision solutions for automated inspection, measurement, alignment, and part verification. * Program and configure Keyence (IV, XG, CV, VS, LumiTrax, etc.) and Cognex (In\-Sight, VisionPro, Designer) vision systems using standardized, scalable programming practices. * Develop robust lighting, lensing, and image acquisition strategies for varying part types and environments. * Integrate vision systems with PLCs, robots, motion controllers, and HMIs, developing communication interfaces using Ethernet/IP, Profinet, TCP/IP, serial, and vendor\-specific protocols. * Support robotic guidance applications, including calibration, coordinate transformation, and high\-precision alignment. * Lead vision system debug during machine assembly, runoff, FAT/SAT, installation, and startup, diagnosing image reliability issues caused by lighting, reflectivity, vibration, or mechanical variation. * Collaborate daily with Electrical/Controls Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Project Management, and Service to deliver successful projects. * jobs.title: AI Architect
jobs.description: **Job Description:** **About Streamline Healthcare Solutions**Here at Streamline, we strive on building lasting and trusting relationships with our clients, and our employees set the bar. Streamline’s mission is to build innovative technology solutions that empower people who improve behavioral health and quality of life of those in need. We are a high growth technology company that delivers web\-based software for healthcare organizations to provide and coordinate all service delivery processes. Streamline has been offering software in the behavioral health marketplace since 2003\. Streamline has built and maintains systems for some of the nation’s premier behavioral health organizations using the latest web\-based technology. Streamline offers competitive compensation and benefits packages as well as a challenging, yet flexible, work environment that is conducive to collaboration and productivity. A career with Streamline Healthcare Solutions provides opportunities for growth and continued learning in a workplace where individual contribution is valued and recognized. Join us, and advance your career today with a company that is on the cutting edge of the behavioral healthcare technology industry. **Summary of the AI Architect** The AI Architect owns the enterprise AI architecture, standards, and governance for healthcare\-grade solutions—establishing reference patterns, platforms, and guardrails that product teams use to safely and efficiently deliver LLM applications, RAG systems, and ML services. This role partners with Security/Compliance, Data/Platform, and Product leaders to ensure HIPAA\-aligned handling of PHI/PII, Responsible AI practices, and measurable clinical and business outcomes. The ideal candidate brings deep Azure experience (including Azure AI Foundry / Azure AI Studio), broad knowledge of OpenAI or Anthropic models, and proven enterprise architecture leadership. This position is remote and based in the United States. The salary range is $150,000 \- $200,000, DOE. Employment visa sponsorship is not available for this role. **Responsibilities of the AI Architect** **Enterprise Architecture \& Standards** * Define and maintain reference architectures for LLM applications, RAG patterns, classical ML, and AI\-enabled services across the organization. * Establish solution blueprints for embeddings/vector search, prompt orchestration, guardrails/safety layers, evaluation frameworks, lineage, and observability. * Publish SLO/SLA templates, token/GPU budget rules, multi\-tenancy/isolation approaches, and cost governance playbooks. **Platform \& Tooling** * Own platform and tooling selection for Azure AI (Azure AI Foundry/Studio, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure ML), Databricks (Delta Lake, MLflow), and orchestration (Airflow or Azure Data Factory). * Define standard patterns for vector databases (e.g., Azure AI Search, Pinecone, FAISS), feature store usage, and data ingestion/streaming. * Provide reference implementations and reusable accelerators (RAG starter kit, evaluation harness, prompt library, safety policies). **Security, Compliance \& Responsible AI** * Embed PHI/PII safeguards and HIPAA\-aligned controls into SDLC and CI/CD gates; standardize data boundaries, de\-identification/anonymization (e.g., Presidio), Key Vault, encryption, RBAC, and auditability. * Define and operationalize Responsible AI requirements (bias/fairness evaluations, model cards, data sheets, red\-teaming) as release criteria. * Partner with Security/Compliance on risk assessments, release approvals, and policy updates; review high\-risk use cases **Solution Governance \& Reviews** * Lead the AI Architecture Review process; manage deviations from standards with an exception register and migration plans. * Advise squads on prompt design, tool/function calling, grounding/RAG strategies, evaluation design (hallucination, safety, utility), and observability (latency, accuracy, drift, cost). **Collaboration \& Enablement** * Collaborate with Lead AI Software Engineers, data scientists, and platform teams to land architectures in production. * Mentor teams in Azure AI Foundry, OpenAI/Anthropic model usage, Microsoft Copilot, and GitHub Copilot—including governance and data leakage prevention. * Run communities of practice, internal training, and publish architecture decision records (ADRs) and technical standards. **Education and Experience Requirements for the AI Architect** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Information Systems, Health Informatics, or a related field. * 10\+ years in software/solution architecture with 5\+ years in AI/ML systems and 2\+ years leading enterprise AI architecture or platform initiatives. * Enterprise cloud architecture (Azure): Azure AI Foundry (Azure AI Studio), Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure ML, Azure Key Vault, networking/IAM, encryption, logging/monitoring. * Hands\-on architectural experience with OpenAI or Anthropic models (e.g., GPT‑4\.x/4o, Claude 3\.x): prompt \& tool calling patterns, grounding/RAG, evaluation methodologies. * Demonstrated Responsible AI leadership: guardrails, safety filters, bias/fairness evaluations, model cards/datasheets, and red\-teaming processes. * Security \& privacy familiarity: PHI/PII protections and HIPAA\-aligned design patterns; ability to translate policy into technical controls and CI/CD checks. * Data platform fluency: Databricks (Delta Lake, MLflow), Spark, orchestration (Airflow or Azure Data Factory/Synapse), and data governance (e.g., Purview). * MLOps standards: model registry, CI/CD for ML, environment isolation, canary/A/B testing, drift/performance/cost monitoring, rollback strategies. * Strong understanding of SQL Server data modeling and performance; able to guide teams using SSMS and review T‑SQL patterns for AI data workloads. * Familiarity with Visual Studio and .NET integration patterns to ensure AI services fit the enterprise application ecosystem. * Experience enabling secure, governed use of Microsoft Copilot and GitHub Copilot in engineering workflows. * Excellent communication and influence skills; proven success leading architecture reviews and driving cross\-functional decisions. **Preferred Education and Experience Requirements for the AI Architect** * Healthcare domain knowledge (clinical or revenue cycle management): FHIR/HL7, EHR/claims data integration, and clinical NLP (entity extraction, summarization, coding/RCM use cases). * Inference optimization: GPU/CUDA, quantization/distillation, caching strategies, prompt/token budgeting, multi\-tenant cost control. * Security/compliance certifications (e.g., HCISPP, CISSP) or demonstrable leadership in healthcare\-grade architectures. * Track record of creating reusable accelerators/libraries/platform capabilities adopted across multiple teams. * Governance \& ethics: model cards, datasheets for datasets, bias/fairness evaluations, and red\-teaming. * Familiarity with .NET microservices and API design to integrate AI services into enterprise systems. *Streamline Healthcare Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, military status, national origin, or any other characteristic protected under federal, state, or applicable local law.*

jobs.title: Application Engineer II - WMS
jobs.description: **Summary** The Application Engineer II designs, configures, enhances, maintains, and supports business\-critical Warehouse Management System (WMS) applications. Working within established architecture and technical direction, this independent contributor applies technical and warehouse process knowledge to deliver reliable system changes, integrations, reports, and production support solutions. The position partners with warehouse operations, business analysts, technical teams, and vendors throughout the solution lifecycle. Enterprise WMS experience is required. Strong hands\-on Oracle SQL and PL/SQL skills are required to analyze WMS data, troubleshoot application behavior, support integrations, develop reports, and perform query\-level optimization. This is a WMS application engineering role, not a database administration role. Manhattan WMOS experience is preferred, but candidates with experience in another enterprise WMS and the ability to learn Manhattan WMOS will be considered. **Primary Responsibilities** * Application Software Development \- 20%: Configure and enhance WMS functionality and develop application components, integrations, operational and analytical reports, and technical utilities based on approved warehouse business and technical requirements. * Application Software Maintenance \- 20%: Diagnose and correct complex WMS application defects using logs, SQL, interface data, configuration, and system behavior analysis. Perform query\-level analysis and optimization, and engage database specialists for indexing, instance tuning, database architecture, or other database administration changes. * Application Software Roadmap \- 15%: Contribute to the WMS application roadmap by assessing business needs, system capabilities, enhancements, upgrades, integrations, technical improvements, and support priorities. * Testing and Performance \- 15%: Design and execute WMS functional, integration, regression, and application performance tests. Support system integration testing, user acceptance testing, production deployment, and post\-release validation. * Documentation and Recovery \- 15%: Create and maintain technical documentation, support procedures, interface specifications, test evidence, and user documentation. Follow established source control, backup, and recovery practices. * Horizon Scanning \- 15%: Develop an understanding of WMS capabilities, warehouse technology, and relevant product developments. Contribute to evaluating their potential impact and usefulness to the organization. **Additional Responsibilities** * Partner with warehouse operations and business analysts to understand inbound, inventory, outbound, and shipping processes; clarify requirements; and implement approved WMS solutions. * Support interfaces between WMS, ERP, transportation, parcel, automation, reporting, and related platforms. * Configure and support WMS functions, workflows, and business rules within established standards and design direction. * Use SQL and PL/SQL to analyze WMS transactions and data, investigate production issues, support interfaces, and develop operational and analytical reports. Validate report accuracy and optimize application queries when needed. * Collaborate with internal teams, consultants, software vendors, and infrastructure partners to resolve issues and deliver changes. * Provide clear status updates, document root cause and resolution, and contribute to knowledge transfer within the team. * Participate in scheduled on\-call and after\-hours production support as required. * Follow organizational change management, security, software development, and project delivery practices. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in a related field of study required, or high school diploma with equivalent relevant experience in lieu of a degree. * At least 4–6 years of relevant and progressive experience, including hands\-on support, implementation, configuration, or enhancement of an enterprise WMS, required. * Ability to work independently on assigned solutions while seeking guidance for unfamiliar, high\-risk, or architectural decisions. * Experience supporting a business\-critical WMS production environment and resolving application, configuration, data, and integration issues. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, documentation, communication, and collaboration skills. * Demonstrated ability and willingness to learn new applications, warehouse processes, and technical tools. **Technical and Domain Skills** * Hands\-on experience with Manhattan WMOS, Blue Yonder/JDA, SAP EWM, Oracle WMS, or a comparable enterprise WMS. * Strong understanding of warehouse operations, including inbound, inventory management, replenishment, picking, packing, shipping, and fulfillment processes. * Strong hands\-on Oracle SQL and practical PL/SQL skills, including complex queries, data analysis, report development, production troubleshooting, and execution\-plan\-based query optimization. Ability to understand, troubleshoot, and modify existing procedures, functions, and packages used by WMS applications. * Experience developing operational and analytical reports using SQL and reporting tools. * Experience tracing WMS integrations and transaction flows across messages, files, APIs, batch processes, and dependent applications to identify and resolve failures. * Familiarity with Unix or Linux environments, application logs, job scheduling, and common production support tools. * Experience designing and executing system, integration, regression, and user acceptance tests. * Intermediate application development or scripting capability used to support WMS enhancements, integrations, automation, and technical utilities. * Ability to connect warehouse process knowledge with system behavior and data analysis, validate report results, and recommend practical application solutions. **Preferred Experience** * Hands\-on Manhattan WMOS experience in one or more functional areas. * Experience with WMS integrations to ERP, transportation, parcel, automation, or material\-handling systems. * Experience in a high\-volume warehouse or distribution environment. * Experience working with software vendors and cross\-functional delivery teams. **Travel Requirements** Domestic travel: Up to 20% **Driver's License Required?** No **WORK ENVIRONMENT** * **Office Location:** Camden, NJ apart of the Greater Philadelphia Area (Philly) **or** Coppell, TX (apart of the Dallas\-Fort Worth Metroplex) **or** Lithia Springs, GA (apart of the Greater Atlanta Area) * **Hybrid Role:** Hybrid Role \- Remote work 2 days per week (after 90 days) \[Wednesdays \& Fridays] **COMPENSATION:** The recruiting base salary range for this full\-time position is $95,000 \- $115,000 / year. Within the range, individual pay is determined by factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Additionally, this role is **bonus\-eligible** , with a target bonus percentage that provides an opportunity to earn even more based on your performance. (Internal Job Grade: P2T) **WHY JOIN US?** In addition to competitive salary and an incomparable culture, Subaru offers an amazing benefits package that include: **Total Rewards \& Benefits:** * Medical, Dental, Vision Plans * Pension, Profit Sharing, and 401K Match Offerings * 15 Vacation days, 5 Floating Holidays, 5 Sick days, and 9 Company Holidays * Tuition Reimbursement Program: Fifteen\-thousand\-dollar yearly benefit * Vehicle Discount Programs **Learning \& Development:** * Professional growth and development opportunities * Direct partnership with senior leadership * Formal Mentorship Program * LinkedIn Learning License Visit our careers landing page for additional information about our compensation and benefit programs. **ABOUT SUBARU** Love. It’s what makes Subaru, Subaru®. As a leading auto brand in the US, we strive to be More Than a Car Company®. Subaru believes in being a positive force in the communities in which we live and work, not just with donations but with actions that set an example for others to follow. That’s what we call our Subaru Love Promise®. Subaru is a globally renowned automobile manufacturer known for its commitment to innovation, safety, and sustainability. With a rich history dating back to 1953, Subaru has consistently pushed the boundaries of automotive engineering to deliver vehicles that offer not only exceptional performance but also a unique blend of utility and adventure. Subaru's company culture is built on collaboration, diversity, and a shared passion for our product. We foster an inclusive environment that encourages employees to bring their unique perspectives and talents to the table. Our team members are driven by a common goal: to create exceptional vehicles that inspire and delight our customers.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Simulation Engineering
jobs.description: **Who we are** With its A.I.\-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high\-density, end\-to\-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility. **What We Need** ---------------- We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager to join our Simulation Engineering organization. This leader will be responsible for guiding the technical vision, strategy, and execution of our Simulation Engineering team while helping unify simulation efforts across robotics, controls, perception, software, systems, and industrial controls organizations. **What We Do** -------------- The Simulation Engineering team develops simulation platforms, tooling, infrastructure, validation environments, and system models used to accelerate the development of Symbotic's robotic systems and automation technologies. Through simulation\-driven engineering, the team enables engineers to design, develop, test, validate, and optimize complex robotic systems before physical deployment. These capabilities help accelerate product development, reduce technical risk, improve product quality, and increase confidence in engineering decisions. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Define and execute the strategy for simulation engineering, platform development, validation environments, and system modeling. * Lead the development of simulation platforms, infrastructure, tooling, and engineering workflows used across the organization. * Drive the architecture and technical direction of simulation systems supporting robotics, perception, controls, software, and automation technologies. * Partner with cross\-functional engineering teams to accelerate development through simulation\-driven testing, validation, experimentation, and analysis. * Lead, mentor, and develop a team of simulation and modeling engineers while establishing technical standards and engineering best practices. * Drive alignment across software, controls, robotics, perception, systems, and industrial controls organizations to establish a unified simulation ecosystem and strategy. * Influence engineering decisions through simulation\-driven insights, technical recommendations, system\-level analysis, performance prediction, and design evaluation. * Support future robotics and automation initiatives by improving simulation fidelity, scalability, performance, and adoption across engineering teams. * Develop simulation capabilities that improve product development velocity, validation effectiveness, system performance, and deployment readiness. * Partner with internal engineering teams and stakeholders to ensure simulation capabilities remain aligned with product development priorities and business objectives. * Communicate complex technical concepts and recommendations to engineering and executive leadership. * Drive alignment across teams to ensure simulation efforts are focused on the highest\-impact engineering challenges. * Partner with internal and external stakeholders to communicate simulation\-driven recommendations, technical tradeoffs, and engineering insights. * Support customer\-facing and executive\-level discussions by translating complex technical concepts and simulation results into actionable recommendations. **What You'll Need** -------------------- * Minimum of 10 years of experience in simulation, modeling, robotics, controls, systems engineering, software engineering, autonomy, operations research, or related technical disciplines. * Minium of 3 years of engineering management experience leading technical teams. * Experience leading engineering teams responsible for simulation platforms, modeling capabilities, validation systems, software engineering or related technologies. * Strong understanding of simulation architecture, engineering workflows, system validation, and complex technical problem solving. * Experience developing or utilizing simulation to improve development, validation, testing, optimization or performance of complex systems. * Experience driving cross\-functional engineering initiatives across multiple organizations and technology domains. * Excellent communication, collaboration, and leadership skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders ranging from individual contributors to executive leadership. * Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast\-paced, and highly technical environments. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience with robotics, autonomous systems, perception systems, controls systems, industrial automation, or other complex cyber\-physical systems. * Experience with simulation\-driven development, HIL/SIL, system validation, or related methodologies. * Experience building or extending simulation platforms, infrastructure, or engineering tooling. * Experience helping engineering organizations adopt simulation to improve development velocity and product outcomes. * Experience aligning simulation efforts across multiple engineering organizations and technology domains. **Our Environment** ------------------- * Up to **10% travel** may be required. Employees must have a valid driver's license and the ability to drive and/or fly to client and other customer locations. * Employees may be required to use a personal credit card for business travel expenses, which are reimbursed based on program guidelines. Eligible employees may receive a corporate credit card based on role and travel requirements, but a personal credit card may be needed during onboarding until the corporate card is issued. **\#LI\-JS1** **\#LI\-Onsite** **About Symbotic** Symbotic is an automation technology leader reimagining the supply chain with its end\-to\-end, AI\-powered robotic and software platform. Symbotic reinvents the warehouse as a strategic asset for the world’s largest retail, wholesale, and food \& beverage companies. Applying next\-gen technology, high\-density storage and machine learning to solve today's complex distribution challenges, Symbotic enables companies to move goods with unmatched speed, agility, accuracy and efficiency. As the backbone of commerce the Symbotic platform transforms the flow of goods and the economics of supply chain for its customers. For more information, visit www.symbotic.com. We are a community of innovators, collaborators and pioneers who embrace our differences, because we know unique perspectives make us stronger and smarter. Every perspective matters. We depend on the collective voices of our employees, customers and community to help guide us as we build a better place to work – for you and the world. That’s why we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or genetic information.
