jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Network Analytics Platform
jobs.description: **About this role:** Wells Fargo is seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer to help design, build, and scale the next generation of enterprise network analytics and observability solutions. This role will be responsible for developing core platform capabilities that support network performance analytics, capacity intelligence, application visibility, network experience measurement, and data\-driven operational insights. The engineer will work closely with network engineers, architects, data engineers, platform engineers, and business stakeholders. This position offers a unique opportunity to influence the architecture and development of an enterprise\-scale analytics platform built on modern software engineering principles, API\-first design, automated data pipelines, observability, and cloud\-native technologies. **In this role, you will:** * Lead moderately complex software engineering initiatives and technical deliverables across multiple development efforts.. * Contribute to strategic planning activities and help shape long\-term technology solutions and engineering roadmaps. * Design, develop, test, debug, deploy, and maintain scalable applications, services, APIs, and data\-driven solutions. * Build reusable software components, integration frameworks, and automation capabilities that improve operational efficiency. * Evaluate technical challenges and recommend solutions based on software engineering best practices, architecture standards, and business requirements. * Resolve complex technical issues while ensuring reliability, performance, maintainability, and security of delivered solutions. * Collaborate with engineers, architects, product owners, and technology partners to deliver high\-quality technology solutions. * Participate in architecture reviews, design discussions, code reviews, and technical decision\-making processes. * Drive engineering excellence through automated testing, software quality practices, and continuous improvement initiatives. * Lead projects and serve as a technical escalation point while mentoring and guiding less experienced engineers. * Support observability, monitoring, troubleshooting, and production support activities to ensure application stability and operational effectiveness. * Contribute to software delivery automation, release management, and engineering lifecycle best practices. * Lead projects and act as an escalation point, provide guidance and direction to less experienced staff. **Required Qualifications:** * 4\+ years of Software Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education * 4\+ experience developing applications using JavaScript and Python * Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs and microservices * Experience with source control, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines * Experience working with containerized applications and cloud\-native architectures * Experience building analytical, reporting, observability, or telemetry\-driven solutions * Strong understanding of software design patterns, application architecture, and secure coding practices * Experience troubleshooting and resolving complex production issues **Desired Qualifications:** * 4\+ years of software distributed systems * Experience designing scalable APIs, services, and backend applications * Experience with MongoDB, SQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL, or similar database technologies * Experience jobs.title: Senior Network Engineer
jobs.description: If you’re passionate about building a better future for individuals, communities, and our country—and you’re committed to working hard to play your part in building that future—consider WGU as the next step in your career. Driven by a mission to expand access to higher education through online, competency\-based degree programs, WGU is also committed to being a great place to work for a diverse workforce of student\-focused professionals. The university has pioneered a new way to learn in the 21st century, one that has received praise from academic, industry, government, and media leaders. Whatever your role, working for WGU gives you a part to play in helping students graduate, creating a better tomorrow for themselves and their families. The salary range for this position takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. At WGU, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their position, and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is: Grade: Technical 408 Pay Range: $118,900\.00 \- $178,500\.00**Job Description** The Senior Network Engineer is part of Enterprise Infrastructure Network team and is responsible for managing and maintaining the network infrastructure, as well as monitoring network availability and performance. This position will support network services for the LAN and WAN infrastructure including Palo Alto firewalls, Cisco routers, and switches and Arista wireless infrastructure. Detail oriented with the ability to work with minimum supervision, and thoughtful customer service. Availability to be on\-call for periodic tasks outside of normal working hours. Able to travel. The Senior Network Engineer is also responsible for recommending and implementing best security and performance practices for continued improvement to the network infrastructure. * This is an in\-office position designated to work 5 days a week from our Salt Lake City headquarters. **Responsibilities** * Manages and supports LAN and WAN network devices. * Manages and supports Internet access and security appliances. * Manages and supports remote and wireless access. * Tests and evaluates network systems to eliminate problems and make improvements. * Escalates network problems to appropriate vendors and/or internal personnel. * Manages technology planning through ongoing research and consulting. * Architects, plans, implements and supports the voice, data, and wireless network and computing infrastructure. * Performs other job\-related duties as assigned. * Knowledge of switching (Capacity Planning \& VLAN’s) and routing (OSPF, EIGRP, BGP) * Knowledge of WAN Technology (MPLS, VPLS, VPN) and Voice Technology (VOIP, QOS, SIP) * Skilled at large scale wireless deployments. * Ability to use security software, including anti\-virus, anti\-spam, and anti\-spyware. * Knowledgeable in application transport and network infrastructure protocols (SSL/TLS, DNS, DHCP, WINS, NTP, FTP, HTTP, SMTP, CIFS, LDAP, and Microsoft AD) and possesses an understanding of how to support these applications/protocols when accessed through VPN and firewall appliances. * Deep understanding of load balancing technologies (F5, ELB) and network automation (Cisco ACI, VRO) * Knowledge of VMware and/or Hyper\-V for server virtualization * Knowledge and experience with IPv4, IPv6, TCP, HSRP/GLBP, IPSEC, VPN, DNS, and HTTP * Energetic self\-starter * Ability to work with minimum supervision * Thorough and detail oriented * Ability to be ‘on\-call’ for period tasks outside of normal working hours. * Ability to travel * Knowledge of power management * Must be able to lift 30lbs * Experience with cross connection and rack management **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. (Equivalent relevant experience performing the essential functions of this job may substitute for education degree requirements. Generally, equivalent relevant experience is defined as 1 year of experience for 1 year of education and is the discretion of the hiring manager.) * 8 years of network administration experience * Vendor Certifications (CCNA/CCNP) * Expertise with F5/BigIP * Expertise with Palo Alto firewalls **Position \& Application Details** Full\-Time Regular Positions (classified as regular and working 40 standard weekly hours): This is a full\-time, regular position (classified for 40 standard weekly hours) that is eligible for bonuses; medical, dental, vision, telehealth and mental healthcare; health savings account and flexible spending account; basic and voluntary life insurance; disability coverage; accident, critical illness and hospital indemnity supplemental coverages; legal and identity theft coverage; retirement savings plan; wellbeing program; discounted WGU tuition; and flexible paid time off for rest and relaxation with no need for accrual, flexible paid sick time with no need for accrual, 11 paid holidays, and other paid leaves, including up to 12 weeks of parental leave. How to Apply: If interested, an application will need to be submitted online. Internal WGU employees will need to apply through the internal job board in Workday. **Additional Information** Disclaimer: The job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job. It’s not all\-inclusive. Accommodations: Applicants with disabilities who require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process should contact our Talent Acquisition team at recruiting@wgu.edu. Equal Employment Opportunity: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic as required by law.

jobs.title: Electrical Project Engineer, Wind
jobs.description: Description: **Electrical Project Engineer** **Westwood Professional Services, Inc.** **Westwood Professional Services, Inc.** is seeking an Electrical Project Engineer to support our Power Division. The position is for an electrical engineer to design solar photovoltaic (PV) systems, which includes plant layout, selecting appropriate system hardware, system optimization, determining power generation and interconnection requirements, and being a leader portions of the electrical engineering of projects. As an Electrical Project Engineer the individual will coordinate with the Project Lead, and Senior Engineers, to maintain firm standards and consistency as well as oversee junior engineers, electrical designers, and drafters on the project. This position may also include supervision responsibilities of an intern and/or new grad for timesheet/expense/PTO approval, annual growth planning, and disciplinary actions Requirements: * Lead electrical engineering portions of commercial and utility scale solar * Responsible for contractual electrical engineering scope, verify incorporation into design, and coordination of change orders with project manager * Responsible for insuring project deliverable schedules for electrical engineering scope are met * Coordinate with other project disciplines including civil engineers, geotechnical/structural engineers, and surveyors * Perform electrical engineering design and creation of construction documents for projects * Responsible for performing electrical calculations and studies such as short circuit, load flow calculations and voltage drop. * Coordinate with clients, utilities, and code enforcement officers. * QA/QC of design work performed by interns, graduate engineers, and staff engineers * Maintain awareness of currently available equipment and industry best practices * Collaborate with and support electrical engineering teams in other offices as projects and workload sharing between offices dictates. * Support construction of the projects by responding to contractor and owner requests including RFIs and submittal review * Supervise, train, and/or mentor interns, graduate engineers, and design technicians **Skills and Qualifications:** * Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering or Renewable Engineering Program * Knowledge of NEC and NESC * Knowledge and proficiency in the use of an electrical power system modeling program(s) * Approximately 3\-7 years of experience in the design of electrical distribution, generation, and or general electrical construction * Working knowledge and ability to read and create construction drawings and specification packages * Proficiency with Microsoft Office products * Professional appearance with excellent written and verbal communications skills, including ability to write detailed technical reports with minimal oversite * Experience with progress reports, managing project data and communicating project requirements to internal stakeholders. * Must have a strong work ethic along with a positive attitude * Must be a supportive team member, able to work in a collaborative environment * Must be self\-motivated with an ability to balance multiple projects under tight deadlines with minimal supervision * Ability to use AutoCAD in at least a limited capacity For Preferred Consideration (Not Required): * Experience and knowledge of overall design and construction of renewable power projects * Experience with EV Chargers * Experience in lighting design and photometrics analysis using AGI32 or Visual Lighting * Proficiency in AutoCAD Civil 3D * Electrical PE License or ability to be licensed in the future * Experience with energy storage systems (battery, flywheel, or capacitor) * Experience with ETAP, CYMCAP, WinIGS, and/or DigSilent, PowerFactory to model electrical power systems and perform load flow, short circuit, voltage drop, grounding, thermal, and protective device coordination studies and analysis. * Experience with Homer Grid/Pro modeling software * Experience with microgrid design, back\-up reciprocating generator system design, or data center design * Experience with PSS/E, PSCAD, EMTP, or similar software and performing transient/dynamic modeling and studies or power systems **For Preferred Consideration (Not Required):** * Experience and knowledge of overall design and construction of utility scale PV and/or wind plants. * NABCEP Certification * Proficiency in AutoCAD Civil 3D * Electrical PE License or ability to be licensed in multiple states * Experience with energy storage systems (battery, flywheel, or capacitor) * Proficiency with ETAP, CYMCAP, WinIGS, and/or DigSilent PowerFactory to model electrical power systems and perform load flow, short circuit, voltage drop, grounding, thermal, and protective device coordination studies and analysis. * Experience with PVsyst, Helioscope, SAM, or other PV production modeling software * Experience with Helios 3D. PVcase, RatedPower, SolarFarmer, or other PV site layout software * Experience with PSS/E, PSCAD, EMTP, or similar software and performing transient/dynamic modeling and studies or power systems **About Westwood Professional Services, Inc. (Westwood)** At Westwood, our purpose is to create a better world for people through our work. We transform the energy grid, design resilient infrastructure, and develop communities that will flourish today and for future generations. With over 50 years of experience and a legacy of innovation, we stand at the forefront of our industry, dedicated to understanding the unique needs of the markets we serve. Our approach revolves around people. We are committed to building a culture that attracts, retains, and develops high performers. Our team values relationships, innovation, dedication, initiative, and growth. We believe fostering a collaborative “One Team” mentality yields superior outcomes in everything we do. We customize our technical capabilities and geographic reach to meet our clients where they are and help them realize their vision. We are partners in our clients’ success, driving to provide solutions that make a lasting difference. Safety, sustainability, and operational excellence are not just facets of our work; they are intrinsic to our identity, guiding every decision we make. We are deeply invested in the communities we serve. Through our projects and giving\-back initiatives, we enrich the lives of those we serve, engage others within our industry, and create a lasting impact on communities around the world. To us, success transcends the completion of projects; it is reflected in the lives we have positively impacted by our work. **Join us in creating a better world.** In 2025, Westwood was recognized as \#77 on the ENR Top 500 Design Firms. Additionally, Westwood was ranked \#5 for ENR's Top Design Firm for Solar, \#6 for Battery Storage, and \#3 for Wind (2025\). The firm consistently ranks on the industry's top 25 lists and receives recognition for its involvement in award\-winning projects nationwide. Westwood provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. We believe that diverse backgrounds strengthen our business. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

jobs.title: Senior Forensic Consultant
jobs.description: **The Role:** The Senior Forensic Consultant \- Premises Liability is responsible for conducting forensic investigations, evaluating incident causation, and providing expert analysis related to premises liability matters. This includes slip, trip, and fall incidents, walkway safety evaluations, hazard identification, human factors assessments, accident reconstruction, and related litigation support services. This role is ideal for an experienced forensic consultant, engineer, safety professional, biomechanical expert, or human factors specialist who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and communicating findings to clients, attorneys, insurance carriers, and other stakeholders. Successful candidates bring strong investigative and analytical skills, experience providing expert opinions, and the ability to develop and maintain client relationships in a consulting environment. The ideal candidate possesses both technical expertise and business development acumen, including an established professional network and a demonstrated ability to generate new opportunities through client relationships, presentations, and industry engagement. This is a remote role with significant travel requirements. To best support client needs and business development efforts, we are seeking candidates located in or near the following metropolitan areas: Denver, Chicago, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Atlanta, Phoenix, Boston, or Houston. Candidates should expect to travel approximately 50% or more based on client and project needs. **In This Role, You Will:** * Conduct forensic investigations involving premises liability claims and litigation matters * Evaluate site conditions, building features, maintenance practices, and environmental factors related to incident causation * Perform and oversee site inspections, scene documentation, and evidence collection * Analyze slip, trip, and fall incidents and develop technical opinions regarding causation and liability * Conduct walkway friction testing and slip resistance evaluations * Research and apply relevant building codes, safety regulations, standards, ordinances, and industry best practices * Utilize 3D scanning, photogrammetry, and other forensic technologies to document and analyze incident locations * Perform hazard identification and risk assessments * Conduct human factors evaluations and accident reconstruction analyses when applicable * Prepare technical reports, presentations, and expert witness materials * Provide deposition and trial testimony as an expert witness * Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across engineering, biomechanics, safety, and forensic disciplines * Build and maintain strong client relationships through exceptional service and technical expertise * Deliver presentations, educational seminars, and thought leadership content to clients and industry groups * Support business development initiatives through networking, marketing, and industry involvement * Contribute to the growth of YA Group's forensic consulting practice **What You Bring:** * Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Biomechanics, Safety Sciences, Human Factors, Occupational Safety, or a related technical discipline * 4\+ years of experience conducting premises liability investigations, forensic consulting, safety analysis, accident reconstruction, or related work * Experience evaluating building codes, regulations, ordinances, standards, and safety practices * Experience conducting slip, trip, and fall investigations and developing technical opinions regarding causation and liability * Experience with walkway friction testing and slip resistance evaluations * Experience conducting hazard identification, risk assessments, and human factors analyses * Experience utilizing 3D scanning, photogrammetry, or similar forensic documentation technologies * Experience preparing expert reports and communicating technical findings to attorneys, insurance carriers, clients, and other stakeholders * Prior deposition and/or trial testimony experience * Strong analytical, investigative, and problem\-solving skills * Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and client\-facing communication skills * Demonstrated ability to present to clients, industry organizations, and referral sources * Established relationships within the legal, insurance, risk management, engineering, or forensic consulting industries * Proven history of business development, client retention, and consulting practice growth * Existing book of business or transferable client relationships * Self\-starter with the ability to independently manage projects, clients, and business development activities * Professional Engineer (PE), Certified Safety Professional (CSP), advanced degree (M.S. or Ph.D.), or other relevant professional credential strongly preferred **Who We Are:** YA Group is an international professional services organization providing forensic consulting, engineering, risk mitigation, and related services. Founded over 25 years ago as a property damage consulting firm, YA has expanded through organic growth and strategic acquisitions. Today, YA has over 800 professionals dedicated to excellence, partnership, and driving innovation. YA Group’s Accident Reconstruction \& Biomechanics team applies scientific investigation, engineering principles, and advanced technology to determine how collisions occur and why. Our experts bring extensive training and experience using sophisticated tools—including 3D modeling, vehicle and site inspections, Event Data Recorder downloads, and forensic animations—to analyze physical evidence and reconstruct events with clarity and accuracy. Capable of handling the full spectrum of motor vehicle accidents—from low speed impacts to complex rollover events, heavy truck collisions, autonomous vehicle incidents, and ADAS evaluations—our multidisciplinary specialists deliver analytically grounded findings that support clients across insurance, legal, corporate, and transportation sectors. In addition, our professionals are experienced in litigation support and are courtroom qualified experts, providing clear, confident testimony to effectively communicate reconstruction results and technical conclusions. **What We Offer:** * Employee\-focused culture * Strong commitment to work\-life balance * Remote work * Flexible vacation \& Paid holidays * Paid family care/sick leave * Parental leave * Medical, Dental, Vision \+ more * 401k w/match * Career growth * Competitive salaries \+ Bonus **Fraudulent Recruitment Alert:** Please be vigilant against fraudulent recruitment attempts. YA will never ask for personal financial information, such as bank account numbers or identification numbers, via social media or chat\-based apps. YA also will not request money for the purchase of business equipment, post job opportunities on Craigslist, or conduct interviews solely via text message. All official email communications regarding applications will come from notify@dayforce.com or directly from a member of YA’s talent team using an @yagroup.com domain name. If fraudulent activity is suspected, please contact careers@yagroup.com. **Disclosures:** As part of our recruitment process, we may use AI\-assisted tools to support candidate screening and evaluation. These tools are designed to assist, rather than replace, human decision\-making, and all employment decisions are made by our recruiting team in accordance with applicable laws and our commitment to equal employment opportunity. Where required by law, we will provide additional information about the use of these tools, including their purpose, and offer alternative processes or accommodations upon request. **The pay range for this role is:** $150,000 \- 225,000 USD per year (Remote \- United States) * This wide salary range reflects the flexibility of the role and accommodates candidates across a broad range of experience levels; base salary and bonus will be commensurate with experience.

The Solutions Engineer serves as a technical point of contact for existing customers, leads MDM walkthroughs and training for customers and internal teams, and partners with the Project Management team to ensure deployments are delivered accurately and efficiently. **Minimum Qualifications** 1\. One year of experience in Mobile Device Management (MDM) 2\. Experience with direct, customer\-facing technical communication, including leading troubleshooting calls 3\. Experience with project management or project coordination preferred 4\. HS Diploma required, Associates degree or current enrollment preferred 5\. Proficient in Microsoft Office computer software 6\. High attention to detail and accuracy 7\. Holds a high standard of professionalism and respect for quality 8\. Excellent written and verbal communication skills 9\. Ability to prioritize workload and manage priorities effectively 10\. Ability to work independently and as part of a team **Essential Position Functions** 1\. Responsible for handling incoming troubleshooting tickets as assigned to build working knowledge of customer environments, device deployments, and common issues 2\. Complete new device builds, including MDM profiles, applications, and settings, to customer specifications 3\. Conduct time studies on builds and deployment processes to support accurate project scoping, capacity planning, and process improvement 4\. Support customer rollouts in partnership with the Solutions Engineering team, with ownership shared depending on project scope 5\. Lead MDM walkthroughs for customers and internal teams and record webinar style sessions for reuse where possible 6\. Manage requests from existing customers, including new builds, new device enrollments, configuration changes, and related tasks 7\. Lead customer calls for troubleshooting and escalations, including tier three escalations from internal teams and customers 8\. jobs.title: Senior Software Developer
jobs.description: **About Us:** Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high\-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in software engineering, logical reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P\&L. **Ideal Background:** This role is ideal for engineers who have built production systems at companies like Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, Meta, or similar high\-scale engineering organizations. We especially welcome graduates from top computer science programs such as Stanford, MIT, Carnegie Mellon, UC Berkeley, Georgia Tech, and comparable institutions — though exceptional experience and skill always take precedence over pedigree. **Project Overview:** As a Software Engineering evaluator, you will create cutting\-edge datasets for training, benchmarking, and advancing large language models, collaborating closely with researchers. This includes curating code examples, providing precise solutions, and making corrections — with a primary focus on Python across backend services, data pipelines, and ML infrastructure, alongside JavaScript (including ReactJS), C/C\+\+, Java, Rust, and Go. You will evaluate and refine AI\-generated code for efficiency, scalability, and reliability, and work with cross\-functional teams to enhance enterprise\-level AI\-driven coding solutions. **What Does a Typical Day Look Like?*** Work on AI model training initiatives by curating code examples, building solutions, and correcting code — primarily in Python, with additional work in JavaScript (including ReactJS), C/C\+\+, Java, Rust, and Go. * Evaluate and refine AI\-generated code to ensure that it is efficient, scalable, and reliable. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to enhance AI\-driven coding solutions against industry performance benchmarks. * Build agents and automated verification tools in Python that can verify the quality of code and identify error patterns. * Hypothesize on steps in the software engineering cycle (prototyping, architecture design, API design, production implementation, launch, experiments, monitoring, operational maintenance) and evaluate model capabilities on them. * Design verification mechanisms that can automatically verify a solution to a software engineering task. **Required Skills:*** Several years of software engineering experience (3 years or more). * Strong expertise in Python with deep knowledge of frameworks, tooling, and best practices for building production\-grade software. * Experience building full\-stack applications and deploying scalable software using modern languages and tools. * Deep understanding of software architecture, design, development, debugging, and code quality/review assessment. * Excellent oral and written communication skills for clear, structured evaluation rationales. **Engagement Details:*** Commitment: flexible engagement, minimum 10 hrs/week, up to 40 hrs/week. * Type: Contractor (no medical/paid leave). * Duration: 1 month (potential extensions based on performance and fit). * Location: Candidates must be based in the United States. **Evaluation Process:*** The application process takes 15–30 minutes. * Completion of an AI video interview is required.
